位场（重力和磁力）数据反演固有的非唯一性和分辨率限制。

tm.why: The paper maps the Curie depth and gravity Moho to understand the crustal and lithospheric structure of the Andaman-Nicobar subduction zone.
The study constrains the geothermal regime of a subduction zone, which is highly relevant to volcanic and geothermal systems.

ev.notes: No PDF was available. Analysis is based on the paper title, journal venue, and Google search snippets indicating the mapping of CPD and Moho in the Andaman-Nicobar region.

sum: This study uses teleseismic waveforms from a 300-km-long broadband seismic array to investigate the crustal and upper mantle structure across the central Altyn Tagh Fault and eastern Kunlun Fault in northern Tibet. Using receiver functions, the authors image complex intra-crustal discontinuities and lateral Moho variations. The results suggest a vertically partitioned crustal shortening mechanism: the upper crust accommodates horizontal shortening via brittle faulting and folding, while the mid-lower crust undergoes ductile deformation, distributed shear, and basal thickening. This deformation is driven by far-field compressional stresses from the India-Asia collision, lateral extrusion, and the blocking effect of the rigid Tarim Basin craton.
本研究利用西藏北部一条300公里长的宽频带地震台阵记录的远震波形，通过接收函数方法研究了阿尔金断裂带中部及东昆仑断裂带下方的地壳和上地幔结构。结果显示存在复杂的壳内不连续面和横向变化的莫霍面，表明藏北地区存在垂直分层的地壳缩短模式：上地壳通过脆性断裂和褶皱吸收水平缩短，而中下地壳则通过韧性变形、分布……

t: Teleseismic receiver function analysis using waveforms from a 300-km-long broadband seismic array to image crustal and upper mantle discontinuities.
利用300公里长宽频带地震台阵的远震波形进行接收函数分析，以对地壳和上地幔不连续面成像。
Teleseismic waveforms recorded by a newly deployed 300-km-long broadband seismic array crossing the central Altyn Tagh Fault in northern Tibet.
跨越藏北阿尔金断裂带中部的、新部署的300公里长宽频带地震台阵记录的远震波形。
Discovery of complex intra-crustal discontinuities and lateral Moho variations, supporting a vertically partitioned shortening mode (brittle upper crust, ductile mid-lower crust).
发现复杂的壳内不连续面和莫霍面横向变化，支持垂直分层的缩短模式（上脆下塑）。
The profile-based array configuration limits the ability to resolve full three-dimensional structural variations and absolute velocity constraints.
基于剖面的台阵配置限制了解析完整三维结构变化和绝对速度约束的能力。
First high-resolution receiver function profile across this specific 300-km segment, providing direct structural evidence for vertically partitioned crustal shortening.
首次跨越该特定300公里区段的高分辨率接收函数剖面，为垂直分层地壳缩短提供了直接的结构证据。

kc: Obtained high-resolution images of intra-crustal discontinuities and Moho variations across the central Altyn Tagh Fault.
Proposed a vertically partitioned crustal shortening model for northern Tibet (brittle upper crust vs. ductile mid-lower crust).
Elucidated the geodynamic roles of the Tarim Basin blocking effect and India-Asia collision in regional crustal deformation.
获得了阿尔金断裂带中部壳内不连续面和莫霍面变化的高分辨率图像。
提出了藏北地区垂直分层的地壳缩短模型（上地壳脆性变形与中下地壳韧性变形）。
阐明了塔里木盆地阻挡作用和印度-亚洲碰撞在区域地壳变形中的地球动力学作用。
me: Teleseismic receiver function analysis to image crustal and upper mantle interfaces.
利用远震接收函数分析方法对地壳和上地幔界面进行成像。
de: Teleseismic waveform data recorded by a newly deployed 300-km-long broadband seismic array in northern Tibet.
由研究团队在藏北新部署的300公里长宽频带地震台阵记录的远震波形数据。
li: The study relies primarily on a 2D profile (300-km-long array), which may limit the resolution of 3D lateral variations.

tm.why: The study uses teleseismic receiver functions to image intra-crustal discontinuities and Moho variations.
The paper investigates the crustal shortening mechanism and geodynamics of northern Tibet near the Altyn Tagh Fault.

ev.notes: No PDF was available. The analysis is based on the detailed abstract and metadata from JGR: Solid Earth.

sum: This study utilizes high-resolution satellite geodesy (optical image correlation, InSAR, and GPS) to analyze the 2016 Mw 6.5 Norcia, Italy, earthquake. The authors quantify off-fault deformation (OFD) and investigate its controlling factors, finding an average of 46% OFD that strongly correlates with unconsolidated sediments and gentle topographic slopes. They construct a multi-segment slip model incorporating 3D elastic structure, revealing a heterogeneous slip distribution with a 73% shallow slip deficit (SSD). The lack of correlation between SSD and OFD suggests that OFD is primarily driven by shallow, inelastic surficial processes rather than deep fault slip behavior.
本研究利用高分辨率卫星大地测量数据（光学图像相关性、InSAR和GPS）分析了2016年意大利Mw 6.5诺尔恰地震。作者量化了断层外变形（OFD）并探讨了其控制因素，发现平均OFD达46%，且与松散沉积物和缓坡地形强烈相关。他们构建了包含3D弹性结构的多段滑移模型，揭示了非均匀滑移分布和73%的浅……

t: Joint inversion of optical, InSAR, and GPS data using an innovative noise-corrected optical image correlation technique to resolve near-field 3D displacements and multi-segment slip.
联合反演光学、InSAR和GPS数据，并采用创新的去噪光学图像相关技术解析近场三维位移。
High-resolution satellite geodetic datasets (optical, InSAR, GPS) covering the 2016 Mw 6.5 Norcia earthquake in Italy.
覆盖2016年意大利Mw 6.5诺尔恰地震的高分辨率卫星大地测量数据集（光学、InSAR、GPS）。

Average off-fault deformation is 46%, strongly correlating with unconsolidated sediments and gentle slopes, while a 73% shallow slip deficit shows no along-strike correlation with off-fault deformation.
平均断层外变形为46%，与松散沉积物和缓坡强相关，而73%的浅部滑移亏损与断层外变形无沿走向相关性。
The findings are based on a single normal-faulting event, requiring further validation across different tectonic regimes and fault types.
研究基于单次正断层事件，需在不同构造背景和断层类型中进一步验证。
First comprehensive quantification of normal-faulting off-fault deformation showing it is controlled by surficial lithology rather than deep shallow slip deficit.
首次全面量化正断层外变形，表明其受表层岩性控制而非深部浅层滑移亏损驱动。

kc: Quantified near-field 3D displacements and off-fault deformation (OFD) for the 2016 Norcia earthquake using an innovative noise-corrected optical image correlation method.
Demonstrated a strong correlation of OFD with near-surface lithology (unconsolidated sediments) and topographic slope.
Developed a comprehensive multi-segment slip model incorporating 3D elastic structure and topography, revealing a 73% shallow slip deficit that does not correlate with OFD.
利用创新的去噪光学图像相关方法，量化了2016年诺尔恰地震的近场三维位移和断层外变形（OFD）。
证实了断层外变形与近地表岩性（松散沉积物）和地形坡度之间存在强相关性。

Joint inversion of optical, InSAR, and GPS data.
3D elastic structure and multi-segmented fault geometry modeling.

sum: Ambient noise interferometry typically requires long-term stacking to extract stable empirical Green's functions (EGFs) and suppress spurious arrivals from directional noise. To overcome this, the authors develop a self-supervised neural network weighting stacking (NNWS) method. NNWS learns optimal stacking weights for cross-correlation functions by jointly optimizing signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) and waveform symmetry, which are key proxies of a diffuse wavefield. Synthetic tests show that NNWS successfully mitigates contamination from interfering noise. When applied to 10 days of continuous USArray data, NNWS recovers high-quality, stable EGFs with SNRs surpassing those of conventional 1-year linear stacking. This physics-constrained, label-free approach enables reliable dispersion measurements from short-duration deployments.
针对背景噪声干涉需长期叠加且易受定向噪声干扰的问题，本文提出自监督神经网络加权叠加方法。该方法通过联合优化信噪比和波形对称性，自动学习互相关函数的最佳叠加权重。合成与USArray数据测试表明，该方法仅用10天数据便提取出高质量经验格林函数，信噪比超越传统1年线性叠加，为短周期台阵快速成像提供了高效……

t: A self-supervised neural network weighting stacking (NNWS) method that learns optimal stacking weights for cross-correlation functions by jointly optimizing signal-to-noise ratio and waveform symmetry.
一种自监督神经网络加权叠加方法，通过联合优化信噪比和波形对称性来学习互相关函数的最佳叠加权重。
Synthetic datasets simulating directional noise and 10 days of continuous ambient noise data from the USArray.
模拟定向噪声的合成数据集以及来自USArray的10天连续背景噪声数据。
NNWS successfully extracted stable, high-quality empirical Green's functions from only 10 days of data, achieving higher signal-to-noise ratios than conventional 1-year linear stacking.

The method relies on the assumption that SNR and symmetry are valid proxies for a diffuse wavefield, and requires more computational resources than linear stacking.
该方法依赖于信噪比和对称性作为弥散波场有效代理的假设，且比线性叠加需要更多的计算资源。
First application of a physics-constrained, self-supervised neural network to optimize stacking weights for short-duration ambient noise interferometry without requiring labeled data.

sum: This study quantifies the decadal-scale post-seismic recovery of the Valdivia estuary wetlands following >2 m of coseismic subsidence during the giant M9.5 1960 Chile earthquake. Using historical aerial photography, Landsat/Sentinel imagery, GNSS-derived vertical land motion, tide-gauge and satellite altimetry records, and dated sediment cores, the authors show that open water expanded 8.8-fold post-earthquake but has since contracted linearly. Interseismic uplift (6.2–9.5 mm/yr) currently outpaces regional absolute sea-level rise (2.3 mm/yr), indicating that tectonic vertical land motion dominates wetland recovery over climate forcing. A Monte Carlo projection estimates a return to supratidal elevations by a median year of 2063. The study highlights the critical role of seismic-cycle vertical deformation in coastal wetland resilience.
本研究量化了1960年智利M9.5地震造成>2米沉降后瓦尔迪维亚河口的震后恢复。利用航片、GNSS垂直运动及沉积物芯，发现震间抬升（6.2-9.5 mm/yr）远超海平面上升，表明构造运动主导了湿地恢复。预测显示河口将于2063年恢复至潮上带。研究阐明了地震周期垂直运动对沿海湿地韧性的关键影响。

t: Quantifying post-seismic wetland recovery using historical aerial photography, satellite imagery, GNSS vertical land motion, tide-gauge/altimetry records, sediment cores, and Monte Carlo projections.
结合历史航片、卫星影像、GNSS地壳垂直运动、潮位计与卫星测高及沉积物芯进行综合量化分析。
Historical aerial photos, Landsat/Sentinel imagery, GNSS vertical land motion data, tide-gauge and satellite altimetry sea-level records, and dated sediment cores from the Valdivia estuary.
智利瓦尔迪维亚河口的航片与卫星图像、GNSS垂直运动数据、潮位与测高记录及定年沉积物芯。
Interseismic uplift (6.2–9.5 mm/yr) outpaces sea-level rise (2.3 mm/yr), driving wetland recovery with a projected return to supratidal elevations by a median year of 2063.
震间抬升速率（6.2-9.5毫米/年）超过海平面上升，预计河口将在2063年恢复至潮上带高度。
Projections are dominated by uncertainties in coseismic subsidence magnitude and future IPCC sea-level rise scenarios.
预测结果受同震沉降幅度及未来IPCC海平面上升情景的不确定性主导。
Demonstrates that tectonic vertical land motion, rather than climate forcing, dominates decadal-scale coastal wetland recovery in active subduction zones.
首次证实构造垂直地壳运动而非气候因素主导了活动俯冲带沿海湿地的十年尺度恢复。

证实了当前的构造垂直抬升速率（6.2-9.5毫米/年）远超区域绝对海平面上升速率（2.3毫米/年）。
利用蒙特卡洛模拟预测该河口将在2063年左右恢复至潮上带高度。

Integration of GNSS-derived vertical land motion, tide-gauge, and satellite altimetry records.
Dating and analysis of sediment cores to determine accretion rates across different facies.
Monte Carlo projections combining vertical land motion, accretion, and IPCC sea-level scenarios.

结合垂直地壳运动、沉积堆积和IPCC海平面情景进行蒙特卡洛预测。

GNSS-derived vertical land motion measurements across the Valdivia estuary.
Regional tide-gauge and satellite altimetry sea-level records.

区域潮位计和卫星测高海平面记录。

sum: This study presents geochemical and geochronological data of Eocene–Oligocene potassic magmatism along the Jinshajiang–Ailaoshan belt in southeastern Tibet. The paper discusses the petrogenesis of these potassic rocks and provides evidence for the reactivation of the metasomatized subcontinental lithospheric mantle (SCLM). It suggests that this reactivation was triggered by asthenospheric upwelling or interaction, shedding light on the geodynamic evolution and lithospheric thinning/destruction processes of the southeastern Tibetan Plateau during the Cenozoic India-Asia collision.
本研究提供了藏东南金沙江-哀牢山带始新世—渐新世富钾岩浆作用的地球化学和年代学数据。通过分析这些富钾岩石的成因，文章提供了交代岩石圈地幔重活化的证据，并指出该重活化是由软流圈上涌或相互作用触发的。这一成果为理解印度-亚洲大陆碰撞过程中藏东南深部动力学演化及岩石圈减薄机制提供了重要启示。

t: Geochemical, isotopic, and geochronological analyses of potassic magmatic rocks to constrain their petrogenesis and mantle source characteristics.
对富钾岩浆岩进行地球化学、同位素和年代学分析，以约束其岩石成因和地幔源区特征。
Analytical datasets, reference materials, and quality-control data of Eocene-Oligocene potassic rocks from the Jinshajiang-Ailaoshan belt.
金沙江-哀牢山带始新世—渐新世富钾岩石的分析数据集、标准物质和质量控制数据。
Identified asthenosphere-triggered reactivation of metasomatized lithospheric mantle as the primary driver for the Eocene-Oligocene potassic magmatism in southeastern Tibet.
确定了软流圈触发的交代岩石圈地幔重活化是藏东南始新世—渐新世富钾岩浆作用的主要驱动力。
Geochemical models of mantle reactivation lack direct physical validation from high-resolution in-situ geophysical observations.
地幔重活化的地球化学模型缺乏来自高分辨率原位地球物理观测的直接物理验证。
Links Eocene-Oligocene potassic magmatism directly to asthenospheric triggering of a previously metasomatized lithospheric mantle along a major strike-slip belt.
将始新世—渐新世富钾岩浆作用直接与主要走滑带上先前交代的岩石圈地幔的软流圈触发重活化联系起来。

kc: Provides comprehensive geochemical and geochronological datasets for Eocene-Oligocene potassic magmatism along the Jinshajiang-Ailaoshan belt.
Demonstrates that the potassic magmas originated from a metasomatized subcontinental lithospheric mantle source.
Proposes a geodynamic model where asthenospheric upwelling triggered the reactivation of the lithospheric mantle in southeastern Tibet.
提供了金沙江-哀牢山带始新世—渐新世富钾岩浆作用的系统地球化学 and 年代学数据集。
证实了富钾岩浆源于交代的次大陆岩石圈地幔源区。
提出了软流圈上涌触发藏东南岩石圈地幔重活化的深部动力学模型。
me: Geochemical analysis of major and trace elements in potassic igneous rocks.
Geochronological dating (e.g., zircon U-Pb dating) to constrain the timing of magmatism.
Isotopic tracing (e.g., Sr-Nd-Pb-Hf isotopes) to identify magma sources and mantle metasomatism.
富钾火成岩的主量和微量元素地球化学分析。
年代学测定（如锆石U-Pb定年）以约束岩浆作用时代。
同位素示踪（如Sr-Nd-Pb-Hf同位素）以识别岩浆源区和地幔交代作用。
de: Analytical results, reference materials, and quality-control data presented in Appendices A1–A6 and B1–B2.
Detailed analytical procedures and instrumental conditions described in Appendix C1.
附录A1-A6和B1-B2中提供的分析结果、标准物质和质量控制数据。
附录C1中详细描述的分析步骤和仪器测试条件。
li: The study relies heavily on geochemical proxies, which can have non-unique geodynamic interpretations without complementary high-resolution geophysical imaging.
研究主要依赖地球化学指标，在缺乏高分辨率地球物理成像的辅助下，其动力学解释可能存在多解性。

tm.why: The paper investigates Eocene-Oligocene potassic magmatism in southeastern Tibet to understand the reactivation of the metasomatized lithospheric mantle triggered by the asthenosphere.

ev.notes: No PDF was available. The analysis is based on the paper's title, abstract, and metadata from OpenAlex.

sum: This study investigates the deep crustal structure and magmatic plumbing system beneath the Harrat Al-Madinah intraplate basaltic volcanic field in western Saudi Arabia. The authors analyze 70 days of continuous vertical-component ambient seismic noise recorded by eight borehole seismometers installed at ~120 m depth (VORiSA network). By combining conventional amplitude-preserving autocorrelation with phase autocorrelation and phase-weighted stacking (PAC–PWS), they evaluate reflector stability and lateral coherence while suppressing near-surface scattering and amplitude fluctuations. Time-to-depth conversion using a regional 1-D velocity model identifies six principal reflectors above 50 km depth: shallow volcanic boundaries (~10 km), mid-crustal interfaces (10–25 km), the Conrad discontinuity (~22 km), the Moho (~38 km), and a lowermost crustal/upper-mantle feature (~46–47 km). Cross-validation with magnetotelluric models shows that mid-crustal reflectors coincide with a major conductive zone interpreted as a magma reservoir, demonstrating the effectiveness of borehole noise autocorrelation in intraplate volcanic terrains.
本研究利用沙特西部麦地那板内火山场VORiSA台网8个约120米深钻孔地震仪记录的70天连续垂直分量背景噪声数据，探测深部地壳结构与岩浆系统。研究结合常规线性自相关与相位自相关加权叠加（PAC-PWS）方法，在压制强振幅干扰的同时提取稳定的P波反射信号。时深转换结果揭示了50公里深度内的6个主要反射……

t: Applies both conventional autocorrelation (daily linear stacking plus spectral normalization) and phase autocorrelation with daily phase-weighted stacking (PAC–PWS, exponent v=3) to 20-s RMS-normalized vertical borehole noise windows, followed by 1-D depth conversion.
对20秒RMS归一化垂直钻孔噪声窗应用常规自相关与相位自相关加权叠加（PAC-PWS），并进行一维时深转换。

Analyzes 70 days (April 21–June 30, 2012) of continuous 250-Hz seismic waveforms recorded by eight 3-component short-period borehole seismometers installed at ~120 m depth in the VORiSA network across Harrat Al-Madinah.
使用麦地那火山场VORiSA台网8个120米深钻孔地震仪采集的70天连续250 Hz三分量波形数据。

Identifies six principal reflectors above ~50 km depth: shallow volcanic interfaces (~10 km), mid-crustal boundaries (10–25 km) matching a magnetotelluric conductive magma reservoir, the Conrad (~22 km), the Moho (~38 km), and a ~46–47 km reflector.
识别出50公里内6个主要反射层，含康拉德面（22km）、莫霍面（38km）及与高导岩浆房吻合的中地壳界面。

Reflector physical interpretation is non-unique, 1-D velocity depth conversion ignores lateral volcanic heterogeneity, and the 70-day duration cannot separate subsurface temporal changes from environmental noise variations.
反射物理解释具多解性，一维速度模型忽略横向非均匀性，且70天数据难以区分地下变化与环境波动。
Combines a borehole seismic array with ambient-noise autocorrelation and phase-weighted stacking to image deep crustal reflectivity and magma plumbing beneath an intraplate volcanic field.
首次结合钻孔地震台阵与背景噪声相位自相关技术，对板内火山场深部地壳反射率与岩浆系统成像。

kc: Demonstrates the first combined application of borehole seismic array data, conventional autocorrelation, and PAC–PWS for crustal reflectivity imaging beneath an intraplate volcanic field.
Identifies six laterally coherent crustal reflectors down to ~50 km depth beneath Harrat Al-Madinah, including the Conrad (~22 km) and Moho (~38 km) discontinuities.
Links mid-crustal seismic reflectors (10–25 km depth) with a known 3-D magnetotelluric conductive anomaly, supporting a multi-level, vertically organized magmatic storage system.
首次将钻孔地震台阵数据、常规自相关与相位自相关加权叠加（PAC–PWS）结合，用于板内火山场地壳反射率成像。
在麦地那火山场下方50公里深度内识别出6个横向连续的主要反射界面，包括康拉德面（~22 km）和莫霍面（~38 km）。
将中地壳反射层（10–25 km）与三维大地电磁高导异常相印证，支持了多层级垂向连通岩浆储运系统的认识。
me: Quality control and ambient-noise characterization via hourly average amplitudes and FFT-based power spectral density (PSD) analysis in 0.1–0.3 Hz and 1–10 Hz bands.

Two-branch autocorrelation processing on 20-s RMS-normalized vertical-component windows: conventional autocorrelation with daily linear stacking and spectral whitening versus phase autocorrelation with daily phase-weighted stacking (PAC–PWS, exponent v = 3).
Lag-time to depth conversion using a 1-D regional P-wave velocity model from seismic refraction, cross-validated against receiver functions and 3-D magnetotelluric resistivity profiles.
通过0.1–0.3 Hz和1–10 Hz频段的小时平均振幅和基于FFT的功率谱密度（PSD）分析，进行数据质量控制和背景噪声特征评估。
对20秒RMS归一化的垂直分量窗口进行双分支自相关处理：常规自相关配合日线性叠加与频域归一化，以及相位自相关配合日相位加权叠加（PAC–PWS，指数v=3）。
利用区域一维地震折射P波速度模型进行时深转换，并与接收函数和三维大地电磁电阻率模型进行交叉验证。
de: 70 days (April 21 to June 30, 2012) of continuous 250-Hz seismic recordings from 8 three-component short-period (2 Hz) borehole sensors deployed at ~120 m depth in the VORiSA network.
Sensitivity experiments evaluating segmentation window lengths (20 s vs. 30 s) and PWS phase-weighting exponents (v = 1.0, 1.5, 2.0, 3.0) on reflector continuity.
VORiSA台网8个安装在约120米深处的三分量短周期（2 Hz）钻孔地震仪在2012年4月21日至6月30日期间记录的70天连续250 Hz采样数据。
针对数据分段窗长（20秒对比30秒）和相位加权叠加指数（v = 1.0, 1.5, 2.0, 3.0）对反射层连续性影响的敏感性测试实验。
li: Reflector interpretation is inherently non-unique; impedance contrasts could represent magmatic intrusions, metamorphic boundaries, compositional layering, or anisotropy.
Time-to-depth conversion relies on a 1-D regional P-wave velocity model, which introduces depth uncertainties in a laterally heterogeneous volcanic setting.
The 70-day recording duration is too short to confidently separate subsurface magmatic temporal changes from seasonal or environmental noise fluctuations.
反射界面的物理解释具有多解性，波阻抗反差可能源于岩浆侵入、变质边界、成分分层或各向异性。
时深转换依赖一维区域P波速度模型，在横向非均匀的火山环境中会引入深度转换误差。
70天的观测时长较短，难以将地下岩浆动态变化与季节性或环境噪声波动可靠区分。

tm.why: The paper applies conventional and phase ambient-noise autocorrelation with phase-weighted stacking to extract crustal P-wave reflection responses.
The study focuses on imaging the deep magmatic plumbing system and mid-crustal magma reservoirs beneath the Harrat Al-Madinah intraplate volcanic field.
The results resolve six major crustal reflectors down to ~50 km depth, including the Conrad and Moho discontinuities beneath western Saudi Arabia.

sum: This study curates and describes a valuable historical dataset from the Lamont-IGY (International Geophysical Year) long-period seismograph network, which operated globally from 1957 to 1962. The authors provide digitized seismograms and, crucially, reconstruct the instrument-response functions for these early stations. This allows modern seismological methods, such as waveform modeling and source inversion, to be applied to key historical earthquakes from the mid-20th century. The work bridges the gap between historical analog recordings and modern digital seismology, preserving irreplaceable data for long-term geophysical studies.
本研究整理并重建了1957至1962年间运行的Lamont-IGY（国际地球物理年）全球历史长周期地震台网的数据集。作者提供了数字化的地震图，并关键性地重建了这些早期台站的仪器响应函数。这一工作使得现代地震学方法（如波形建模和震源机制反演）能够应用于20世纪中叶的重要历史地震。该研究弥合了历史模拟记……

sum: This study utilizes a two-month seafloor Distributed Acoustic Sensing (DAS) dataset acquired near the Kefalonia Transform Fault (KTF) in 2024 to resolve interseismic microseismicity. By applying a matched-filter method with five template events, the authors detected 17,325 microearthquakes, nearly 20 times the number in the concurrent land-based regional catalog. The newly detected seismicity reveals intense, episodic swarms, with one cluster accounting for over 72% of detections. This work lowers the local magnitude of completeness by approximately 2 units near the template clusters, demonstrating that the KTF releases strain near-continuously during its interseismic period through persistent episodic swarm-like activity.
本研究利用2024年凯法利尼亚转换断层（KTF）附近的海底分布式声学传感（DAS）数据解析震间微震。通过对5个模板事件进行匹配滤波，检测到17,325次微地震，是同期陆地台网的近20倍。新地震活动呈强烈幕式震群特征。该工作将局部完备震级降低约2个单位，表明KTF在震间期通过持续的幕式震群近乎连续地释……

t: Matched-filter template matching using five template events applied to continuous seafloor Distributed Acoustic Sensing (DAS) data.
对连续海底分布式声学传感（DAS）数据应用基于五个模板事件的匹配滤波模板匹配技术。
A two-month continuous seafloor DAS dataset acquired near the Kefalonia Transform Fault in 2024, compared with concurrent regional land-based catalog.

Detection of 17,325 microearthquakes (20x land catalog), lowering the magnitude of completeness by ~2 units and revealing persistent episodic swarms.
检测到17,325次微地震（陆地目录的20倍），使完备震级降低约2个单位，揭示了持续的幕式震群。
Detection is restricted to the vicinity of the five template events and limited by the two-month duration of the dataset.
检测受限于五个模板事件的邻近区域，且受限于两个月的数据时长。
First application of seafloor DAS to resolve high-resolution interseismic microseismicity and persistent swarm-like strain release along the Kefalonia Transform Fault.

sum: This study investigates the spatiotemporal evolution of post-collisional slab breakoff along the >2,500 km Paleo-Tethyan sutures in southwest China. Using in situ LA-ICP-MS U–Pb dating of retrograde rutile in eclogites, the authors constrain exhumation timing to 246.7 ± 8.5 and 239.7 ± 14.0 Ma in the Changning–Menglian suture zone (western Yunnan), and 213.0 ± 10.0 and 205.6 ± 8.9 Ma in the Longmu Co–Shuanghu suture zone (northern Tibet). Combining these results with compiled regional geochronological and geochemical data for high-pressure metamorphic and syn-exhumation igneous rocks, the study demonstrates that eclogite exhumation was coeval with crustal anatexis and asthenospheric upwelling. The ~30 Myr age lag between western Yunnan and northern Tibet provides direct geochronological evidence that post-collisional slab breakoff initiated beneath western Yunnan and propagated bilaterally via lateral slab tearing, explaining the diachronous tectonomagmatic evolution along the collision zone.
本研究利用原位LA-ICP-MS金红石U-Pb定年技术，结合区域变质岩与火成岩年代学及地球化学汇编数据，探讨了中国西南古特提斯缝合带碰撞后板片断离的时空演化。结果显示，滇西昌宁-孟连带退变榴辉岩折返年龄为246.7±8.5和239.7±14.0 Ma，而藏北龙木错-双湖带为213.0±10.0和20……

t: In situ U–Pb isotopic analysis of handpicked retrograde rutile grains using a 193 nm ArF excimer laser coupled to a sector-field ICP-MS, calibrated with RMJG and NIST612 standards and processed via Tera–Wasserburg concordia diagrams.
利用193 nm准分子激光联用ICP-MS对退变金红石进行原位U-Pb定年，获取下交点年龄。

Four retrograde eclogite samples from the Changning–Menglian and Longmu Co–Shuanghu suture zones, supplemented by compiled regional geochronological and geochemical datasets of early Mesozoic metamorphic and igneous rocks.
滇西与藏北4件退变榴辉岩样品，以及区域早中生代高压变质岩和火成岩的汇编数据。

Rutile from western Yunnan eclogites yielded lower intercept U–Pb ages of 239.7 ± 14.0 Ma and 246.7 ± 8.5 Ma, whereas northern Tibet samples yielded younger ages of 213.0 ± 10.0 Ma and 205.6 ± 8.9 Ma.
The analyzed rutile grains have low uranium contents (down to 0.01–0.42 ppm in western Yunnan) and grain sizes <200 μm, which lowers their bulk closure temperature and increases age uncertainties.
金红石粒径小于200微米且滇西样品铀含量极低，降低了封闭温度并增大了定年误差。

Provides direct rutile U–Pb geochronological evidence of a ~30 Myr northwestward migration in eclogite exhumation, demonstrating bilateral slab tearing from western Yunnan rather than synchronous breakoff.
直接揭示了滇西与藏北榴辉岩折返存在约30 Myr时差，证实了双向扩展的穿时板片断离。

kc: Obtained new in situ LA-ICP-MS rutile U–Pb ages for retrograde eclogites in the Changning–Menglian (246.7–239.7 Ma) and Longmu Co–Shuanghu (213.0–205.6 Ma) suture zones.
Quantified a ~30 Myr time lag in high-pressure rock exhumation and coeval syn-exhumation magmatism from western Yunnan to northern Tibet.
Proposed a bilateral propagating slab tearing model initiating beneath western Yunnan to explain the spatiotemporal heterogeneity of post-collisional tectonomagmatism.
获得了昌宁-孟连带（246.7–239.7 Ma）和龙木错-双湖带（213.0–205.6 Ma）退变榴辉岩的原位LA-ICP-MS金红石U-Pb新年龄。
量化了从滇西到藏北高压变质岩折返及同折返岩浆活动之间约30 Myr的时间滞后。
提出了始于滇西并向两侧扩展的板片撕裂模型，解释了碰撞后构造岩浆活动的时空异质性。
me: In situ U–Pb isotopic dating of rutile using a 193 nm ArF excimer laser coupled to a sector-field ICP-MS.
Petrographic and microstructural analysis via optical microscopy and back-scattered electron (BSE) imaging to confirm retrograde origin of rutile.
Synthesis of regional geochronological (zircon U–Pb, Ar–Ar, Lu–Hf) and geochemical (zircon saturation temperature, Hf isotopes) datasets.
利用193 nm准分子激光联用扇形磁场ICP-MS对金红石进行原位U-Pb同位素定年。
通过光学显微镜和背散射电子（BSE）成像进行岩相学与显微构造分析，确认金红石的退变质成因。
综合分析区域年代学（锆石U-Pb、Ar-Ar、Lu-Hf）和地球化学（锆石饱和温度、Hf同位素）数据集。
de: Four retrograde eclogite samples: two from western Yunnan (23LC004, 23SJ041/042) and two from northern Tibet (21GMC55, 21GMC66).
Compiled database of early Mesozoic high-pressure metamorphic and igneous rock ages, zircon εHf(t), and whole-rock geochemistry across southwest China.
4件退变榴辉岩样品：2件采自滇西（23LC004, 23SJ041/042），2件采自藏北（21GMC55, 21GMC66）。
中国西南早中生代高压变质岩和火成岩年龄、锆石εHf(t)及全岩地球化学汇编数据库。
li: Low uranium concentrations in western Yunnan rutile (0.01–0.50 ppm) result in relatively large analytical uncertainties (±8.5 to ±14.0 Ma).
The proposed bilateral slab tearing geometry is inferred from surface geochronological and geochemical trends rather than direct deep geophysical imaging.
滇西金红石样品的铀含量较低（0.01–0.50 ppm），导致定年结果的分析误差相对较大（±8.5至±14.0 Ma）。
所提出的双向板片撕裂几何形态主要基于地表年代学和地球化学趋势推断，缺乏深部地球物理成像的直接约束。

tm.why: The paper uses rutile U-Pb geochronology of retrograde eclogites to constrain the geodynamic evolution of post-collisional slab breakoff, slab tearing, and asthenospheric upwelling along the Paleo-Tethyan sutures.

sum: This study presents AlpRA25, a high-resolution 3D model of shear-wave velocity and radial anisotropy down to 250 km depth across the Greater Alpine region, Northern Apennines, and Northern Dinarides. The authors combine two years of ambient noise recordings (~700 stations) with over 5 million waveforms from ~6,000 earthquakes (~3,300 stations) to extract ~295,000 Rayleigh and ~237,000 Love dispersion curves (3–250 s). Using least-squares 2D phase-velocity mapping and Particle Swarm Optimization for 1D depth inversions, the model resolves detailed collisional deformation. Within the upper crust, negative radial anisotropy marks steep fault zones, thrust fronts, and the Ivrea body, while strong positive (horizontal) anisotropy dominates the lower crust due to ductile flow. In the upper mantle, negative radial anisotropy delineates subvertical Eurasian and Apenninic slabs, supporting continuous southward Eurasian subduction beneath the Eastern Alps without polarity reversal and confirming Western Alpine slab break-off below 70 km.
本研究结合约700个台站的背景噪声和约3300个台站的约6000次地震数据，提取了约29.5万条瑞利波和23.7万条勒夫波频散曲线，利用最小二乘层析成像和粒子群优化反演，构建了大阿尔卑斯地区0-250 km高分辨率三维横波速度与径向各向异性模型（AlpRA25）。结果表明：上地壳负径向各向异性对应陡……

t: 2D phase velocity maps (3–250 s) are inverted on a 30-km triangular grid via LSQR, followed by joint Rayleigh-Love 1D depth inversions at each node using Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) and Knopoff matrix forward modeling.
利用LSQR反演3–250 s二维相速度图，再通过粒子群算法联合反演各节点一维VSV、VSH及径向各向异性。
Two years of ambient noise from ~700 stations and >5 million waveforms from ~6,000 earthquakes across ~3,300 stations, merged into 295,000 Rayleigh and 237,018 Love dispersion curves (3–250 s).
融合约700台站2年背景噪声与约3300台站6000次地震波形，共获得29.5万条瑞利波和23.7万条勒夫波频散曲线。

Negative radial anisotropy (0.6 < ξ < 1) marks steep upper-crustal thrusts, the Ivrea body, and subvertical Eurasian and Apenninic slabs, while strong positive anisotropy (1 < ξ < 1.4) characterizes the lower crust and inter-slab mantle.
负径向各向异性标记了上地壳陡倾冲断带、Ivrea体及近垂直俯冲板片，下地壳与板片间地幔则呈强正各向异性。

Seismic tomography cannot unambiguously distinguish between intrinsic lattice-preferred orientation (LPO) and extrinsic shape-preferred orientation (SPO) or structural fabrics, and short-period resolution is reduced in peripheral basins.
层析成像无法唯一区分LPO与裂缝或层理等SPO机制，且南亚平宁等边缘区域短周期射线覆盖较低。
First high-resolution 3D radial anisotropy and shear-velocity model (AlpRA25) spanning the entire Greater Alpine crust and upper mantle down to 250 km using >3,300 stations.
首次利用超3300个台站构建了涵盖整个大阿尔卑斯地壳与上地幔（至250 km）的高分辨率三维径向各向异性模型。

kc: Constructed AlpRA25, a comprehensive 3D shear-wave velocity and radial anisotropy model of the Greater Alpine crust and upper mantle down to 250 km depth.
Implemented an empirical sigmoidal period-dependent weighting scheme to seamlessly merge ambient-noise and earthquake dispersion measurements.

Demonstrated that upper crustal negative radial anisotropy tracks thin-skinned fold-and-thrust belts, steeply dipping faults, and the Ivrea body, while lower crust exhibits strong horizontal anisotropy.
Imaged negative radial anisotropy within subvertical Eurasian and Apenninic slabs, arguing against subduction polarity reversal in the Eastern Alps and supporting slab break-off in the Western Alps.
构建了大阿尔卑斯地区地壳至上地幔250 km深度的三维横波速度与径向各向异性高分辨率模型（AlpRA25）。
实施了基于周期的经验S型加权校正方案，无缝融合了背景噪声和地震面波频散测量数据。
揭示了上地壳负径向各向异性追踪薄皮褶皱冲断带、陡倾断层和Ivrea体，而下地壳表现出强烈的水平各向异性。
在近垂直的欧亚和亚平宁俯冲板片中成像出负径向各向异性，反驳了东阿尔卑斯俯冲极性反转假说并支持西阿尔卑斯板片断离。
me: Ambient noise frequency-domain cross-correlation using SeisLib to extract Rayleigh and Love phase velocities.
Two-station cross-correlation and Gaussian filtering of teleseismic/regional earthquake waveforms for fundamental-mode dispersion.
Empirical sigmoidal period-dependent discrepancy correction to merge ambient noise and earthquake dispersion datasets.
2D least-squares (LSQR) tomographic inversion on a 30-km triangular grid for phase velocity maps (3–250 s) with roughness quality control.
Joint Rayleigh-Love 1D depth inversion at each grid node using Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) and Thomson-Haskell/Knopoff forward modeling.
使用SeisLib进行背景噪声频域互相关，提取瑞利波和勒夫波相速度频散曲线。
对远震/区域地震波形进行双台互相关和高斯滤波，测量基阶面波相速度频散。
应用基于周期的经验S型权重校正函数，消除系统偏差并融合背景噪声与地震频散数据集。
在30 km间距三角形网格上使用LSQR算法反演3–250 s二维相速度图，并进行频散曲线粗糙度质控。
结合Thomson-Haskell/Knopoff正演与粒子群优化算法（PSO），在各网格节点联合反演一维VSV、VSH及莫霍面深度。
de: 2 years (2017–2019) of continuous three-component ambient noise data from ~700 broadband stations, yielding 46,041 Rayleigh and 40,028 Love dispersion curves.
Over 5 million waveforms from ~6,000 earthquakes (1990–2022, Mw 4–6, epicentral distance 2.5°–120°) recorded at ~3,300 stations.
Merged dataset of 295,000 Rayleigh and 237,018 Love interstation dispersion curves spanning 3 to 250 s.
Checkerboard resolution tests confirming 55 km lateral resolution at short periods (5, 20 s) and 110 km at long periods (101, 145 s).
约700个宽频带台站2年（2017–2019年）的连续三分量背景噪声记录，提取了46,041条瑞利波和40,028条勒夫波频散曲线。
约3,300个台站记录的1990–2022年间约6,000次地震（Mw 4–6，震中距2.5°–120°）的超500万条波形数据。
校正合并后共获得周期3至250 s的295,000条瑞利波和237,018条勒夫波台站对频散曲线。
检测板分辨率测试表明短周期（5、20 s）横向分辨率达55 km，长周期（101、145 s）横向分辨率达110 km。
li: Seismic tomography cannot unambiguously distinguish between intrinsic lattice-preferred orientation (LPO) and extrinsic shape-preferred orientation (SPO) such as cracks or layering.
Low raypath coverage of short-period ambient noise measurements in peripheral areas like the Southern Apennines and Tyrrhenian basin reduces shallow resolution and increases misfit.
Below 250 km depth, the Eurasian and Apenninic slabs become indistinguishable, preventing deeper inferences on Eurasian slab break-off in the Central Alps.
地震层析成像无法明确区分岩石晶格优选方位（LPO）与裂缝、层理等形态优选方位（SPO）引起的各向异性。
南亚平宁和第勒尼安海盆等边缘区域的短周期背景噪声射线覆盖较低，限制了浅部解析度并导致拟合残差增大。
在250 km深度以下，欧亚板片与亚平宁板片难以区分，无法对中阿尔卑斯欧亚板片更深部的断离情况做出推断。

tm.why: The paper constructs a 3D model of shear-wave radial anisotropy across the Alpine-Apennine region down to 250 km depth.
It inverts ~295,000 Rayleigh and ~237,000 Love wave dispersion curves from ambient noise and earthquakes for 2D phase velocity maps and 3D shear-wave models.
The model constrains crust-mantle coupling, slab geometry, subduction polarity, and collisional deformation across the Eurasian-Adriatic plate boundary.

ev.notes: Full 30-page PDF provided and analyzed, including abstract, methodology, figures 1–11, and conclusions.

sum: This paper investigates the feasibility of assessing coseismic rupture potential by analyzing interseismic viscoelastic coupling. Using geodetic observations and viscoelastic modeling, the authors examine the relationship between accumulated slip deficit and subsequent earthquake rupture characteristics. They identify a positive correlation between the accumulated slip deficit and coseismic slip, suggesting that interseismic viscoelastic coupling models can provide critical constraints on the spatial distribution and maximum magnitude of future earthquake ruptures. This approach bridges the gap between long-term interseismic deformation and short-term coseismic rupture behavior, offering a valuable framework for seismic hazard assessment along major fault zones.
本文探讨了利用震间粘弹性耦合评估同震破裂潜力的可行性。作者结合大地测量观测与粘弹性介质建模，分析了累积滑移亏损与随后地震破裂特征之间的关系。研究发现累积滑移亏损与同震滑移量之间存在正相关关系，表明震间粘弹性耦合模型能够为未来地震破裂的空间分布和最大震级提供关键约束。该方法建立了长期震间形变与短期同震……

t: Viscoelastic dislocation modeling and geodetic inversion to estimate interseismic coupling and accumulated slip deficit on faults.
利用粘弹性位错建模和大地测量反演来估算断层上的震间耦合和累积滑移亏损。
Geodetic observations (GNSS/InSAR) and historical earthquake rupture models used to analyze slip deficit and coseismic slip correlation.
用于分析滑移亏损与同震滑移相关性的大地测量观测（GNSS/InSAR）及历史地震破裂模型。

Simplifications in viscoelastic rheology and limited spatial resolution of geodetic data at seismogenic depths.
粘弹性流变学的简化以及大地测量数据在发震深度处的空间分辨率有限。
Directly linking interseismic viscoelastic coupling and accumulated slip deficit to quantitative coseismic rupture potential assessment.

sum: Standard elastic full-waveform inversion (FWI) assumes welded contact across material interfaces, yet targets like karst cavities, fractures, and soil-structure contacts often exhibit tangential slip. This paper investigates how violating this assumption impacts parameter recovery. Using the FEniCS finite-element platform, the author compares a standard continuous Galerkin (CG) solver (enforcing welded continuity) with a discontinuous Galerkin (DG) solver based on Nitsche's interior penalty method (permitting tangential slip). In a 2D synthetic cross-test where observed data are generated with the slip-permitting DG solver for a circular inclusion, inverting with the CG solver commits an 'inversion crime': it achieves a numerically lower L2 misfit (7.33e-6 vs. 1.57e-5 at iteration 12) by artificially inflating the inclusion's density (6.26 vs. 5.93) while leaving shear modulus frozen. The study demonstrates that unmodelled interfacial slip translates into systematic bulk parameter bias in FWI.
常规弹性全波形反演（FWI）假设介质界面为焊接接触，但喀斯特溶洞、裂缝及土-结接触面常存在切向滑移。本文基于FEniCS有限元平台，对比了强制焊接连续的连续伽辽金（CG）法与基于Nitsche内部罚函数允许切向滑移的间断伽辽金（DG）法。通过对二维圆形夹杂体模型进行合成数据交叉测试（以DG生成观测数……

t: Compares standard continuous Galerkin (welded) and Nitsche-based discontinuous Galerkin (tangential slip) 2D finite-element elastodynamic formulations in FEniCS, using central finite differences to compute L2 misfit gradients for parameter inversion.
在FEniCS中对比二维连续伽辽金（焊接）与基于Nitsche方法的间断伽辽金（切向滑移）正演格式，利用中心有限差分梯度…

A 2D synthetic cross-test on a circular inclusion embedded in a homogeneous background, where observed surface seismograms are generated using the slip-permitting DG solver and inverted by both CG and DG solvers.
基于含圆形夹杂体的二维均匀背景合成模型，用允许滑移的DG求解器生成地表观测记录，并分别用CG和DG求解器反演。
At iteration 12, the welded CG solver reaches a lower misfit (7.3e-6 vs. 1.6e-5 for DG) by over-inflating density to 6.26 (vs. 5.93 for DG) to compensate for unmodelled interfacial slip.
12次迭代后，CG求解器虽获得更低残差（7.3e-6对比1.6e-5），但通过将密度高估至6.26（DG为5.93）来强…
Limited to a small 2D model with a single circular inclusion, adjoint-free finite-difference gradients, and incomplete convergence after 12 iterations.
局限于含单个圆形夹杂体的二维小模型、无伴随有限差分梯度，且12次迭代后参数尚未完全收敛。

Demonstrates through a synthetic cross-test that unmodelled interfacial slip generates secondary diffracted wavefields concentrated at the inclusion boundary.
Proves that a welded CG FWI solver compensates for missing interfacial slip physics by systematically biasing density estimates upward while achieving a misleadingly lower data misfit.
在FEniCS中构建并实现了用于二维弹性FWI的连续伽辽金（CG，焊接界面）和基于Nitsche方法的间断伽辽金（DG，允许切向滑移）正演求解器。
通过合成交叉测试证明，未建模的界面滑移会在夹杂体边界处产生并向外传播的次生绕射波场。
证明焊接假设的CG反演求解器会通过系统性高估密度参数来补偿缺失的界面滑移物理机制，虽获得更低的数据残差却牺牲了物理真实性。
me: 2D time-domain elastodynamic finite-element modelling implemented in FEniCS.
Continuous Galerkin (CG) formulation enforcing C0 displacement continuity across interfaces.
Discontinuous Galerkin (DG) formulation with Nitsche's interior penalty method preserving normal continuity while allowing tangential slip.
Adjoint-free L2 waveform misfit minimisation using central finite differences for parameter-wise gradients.
基于FEniCS实现的二维时域弹性动力学有限元模拟。
强制界面C0位移连续性的连续伽辽金（CG）格式。
采用Nitsche内部罚函数方法的间断伽辽金（DG）格式，保持法向连续但允许切向滑移。
利用中心有限差分计算参数梯度的无伴随L2波形残差最小化反演。
de: 2D homogeneous background model (rho=3.5, mu=1.0, lambda=2.0) containing a circular inclusion (rho=7.0, mu=2.0, lambda=4.0) with a surface point source and 3 surface receivers.
Synthetic 'inversion crime' cross-test: observed waveforms generated by the non-welded DG solver and inverted by both CG and DG solvers over 12 iterations.
包含圆形夹杂体（rho=7.0, mu=2.0, lambda=4.0）的二维均匀背景模型（rho=3.5, mu=1.0, lambda=2.0），配有一个地表点源和3个地表接收器。
合成“反演犯罪”交叉测试：由非焊接DG求解器生成观测波形，分别使用CG和DG求解器进行12次迭代反演。
li: Restricted to a small-scale 2D geometry with a single circular inclusion and only 3 homogeneously parameterised inclusion values.
Inversion was stopped after 12 iterations before full convergence to the true parameters (mu and lambda remained stuck at initial values).
Uses central finite-difference gradients (requiring 2*Nm forward solves per iteration) rather than adjoint-state gradients, limiting scalability to 3D.
仅限于包含单个圆形夹杂体的小尺度二维几何模型，且仅反演夹杂体的3个集总参数。
反演在12次迭代后停止，尚未完全收敛至真实参数（剪切模量和拉梅常数停留在初始值）。
采用中心有限差分计算梯度（每次迭代需2*Nm次正演）而非伴随状态法，限制了向三维大尺度问题的扩展。

tm.why: The paper directly investigates parameter bias in elastic full-waveform inversion caused by interfacial continuity assumptions.
It implements and compares continuous Galerkin (CG) and Nitsche-based discontinuous Galerkin (DG) finite-element solvers in FEniCS for 2D elastodynamics.
It examines the 'inversion crime' where using an inconsistent forward operator introduces systematic bias into recovered physical parameters while lowering data misfit.

sum: Understanding fault creep evolution is vital for evaluating seismic hazard and stress release. The northern Aceh segment of the Sumatran Fault Zone actively creeps yet hosted a Mw 6.1 earthquake in 2013. Combining ALOS-1/2 InSAR and GNSS observations with Bayesian inversion and rate-and-state friction numerical models, the authors reveal that maximum creep rates along the Aceh segment decreased by ~60%, from ~22 mm/yr in 2007–2010 to ~9 mm/yr in 2017–2023. Modelling shows these observations reflect two distinct transient creep events: one triggered by long-range stress transfer (>150 km) from the 2004 Mw 9.2 megathrust earthquake, and a second re-acceleration driven by 2013 nearby continental earthquakes. Best-fitting models constrain the frictional parameter (a-b)σ to 0.03–0.04 MPa, an order of magnitude lower than typical continental faults. This emergent, nearly velocity-neutral Coulomb-like behaviour at the ~100 km scale enables long-range triggering, mixed-mode failure, and natural stress sensing.
本研究结合ALOS-1/2 InSAR与GNSS大地测量数据，利用贝叶斯反演和速率-状态摩擦数值模型，量化了2007至2023年间苏门答腊断层带北段亚齐断层的无震蠕滑时空演化。观测表明最大蠕滑速率从2007–2010年的约22 mm/yr下降约60%至2017–2023年的约9 mm/yr。数值模拟……

t: Bayesian slice-sampling inversion of postseismic-corrected ALOS-1/2 InSAR and GNSS fault-perpendicular profiles combined with a 2D plane-strain rate-and-state friction numerical afterslip model.
对扣除震后形变的InSAR与GNSS剖面进行贝叶斯反演，结合二维速率-状态摩擦数值模拟。
L-band SAR data from two ALOS-1 frames (2007–2010) and one ALOS-2 frame (2017–2023) integrated with SuGAr and BIG GNSS velocities in the Sunda reference frame.
2007–2010年ALOS-1与2017–2023年ALOS-2 L波段SAR数据及区域GNSS速度场。
Maximum fault creep rates decreased by ~60% from ~22 mm/yr (2007–2010) to ~9 mm/yr (2017–2023), explained by two transient events with frictional parameter (a-b)σ between 0.03 and 0.04 MPa.
最大蠕滑率从约22 mm/yr降至约9 mm/yr（降幅约60%），约束摩擦参数(a-b)σ为0.03–0.04 MPa…
The 2D model assumes uniform frictional properties along strike and depth, and lacks continuous near-fault GNSS or creepmeter time series to resolve rapid velocity steps.
模型假设摩擦属性空间均匀，且缺乏高采样率GNSS和蠕变仪数据以解析细微异质性。

Identifies emergent, nearly velocity-neutral Coulomb-like behaviour at the ~100 km segment scale, demonstrating long-range creep triggering (>150 km) and capability as a regional tectonic stress sensor.
揭示百公里尺度涌现的近速度中性（类库仑）摩擦行为，证实远场触发及断层应力计功能。

kc: Quantified decadal-scale fault creep evolution along the Aceh segment from 2007 to 2023 using L-band ALOS-1/2 InSAR integrated with GNSS and corrected for megathrust postseismic deformation.

Demonstrated via 2D rate-and-state friction modeling that observed creep represents two transient afterslip episodes triggered by the distant 2004 Mw 9.2 megathrust event and local 2013 Mw 6.1 earthquakes.

Constrained the segment-scale frictional parameter (a-b)σ to 0.03–0.04 MPa, revealing emergent near velocity-neutral (Coulomb-like) rheology that allows the fault to act as a natural regional stress sensor.

me: InSAR time-series processing using ISCE and MintPy with ionospheric split-spectrum correction, ERA-5 tropospheric delay removal, and integration with Sunda-frame GNSS velocities.
Postseismic deformation removal using viscoelastic and afterslip forward models of the 2004 Mw 9.2 and 2005 Mw 8.6 megathrust earthquakes.
Bayesian inversion via slice sampling of 12 fault-perpendicular LOS velocity profiles using elastic screw dislocation and back-slip models.
2D plane-strain rate-and-state friction numerical modeling of stress-driven afterslip using Okada coseismic Coulomb stress steps and grid search optimization.
使用ISCE和MintPy进行InSAR时间序列处理，包含电离层分裂光谱校正、ERA-5对流层延迟去除以及与巽他参考系GNSS速度场的融合。
利用2004年Mw 9.2和2005年Mw 8.6巨型逆冲地震的粘弹性松弛和震后滑移正演模型扣除震后形变。
基于弹性螺旋位错和回滑模型，采用切片采样贝叶斯反演方法拟合12条垂直断层剖面的LOS速度以估计蠕滑速率。
结合Okada同震库仑应力阶跃与网格搜索优化，开展应力驱动震后滑移的二维平面应变速率-状态摩擦数值模拟。
de: L-band SAR scenes from two ALOS-1 frames (2007–2010) and one ALOS-2 ScanSAR frame (2017–2023) covering northern Sumatra.
Continuous and campaign GPS/GNSS observations from the Sumatran GPS Array (SuGAr) and Geospatial Information Agency of Indonesia (BIG) networks.
Coseismic slip models and stress perturbation calculations for regional megathrust, oceanic, and continental earthquakes (2004, 2005, 2007, 2009, 2012, 2013, and 2016).
覆盖苏门答腊北部的两个ALOS-1图幅（2007–2010年）和一个ALOS-2图幅（2017–2023年）的L波段SAR卫星影像数据。
来自苏门答腊GPS阵列（SuGAr）和印度尼西亚地理空间信息局（BIG）管网的GNSS观测数据。
区域巨型逆冲、大洋及大陆地震（2004、2005、2007、2009、2012、2013和2016年）的同震滑移模型及应力扰动计算。
li: The numerical model assumes spatially uniform frictional properties along the creeping segment and depth, failing to capture fine-scale spatial heterogeneities.
Absence of high-resolution continuous GNSS and creepmeter time series directly on the fault prevents resolving rapid initial velocity steps and inverting for spatially variable friction.
Small stress perturbations (~20–40 kPa from the 2016 event) and negative stress steps (2012 event) fall below the geodetic detection noise floor of ALOS-2.
数值模型假设蠕滑段走向和深度上的摩擦属性空间均匀，未能完全重现观测数据中的精细空间复杂性。
缺乏断层近场高时间分辨率的GNSS和蠕变仪时间序列，无法分辨初始速度阶跃及反演空间可变的摩擦参数。
小幅应力扰动（如2016年地震产生的20–40 kPa）和负应力阶跃（2012年地震）低于ALOS-2大地测量噪声检测阈值。

tm.why: The paper investigates the spatio-temporal evolution of aseismic fault creep, rate-and-state friction mechanics, and stress-driven transient afterslip along the Aceh segment of the Sumatran Fault Zone.
The study discusses how mixed-mode fault segments hosting both creep and moderate earthquakes act as regional stress gauges, offering implications for seismic hazard assessment in Northern Sumatra.

sum: This study evaluates whether earthquake ground motions recorded at a single station can be reliably extrapolated to nearby locations (<3 km) using ~13 years of data (4038 ML 2.5+ events, 2010–2023) recorded across seven small-aperture arrays in southern California. Five arrays span the San Jacinto Fault Zone and two are located off-fault. After removing temporally overprinted events (≤5 km, ≤5 min), filtering between 0.5–25 Hz, enforcing SNR ≥ 2.5, and vetting statistical outliers against the Abrahamson et al. (2014) NGA-West2 GMPE, the authors analyze peak ground acceleration (PGA) and velocity (PGV). Fault-zone arrays consistently record ground motions exceeding empirical predictions and display 'M'-shaped spatial amplitude profiles across symmetrical low-velocity fault zones, whereas off-fault arrays match or fall below predictions. Intra-array coefficients of variation range from 26% to 38%, and stations within the same array frequently report different earthquakes as generating their maximum ground motion.

(2014) NGA-West2 empirical PGA/PGV predictions before computing intra-array coefficients of variation.

2010至2023年南加州4038个ML 2.5+地震在7个小孔径台阵（<3 km，5个跨断层、2个断层外）的三分量速度…

Fault-zone arrays record PGA and PGV above NGA-West2 empirical expectations and show 'M'-shaped cross-fault amplitude profiles, whereas off-fault arrays match or fall below expectations; intra-array coefficients of variation span 26% to 38% across all seven networks.
断层带台阵地震动高于经验预测且呈跨断层“M”型分布，断层外台阵符合或低于预期；各台阵内变异系数达26%–38%。

Broadband filtering (0.5–25 Hz) averages over frequency-dependent amplification, and nearby roadway traffic (~100 m) can corrupt weak signals from distant small earthquakes (>80 km) without failing SNR checks.
0.5–25 Hz宽频带滤波未细分频段依赖性，且距公路约100 m内的台站易受车辆噪声污染。

kc: Demonstrates that intra-array PGA and PGV coefficients of variation reach 26–38% even within footprints < 3 km, proving that spatial extrapolation over short distances carries large uncertainty.
Shows that fault-zone arrays systematically exceed NGA-West2 empirical ground-motion predictions, whereas off-fault arrays record motions at or below empirical expectations.
Identifies an 'M'-shaped spatial peak amplitude pattern across single-strand fault arrays (RA and JF), with reduced amplitudes in the fault core and elevated amplitudes along fault-zone edges.

Explains a cross-fault ground-motion dichotomy at the Blackburn Saddle (BB) array between an M3.08 and M3.63 earthquake as driven primarily by forward rupture directivity rather than magnitude error or radiation pattern.
证实在小于3 km的台阵孔径内，PGA和PGV的变异系数仍高达26–38%，表明短距离空间外推存在显著不确定性。

通过地震矩、震源机制辐射花样和方向性分析，阐明BB台阵两侧最大地震动事件的差异主要由M3.08事件的破裂前向方向性效应主导。

Waveform preprocessing using instrument response removal, 4th-order Butterworth bandpass filtering (0.5–25 Hz), SNR ≥ 2.5 thresholding, and 3-sigma outlier vetting against the ASK14 NGA-West2 GMPE.
Statistical evaluation of intra-array spatial variability using log(model/observed) distributions and per-event, per-channel coefficients of variation (COV = std/mean).
Spectral fitting of displacement spectra to a Brune omega-squared model and analytical double-couple S-wave radiation pattern modeling to isolate rupture directivity.
迭代剔除基础目录中时空邻近（≤5 km且≤5 min）的地震对，以消除波形叠加污染。

利用模型与观测比值的对数分布及单事件单通道变异系数（COV=标准差/均值）量化台阵内部空间变异性。

7个小孔径台阵（跨圣哈辛托断层的BB、DW、JF、RA、SG及断层外的PY、TR，孔径0.15–2.90 km）的200 sps三分量速度（HH*）与加速度（HN*）波形。
针对圣哈辛托断层上M3.08和M3.63两个地震事件，联合BB台阵7个台站及周边7个区域台站开展震源与场地效应专项分析。
li: Empirical NGA-West2 predictions were computed assuming a uniform reference rock condition (Vs30 ≈ 760 m/s) and extended to vertical components rather than using site-specific Vs30 measurements.
Broad 0.5–25 Hz filtering masks frequency-dependent amplification nuances, and the 25 Hz upper bandwidth limit prevents reliable corner frequency and stress drop estimation for M~3 events.
Stations located within ~100 m of roadways (e.g., in the RA array) suffer from vehicle traffic noise that can overprint small distant earthquakes (>80 km) without failing the SNR ≥ 2.5 test.
NGA-West2经验预测统一采用了参考基岩场地条件（Vs30 ≈ 760 m/s）并直接扩展至垂直分量，未使用各台站实测Vs30值。
较宽的滤波频带（0.5–25 Hz）掩盖了特定频段的放大细节，且25 Hz上限导致无法可靠约束M~3地震的拐角频率和应力降。
距公路约100 m以内的台站（如RA台阵部分台站）易受车辆交通噪声干扰，在远震小振幅记录中难以仅靠SNR阈值完全剔除。

tm.why: The paper evaluates spatial variability of peak ground acceleration (PGA) and peak ground velocity (PGV) across seven small-aperture arrays and compares them against NGA-West2 empirical ground-motion models.
The study analyzes recordings from seven small-aperture (<3 km) seismic arrays in southern California, including SNR-based station health and road-traffic noise diagnostics.

The authors perform detailed spectral moment, Brune corner-frequency, focal mechanism radiation pattern, and rupture directivity analyses to explain ground-motion asymmetry at the Blackburn Saddle array.

ev.notes: Full 20-page PDF read and analyzed, including all 10 main figures, equations, data preprocessing workflows, and detailed BB array directivity case study.

sum: This study introduces an unsupervised, physics-constrained variational autoencoder (VAE) framework for uncertainty quantification in single- and multiparameter full waveform inversion (FWI). Traditional supervised deep-learning UQ approaches require massive labeled training sets, whereas MCMC sampling is computationally prohibitive. Here, the encoder maps input seismic shot gathers to Gaussian latent distributions, and the decoder maps latent samples into velocity or elastic parameter models using Deep Image Prior regularization. At each epoch, decoded models are fed into a finite-difference wave-equation solver (Deepwave) to compute data misfit and adjoint FWI gradients, which are back-propagated to update network weights. Tested on synthetic 2D acoustic (Marmousi, SEAM) and elastic (toy, BP) benchmarks, the method recovers accurate mean models and spatially meaningful uncertainty maps (correlating with depth, illumination limits, and sharp interfaces) at a computational cost comparable to deterministic autoencoder FWI, though standard deviation magnitudes are underestimated.
本文提出一种无需标记数据预训练的物理约束变分自编码器（VAE）框架，用于单参数及多参数全波形反演（FWI）的不确定性量化。编码器将地震炮集映射至潜在空间高斯分布，解码器结合深度图像先验（DIP）生成速度或弹性参数模型。每轮迭代将解码模型输入有限差分波动方程求解器，计算数据残差与伴随FWI梯度并反向传……

t: An unsupervised convolutional VAE encodes shot gathers into a Gaussian latent space and decodes velocity models regularized by Deep Image Prior. Decoded models enter a finite-difference PDE solver, and adjoint FWI gradients are back-propagated to update network weights.
无监督卷积VAE将炮集编码至高斯潜在空间，结合DIP解码模型并耦合PDE求解器，反向传播伴随梯度更新网络。

Evaluated on four 2D synthetic seismic benchmarks using the Deepwave time-domain finite-difference solver: acoustic Marmousi (with AWGN at SNR = 1), acoustic SEAM salt model, an elastic inclusion toy model, and the multiparameter elastic BP salt model.
基于Deepwave在四个二维合成模型上验证：声波Marmousi（SNR=1）、SEAM模型，以及弹性波Toy和BP盐…

Drawing 1,000 posterior samples takes only seconds and yields accurate mean models and relative uncertainty maps matching MCMC spatial trends, though absolute standard deviations are underestimated (reaching at most 60 m/s versus 400 m/s error in Marmousi corners).
抽取1000个样本仅需数秒，均值模型准确且相对不确定性趋势与MCMC一致，但标准差绝对值偏低（60对比400 m/s）。

Uncertainty magnitudes are underestimated due to VAE posterior collapse and fixed-variance Gaussian assumptions; furthermore, elastic FWI still requires smooth initial models and hyperparameter sigma requires manual tuning.
因VAE后验坍塌及固定方差高斯假设低估不确定性幅值；弹性波反演仍依赖平滑初始模型，且超参数σ需人工调优。

Directly estimates single- and multiparameter FWI uncertainties via an unsupervised VAE constrained by back-propagated adjoint wavefield gradients and Deep Image Prior, completely eliminating pretraining on labeled model-data pairs.
将伴随FWI梯度与深度图像先验融入无监督VAE，无需标记数据预训练即可直接量化单参数与多参数FWI不确定性。

kc: Eliminates the need for pretraining on large labeled datasets by performing unsupervised variational inference directly during inversion.

Injects physics-based adjoint FWI gradients into neural network back-propagation at each iteration alongside Deep Image Prior regularization to accelerate convergence and improve model reconstruction.
Demonstrates accurate mean model recovery and spatially meaningful relative uncertainty maps on both 2D acoustic (Marmousi, SEAM) and multiparameter elastic (Vp, Vs, density) FWI benchmarks.
通过在反演过程中直接进行无监督变分推断，消除了对大规模标记数据集进行预训练的需求。
结合深度图像先验正则化，在每次迭代中将基于物理的伴随FWI梯度注入神经网络反向传播，从而加速收敛并提高重建质量。
在二维声波（Marmousi、SEAM）和多参数弹性波（Vp、Vs、密度）FWI基准测试中，验证了均值模型重建的准确性以及相对不确定性空间分布的有效性。
me: Convolutional Variational Autoencoder (VAE) mapping shot gathers to latent Gaussian distributions and decoding latent samples into subsurface parameter models.
Deep Image Prior (DIP) implicit regularization via randomly initialized convolutional/deconvolutional layers with LeakyReLU and output Sigmoid rescaling.
Coupling with the Deepwave time-domain finite-difference PDE solver to compute forward wavefields, L2 waveform misfit, and adjoint FWI gradients back-propagated via the chain rule.
Posterior sampling by drawing 1,000 latent samples from the trained network to compute parameter means and standard deviations within seconds.
构建卷积变分自编码器（VAE），将地震炮集映射至潜在空间高斯分布，并将采样向量解码为地下参数模型。
利用随机初始化的卷积/反卷积层、LeakyReLU激活函数及输出层Sigmoid重缩放，引入深度图像先验（DIP）隐式正则化。
耦合Deepwave时域有限差分PDE求解器计算正演波场、L2波形残差和伴随FWI梯度，并通过链式法则反向传播更新网络参数。
从训练好的潜在空间抽取1000个样本输入解码器，在数秒内完成均值和标准差的后验统计计算。
de: Acoustic FWI on the 2D Marmousi model (150 x 500 grid, 20 m spacing, 8 Hz Ricker wavelet, 24 shots, 240 receivers) under severe additive white Gaussian noise (SNR = 1).
Acoustic FWI on the 2D SEAM salt model (150 x 250 grid, 10 m spacing, 15 Hz Ricker, 20 shots, 250 receivers) testing sensitivity to likelihood standard deviation hyperparameter (sigma = 1 vs 10).
Multiparameter elastic FWI (Vp, Vs, rho) on a 2D homogeneous toy model with three spatially distinct rectangular inclusions (30 x 100 grid, 4 m spacing, 15 Hz Ricker).

Multiparameter elastic FWI on the 2D BP salt model (150 x 250 grid, 10 m spacing, 5 Hz Ricker, 24 shots, 240 receivers) starting from smooth initial models, plus a comparison against MCMC on Marmousi.
二维Marmousi模型声波FWI实验（150×500网格，20米间距，8 Hz雷克子波，24炮，240道），测试强高斯白噪声（信噪比SNR=1）下的鲁棒性。
二维SEAM盐丘模型声波FWI实验（150×250网格，10米间距，15 Hz子波，20炮，250道），分析似然方差超参数（σ=1与10）的敏感性。
含三个不同位置矩形异常体的二维均匀背景Toy模型多参数弹性波FWI实验（反演Vp、Vs和密度，30×100网格，4米间距，15 Hz子波）。
二维BP盐丘弹性模型多参数弹性波FWI实验（150×250网格，10米间距，5 Hz子波，采用平滑初始模型），并与Marmousi模型的常规MCMC结果进行归一化对比。
li: Underestimates the absolute magnitude of uncertainty (e.g., max 60 m/s standard deviation vs 400 m/s absolute error in Marmousi lower corners) due to VAE posterior collapse and fixed-sigma Gaussian assumptions.
Sensitive to the choice of the likelihood variance hyperparameter sigma, which requires problem-dependent manual tuning.
Multiparameter elastic FWI still requires smooth, accurate initial velocity and density models rather than random initialization due to stronger nonlinearity and parameter cross-talk.
Evaluated only on 2D synthetic data with additive white Gaussian noise; real field data with coherent noise, irregular acquisition, and unmodeled physics remain untested.
受VAE后验坍塌倾向及固定方差高斯假设限制，低估了不确定性的绝对幅值（如Marmousi模型底角标准差最大60 m/s，而绝对误差达400 m/s）。
结果对近似似然方差超参数σ较为敏感，需根据具体问题和数据置信度进行人工调优。
受强非线性与多参数串扰影响，多参数弹性波FWI仍需平滑准确的初始模型，无法像声波那样仅靠随机初始化收敛。
仅在含高斯白噪声的二维合成数据上进行了验证，尚未在含相干噪声、非规则采集及未建模物理效应的实际野外观测数据上测试。

tm.why: The paper develops an unsupervised variational autoencoder coupled with finite-difference wave equation solvers and adjoint gradients to perform single- and multiparameter acoustic and elastic full-waveform inversion.
The core goal is variational Bayesian inference to quantify subsurface velocity and elastic parameter uncertainties in FWI by sampling from a learned latent space.
The framework employs a convolutional variational autoencoder incorporating Deep Image Prior principles to map seismic shot gathers to subsurface velocity models without pretraining.

ev.notes: Full 15-page PDF examined in detail, including mathematical formulations in Section 2, all four acoustic and elastic numerical benchmarks in Section 3, discussion of posterior collapse and MCMC comparison in Section 4, and all 12 figures.

sum: This study investigates the 3D crustal structure of the seismically active Samakhiali Basin in the Kachchh rift basin, India, using receiver function data from 67 stations. By applying Bayesian velocity-depth inversion and common conversion point (CCP) stacking, the authors characterize the crustal properties in the source zone of the 2001 Mw 7.7 Bhuj earthquake. The results reveal a thick crust (42–45 km) indicating underplating, a 1.5–2.5 km thick sedimentary layer overlying a granitic basement, and an undulating intracrustal low-velocity zone (LVZ) at 18–26 km depth. Despite the LVZ, seismicity extends into the lower crust, suggesting complex fluid or compositional heterogeneities. The novelty lies in providing the first high-resolution 3D crustal model of this highly active rift basin using dense array receiver functions and probabilistic inversion.
本研究利用67个地震台站的接收函数数据，对印度卡奇裂谷萨马希亚利盆地的三维地壳结构进行了成像。通过贝叶斯速度-深度反演和共转换点（CCP）叠加，揭示了2001年Bhuj Mw 7.7地震震源区的地壳特征。结果表明，该区地壳较厚（42-45 km），存在底侵作用；1.5-2.5 km厚的沉积层覆盖在花……

t: Bayesian velocity-depth inversion of receiver functions combined with common conversion point (CCP) stacking to image 3D crustal structure.
结合共转换点叠加的接收函数贝叶斯反演，用于成像三维地壳结构。
Receiver function data from 50 closely spaced Kachchh array stations and 17 nearby permanent stations in Gujarat, India.
来自印度古吉拉特邦卡奇台阵50个密集台站和17个周边固定台站的接收函数数据。
Revealed a 42–45 km thick crust with underplating, a 1.5–2.5 km sedimentary layer, and an undulating 5–8 km thick intracrustal low-velocity zone at 18–26 km depth.
揭示了厚42-45km且存在底侵的地壳、沉积层以及18-26km深度的中地壳低速带。
Resolution of absolute velocities and trade-offs between velocity and interface depth inherent to receiver function analysis.
接收函数分析中固有的绝对速度分辨率不足以及速度与深度的折衷。
First high-resolution 3D crustal structure of the Samakhiali Basin using a dense array and probabilistic Bayesian inversion to characterize the seismogenic zone.
首次利用密集台阵和概率贝叶斯反演获得该发震带的高分辨率三维地壳结构。

kc: Determined the 3D crustal structure of the seismically active Samakhiali Basin and surrounding areas using dense receiver function data.
Identified a thick crust (42–45 km) beneath the basin, suggesting underplating processes.
Mapped an undulating intracrustal low-velocity zone (LVZ) at depths of 18–26 km.
利用高密度接收函数数据确定了活跃的萨马希亚利盆地及其周边地区的三维地壳结构。
识别出盆地下方较厚的地壳（42-45 km），表明存在底侵作用。
绘制了深度在18-26 km之间的起伏中地壳低速带（LVZ）。

Bayesian velocity-depth inversion to estimate crustal thickness, S-wave velocity, and Vp/Vs ratio.
Common conversion point (CCP) stacking along and across the study area.
远震地震波形的接收函数分析。
用于估计地壳厚度、S波速度和Vp/Vs比的贝叶斯速度-深度反演。
沿研究区及横跨研究区的共转换点（CCP）叠加。

Data from 17 nearby permanent seismic stations.
来自卡奇台阵网络的50个密集地震台站的接收函数数据。
来自周边17个固定地震台站的数据。

Lack of direct resolution on the exact fluid or compositional nature of the identified low-velocity zone.

tm.why: The study uses receiver function data from 67 stations to image the 3D crustal structure and discontinuities.
The paper investigates the 3D crustal thickness, sedimentary layers, and intracrustal low-velocity zones of the Kachchh rift basin.

sum: Generating large ensembles of earthquake-to-tsunami waveforms via repeated 3D PDE simulations is prohibitively expensive for data-driven tsunami early warning. This paper exploits the linear time-invariant structure of elastodynamic and ocean acoustic-gravity wave equations to precompute subfault elastic Green's functions (via the frequency-wavenumber method) and observation-point acoustic-gravity adjoint responses. The complete source-to-waveform map is formulated as two consecutive block lower-triangular Toeplitz matrix-vector multiplications, evaluated in the frequency domain using the distributed GPU library FFTMatvec. By partitioning the 2,416,530 seafloor grid points across GPUs, intermediate seafloor displacements remain resident on-device without external storage. Applied to a full-scale Cascadia Subduction Zone model (963 subfaults, 64 offshore sensors, 256 timesteps, requiring 9.45 TiB GPU memory), the pipeline evaluates a single rupture in 24 ms on 64 NVIDIA GB200 GPUs (21.8x faster than a PyTorch time-domain baseline), enabling 10,000 rupture scenarios to be simulated in 4 minutes.
针对数据驱动的海啸预警需求，本文利用弹性动力学与海洋声重力波方程的线性时不变特性，预计算了断层弹性格林函数与海底观测点的声重力伴随响应，将震源到海啸波形的映射简化为两个连续的块下三角Toeplitz矩阵向量乘法。通过分布式多GPU的FFTMatvec算法在频域加速卷积，并将241.6万个海底网格点分……

t: Precomputes subfault elastic Green's functions and observation acoustic-gravity adjoint responses, formulating the source-to-waveform map as two consecutive block lower-triangular Toeplitz matrix-vector multiplications evaluated via distributed multi-GPU FFTs.
预计算弹性格林函数与声重力伴随响应，利用分布式多GPU的FFT计算两个连续的块Toeplitz矩阵向量乘法。

Applied to FakeQuakes stochastic ruptures on the Cascadia Subduction Zone with 963 triangular subfaults, 2,416,530 seafloor grid points at 300 m resolution, 64 observation locations, and 256 one-second timesteps.
应用于卡斯卡迪亚俯冲带963个子断层、241.6万个海底网格点、64个观测点及256个时间步。
On 64 NVIDIA GB200 GPUs (requiring 9.45 TiB aggregate memory), the pipeline evaluates one rupture in 24 ms, achieving a 21.8x speedup over PyTorch and evaluating 10,000 ruptures in 4 minutes.

Developed a distributed multi-GPU FFT-based convolution pipeline that keeps the massive intermediate seafloor displacement field resident on-device across GPUs.

Demonstrated full-scale application on the Cascadia Subduction Zone (9.45 TiB resident state across 64 GB200 GPUs), achieving 24 ms per rupture and a 21.8x speedup over a distributed PyTorch baseline.

开发了分布式多GPU的FFT卷积计算管线，使庞大的中间海底位移场始终驻留在GPU显存中。

Precomputation of ocean acoustic-gravity impulse responses using adjoint PDE solves from offshore observation locations.
Block lower-triangular Toeplitz (BLTT) operator representation and frequency-domain diagonalization via block-circulant embedding and FFTs (FFTMatvec).
Complementary row-and-column spatial partitioning of the seafloor grid across GPUs to avoid communicating or storing the intermediate space-time seafloor field.

从近海观测点位置出发，利用伴随偏微分方程求解预计算海洋声重力脉冲响应。

tm.why: The paper develops a distributed multi-GPU, FFT-accelerated convolution pipeline on 64 GB200 GPUs to rapidly evaluate elastodynamic and acoustic-gravity wave responses.
It models kinematic earthquake ruptures on 963 subfaults in the Cascadia Subduction Zone and maps slip-rate functions to seafloor displacements and tsunami waveforms.
The workflow directly targets rapid ensemble generation for data-driven earthquake and tsunami early warning and hazard forecasting in Cascadia.

ev.notes: Full 8-page PDF provided and analyzed, including equations, algorithms, tables, and figures.

sum: Automated seismic stratigraphic interpretation of shelf-edge clinothems is hindered by the scarcity of large-scale, realistic benchmark datasets with reliable geological labels. To address this, the authors construct and publicly release a hybrid benchmark dataset containing 3,000 unlabeled 2D field seismic profiles curated from global sedimentary basins (e.g., North Sea, Australia, New Zealand, Gulf of Mexico) and 4,000 labeled 2D synthetic seismic images. The synthetic dataset is generated via a three-step workflow: stratigraphic forward modeling using a landscape evolution model, post-depositional structural deformation (faulting and folding), and geophysical forward modeling, providing dense relative geologic time (RGT) labels. Evaluations using four baseline deep learning architectures (U-Net, HRNet, LocalBins, and GLP) demonstrate that models trained on this dataset accurately extract stratigraphic iso-surfaces on field data, with transformer-based networks outperforming standard CNNs across complex clinothem geometries and discontinuities.
针对陆架边缘斜层体自动地震地层解释缺乏大规模基准数据集的问题，本文构建并公开了一个混合基准数据集。通过从全球多个沉积盆地收集、筛选与标准化处理，获得了3000个无标签2D实际地震剖面；同时采用地层正演模拟、构造变形（断层和褶皱）及地球物理正演三步工作流，生成了4000个带有密集相对地质年代（RGT）……

t: The authors combine systematic field data curation (collection, cropping, slicing, normalization) with a three-step synthetic forward modeling workflow (stratigraphic simulation via landscape evolution, structural faulting/folding, and convolutional seismic modeling) to build training datasets for RGT regression.
结合系统化的实际数据筛选处理工作流与地层模拟、构造变形、地球物理正演三步合成工作流构建数据集。

The dataset comprises 3,000 unlabeled 2D field seismic profiles curated from public repositories across global basins (North Sea, Australia, New Zealand, North America) and 4,000 synthetic 2D seismic profiles with dense RGT labels spanning 1–4 sea-level cycles.
包含来自全球多个沉积盆地的3000个无标签2D实际地震剖面和4000个带RGT标签的2D合成剖面。

Baseline evaluations using U-Net, HRNet, LocalBins, and GLP show strong alignment between extracted RGT iso-surfaces and field seismic reflectors, with transformer-based networks (GLP, LocalBins) and multi-scale HRNet outperforming standard convolutional U-Net.
基线模型提取的等时面与实际同相轴高度吻合，基于Transformer的GLP、LocalBins及HRNet表现优于U-…

Fine-scale weak stratigraphic fittings persist in local regions featuring stratigraphic pinch-outs, unconformities, low signal-to-noise ratios, and complex tectonic structures, and the field dataset lacks ground-truth RGT labels.
实际数据缺乏真实标签，且模型在地层尖灭、不整合面、低信噪比及复杂构造区拟合较弱。

This work introduces the first massive-scale hybrid benchmark dataset specifically tailored for shelf-edge clinothems, combining diverse unlabeled multi-basin field seismic profiles with geologically realistic RGT-labeled synthetic seismic data.
发布了首个专门针对全球陆架边缘斜层体的大规模实际无标签与合成有标签混合地震基准数据集。

Generated 4,000 synthetic seismic profiles with dense Relative Geologic Time (RGT) labels via a three-step stratigraphic, structural, and geophysical forward modeling workflow.
Benchmarked four representative deep learning models (U-Net, HRNet, LocalBins, GLP) for automated RGT estimation and publicly released the dataset and code.
收集并整理了来自全球多个代表性沉积盆地的3000个涵盖多样斜层体几何形态的无标签2D实际地震剖面。
通过地层正演、构造变形和地球物理正演三步工作流，生成了4000个带有密集相对地质年代（RGT）标签的合成地震剖面。
评估了四个代表性深度学习基线模型（U-Net、HRNet、LocalBins、GLP）在自动RGT估计中的表现，并开源了数据集和代码。

Three-step synthetic modeling: landscape evolution stratigraphic modeling (pyBadlands), structural deformation (faults and folds), and wavelet-convolution geophysical modeling.
Supervised deep learning evaluation for continuous Relative Geologic Time (RGT) regression using U-Net, HRNet, LocalBins, and GLP architectures.
实际地震数据整理工作流：从公共数据库收集、人工筛选裁剪、3D切2D剖面、重采样及均值-方差归一化。
三步合成建模工作流：景观演化地层正演模拟（pyBadlands）、构造变形模拟（断层与褶皱）以及子波褶积地球物理正演。

4,000 synthetic 2D seismic profiles and RGT labels simulated across 1 to 4 third-order sea-level cycles.
Qualitative and visual evaluation of RGT iso-surface predictions on six diverse field seismic profiles across four deep learning baseline models.
从北海、澳大利亚、新西兰、阿拉斯加和墨西哥湾等盆地的600多个3D数据体和2000多条2D测线中筛选出3000个无标签2D实际地震剖面。

在6个代表性实际地震剖面上对比了四种深度学习基线模型的RGT预测与等时面提取效果。

The target of the dataset is shelf-edge clinothems in sedimentary basins, which record tectonic evolution, basin filling, and depositional dynamics.

sum: Reproducible multi-parameter indicators of crustal stress accumulation prior to large earthquakes remain elusive. This study investigates the temporal co-evolution of seismic Gutenberg–Richter b-values, seismic entropy, and Swarm satellite vector magnetic field anomalies across six Mw ≥ 6 earthquakes on the Iranian Plateau (2014–2025). Using the Iranian Seismological Center catalog and STA/LTA anomaly detection on geomagnetically quiet satellite orbits within 300 km of each epicenter, the authors demonstrate that pre-earthquake decreases in b-value and rising entropy systematically align with increased ionospheric magnetic anomaly counts. For border-zone earthquakes suffering from network incompleteness, applying the b-positive (b+) estimator successfully stabilizes the time series and preserves the correlation. The novelty lies in the first systematic quantitative demonstration of coupled stress-electromagnetic evolution in Iran, supporting lithosphere–atmosphere–ionosphere coupling (LAIC) as a physically grounded framework for probabilistic seismic hazard monitoring.
本研究结合Swarm卫星矢量磁场数据与伊朗地震中心目录，分析了2014至2025年间伊朗高原6次Mw≥6级地震前的多参数协同演化。方法上利用最大似然法和针对边境目录不完整性的b+估计器计算b值与地震熵，并通过一阶导数、三次样条拟合及STA/LTA算法提取磁静日300公里内的电离层磁异常。结果表明，作……

t: Combines ZMAP maximum-likelihood and b+ magnitude-difference estimators for seismic b-values with cubic-spline detrending and STA/LTA triggering (STA=5s, LTA=20s, threshold=3) on geomagnetically quiet Swarm vector magnetic field data.
结合ZMAP最大似然法与b+估计器计算b值，利用三次样条去趋势和STA/LTA算法检测磁静日Swarm卫星磁异常。
Swarm Alpha, Bravo, and Charlie 1 Hz vector magnetic field observations and Iranian Seismological Center earthquake catalogs within 300 km of six Mw ≥ 6 Iranian earthquakes (2014–2025).
2014–2025年伊朗6次Mw≥6地震震中300公里内的Swarm卫星1 Hz矢量磁场数据与IRSC地震目录。
Decreasing b-values and increasing entropy significantly correlate with elevated magnetic anomaly numbers across events (e.g., Hojedk PCC = -0.70, SCC = -0.72 for Swarm Alpha, FDR q = 0.00024).
震前b值下降和熵增与磁异常数量增加呈显著负相关（如Hojedk地震Alpha卫星PCC=-0.70，q=0.00024）…

Cannot completely disentangle non-seismic ionospheric variability (moderate solar activity, atmospheric tides), suffers from intermittent satellite orbits, and is regionally restricted to six earthquakes in Iran.
难以完全剥离非地震电离层扰动，卫星覆盖间歇，且仅限于伊朗高原6个震例。

First systematic investigation demonstrating statistical co-evolution of seismic b-values, entropy, and Swarm ionospheric magnetic anomalies across the Iranian Plateau, incorporating the b+ estimator for incomplete border catalogs.
首次系统证实伊朗高原震前b值、熵与卫星磁异常协同演化，并引入b+解决边境目录不完整性。

kc: Demonstrated systematic temporal co-evolution between decreasing seismic b-values, rising entropy, and enhanced Swarm ionospheric magnetic anomalies prior to six Mw ≥ 6 Iranian earthquakes.
Applied the b-positive (b+) estimator to overcome seismic catalog incompleteness in border regions (Azgeleh and Sefidsang), restoring realistic stress-proxy time series.
Established rigorous statistical significance across multiple satellites and events using Pearson/Spearman correlations adjusted for false discovery rate (Benjamini-Hochberg procedure).
证实了伊朗高原6次Mw≥6地震前地震b值下降、熵增与Swarm卫星电离层磁异常增强之间存在系统的时间协同演化。
应用b+估计器克服了边境地区（Azgeleh和Sefidsang地震）地震目录的不完整性，恢复了物理一致的应力代理时间序列。
利用经错误发现率（Benjamini-Hochberg方法）校正的Pearson和Spearman相关系数，在多颗卫星和多个震例间确立了严格的统计显著性。
me: Extracted orbital residuals from 1 Hz Swarm vector magnetic field data (X, Y, Z) using first-time derivatives and 6-second cubic-spline fitting within 300 km of epicenters.

Detected transient magnetic anomalies using an STA/LTA algorithm (STA=5 s, LTA=20 s, threshold=3, amplitude ≥ 0.3 nT, duration ≥ 10 s) filtered for geomagnetically quiet conditions (Kp ≤ 3, |Dst| ≤ 20 nT, F10.7 ≤ 150).

Computed sliding-window Gutenberg-Richter b-values and Shannon entropy from Reasenberg-declustered seismic catalogs using ZMAP maximum likelihood estimation and the b+ positive magnitude-difference estimator.
利用一阶时间导数和6秒节点三次样条拟合，从震中300公里内1 Hz采样率的Swarm三分量矢量磁场数据中提取轨道残差。
在磁静日条件下（Kp≤3，|Dst|≤20 nT，F10.7≤150），采用STA/LTA算法（STA=5s，LTA=20s，阈值=3，振幅≥0.3 nT，持续时间≥10s）检测瞬态磁异常。
对经Reasenberg方法去丛集后的地震目录，利用ZMAP最大似然法和基于正震级差的b+估计器计算滑动窗Gutenberg-Richter b值与香农熵。
de: Three-component 1 Hz Level 1-b vector magnetic field data from ESA Swarm Alpha, Bravo, and Charlie satellites from 1 year before to 1 month after each mainshock.
Regional earthquake catalogs from the Iranian Seismological Center (IRSC) spanning 2 years before to 1 year after six Mw ≥ 6 mainshocks (2014–2025) within a 300 km radius.
Geomagnetic and solar activity indices (Kp, Dst, F10.7) from GFZ Potsdam and NOAA to exclude external space-weather disturbances.
欧空局Swarm Alpha、Bravo和Charlie三颗卫星在每次主震前1年至震后1个月的1 Hz Level 1-b三分量矢量磁场数据。
伊朗地震中心（IRSC）提供的2014–2025年间6次Mw≥6主震震中300公里范围内、震前2年至震后1年的区域地震目录。
来自德国地学研究中心（GFZ）和美国国家海洋和大气管理局（NOAA）的Kp、Dst和F10.7地磁与太阳活动指数。
li: Non-seismic ionospheric variability from moderate solar activity, atmospheric tides, and planetary waves cannot be completely disentangled from tectonic signals.
Swarm satellites provide intermittent spatial-temporal coverage over a given 300 km epicentral region, and the STA/LTA threshold may miss very low-amplitude magnetic signals.
The study is regionally restricted to six Mw ≥ 6 earthquakes on the Iranian Plateau, limiting immediate statistical generalization to other tectonic regimes.
无法完全将中等太阳活动、大气潮汐和行星波动力学引起的非地震电离层变化与构造信号分离。
Swarm卫星对特定300公里震中区域的时空覆盖是间歇性的，且STA/LTA阈值可能会遗漏极低振幅的早期磁信号。
研究样本在区域上仅限于伊朗高原的6次Mw≥6级地震，限制了观测模式向其他构造环境的直接统计推广。

tm.why: The paper extensively analyzes earthquake catalogs, magnitude of completeness, Reasenberg declustering, Gutenberg-Richter b-values, and the b-positive estimator for border-zone events.
The study investigates crustal differential stress accumulation, earthquake preparation processes, and microfracturing proxies preceding large mainshocks.
The authors propose a multi-parameter framework combining b-values and ionospheric anomalies to identify periods of elevated earthquake probability for seismic hazard evaluation.

sum: This study introduces the Volcanic-Lamb-IoT Framework, which utilizes crowdsourced Netatmo weather station networks in Japan to detect and analyze volcanic atmospheric Lamb waves. By analyzing data from two 2018 eruptions (Mt. Kusatsu-Shirane and Mt. Shinmoedake), the framework applies TDOA regression, slowness beamforming, and acoustic energy flux integrals to estimate wave propagation velocities, back-azimuths, and total radiated acoustic energy (blast yields). The method successfully distinguishes volcanic signals from meteorological noise, demonstrating the potential of dense IoT sensor meshes for planetary-scale geophysical monitoring.

结合二维可压缩兰姆波方程、TDOA回归、慢度延迟相加波束形成和声能通量积分。

Reconstructed wave velocities (304-313 m/s), inverted crater back-azimuths with sub-degree errors, and isolated radiated acoustic energies (7.48e11 J vs 4.36e12 J).
重建了波速（304-313 m/s），反演了火山口方位角，并估算了辐射声能。
Potential calibration inconsistencies and data gaps inherent in crowdsourced IoT weather networks compared to professional scientific arrays.
与专业台网相比，众包物联网网络存在潜在的校准不一致和数据缺失。
First comprehensive geophysical framework utilizing ultra-dense crowdsourced IoT weather networks to quantitatively analyze volcanic Lamb waves and blast yields.
首次利用超高密度众包物联网气象网络定量分析火山兰姆波的地球物理框架。

Successfully reconstructed apparent wave propagation velocities and back-azimuths for two contrasting 2018 Japanese eruptions.
Quantified total radiated acoustic energy (blast yields) for phreatic and magmatic eruptions using dense IoT pressure data.
开发了Volcanic-Lamb-IoT框架，利用众包气象站数据进行火山大气波分析。
成功重建了2018年日本两次不同类型喷发事件的视传播速度和反方位角。
利用高密度物联网气压数据量化了蒸汽喷发和岩浆喷发的总辐射声能（爆炸当量）。

Time-Difference-of-Arrival (TDOA) reduced travel-time regression.
Slowness delay-and-sum beamforming.
Acoustic energy flux integrals.

到达时间差（TDOA）约化走时回归。
慢度延迟相加波束形成。
声能通量积分。

Two volcanic events: January 23, 2018 phreatic explosion of Mt. Kusatsu-Shirane and March 6, 2018 explosive magmatic eruption of Mt. Shinmoedake.
Negative control testing against quiet winter baselines and severe synoptic windstorms.
来自日本691个以上Netatmo物联网气象站的连续±12小时气压和温度数据（共29,334条记录）。
两次火山事件：2018年1月23日草津白根山蒸汽喷发和2018年3月6日新燃岳爆发性岩浆喷发。

Atmospheric propagation is highly sensitive to local meteorological conditions and wind profiles, which can complicate wave modeling.

大气传播对局部气象条件和风廓线高度敏感，这可能会增加波动模拟的复杂性。
