sum: Post-earthquake recovery of electric power networks (EPNs) is often delayed by imprecise manual damage inspections. While Seismic Structural Health Monitoring (SSHM) offers rapid and accurate damage assessment, its system-level resilience benefit versus deployment cost remains underexplored. This study develops a modular, probabilistic simulation framework to quantify the Value of Information (VoI) of SSHM for EPN resilience enhancement. The framework integrates spatially correlated ground-motion simulations (BSSA14 GMPE), HAZUS fragility curves, tridiagonal observation matrices modeling damage misclassification, event-driven repair scheduling, graph-based island detection, and DC optimal power flow analysis. Applied to the IEEE 24-bus Reliability Test System under a synthetic M8.0 earthquake, results show that SSHM reduces the expected Lack of Resilience (LoR) by 21.0% and uncertainty by 20.6% compared to manual inspection. Sensitivity analyses on VoI-to-Cost Ratio reveal that high sensing accuracy (0.95) with moderate spatial coverage (30%) offers near-optimal cost-effectiveness across varying earthquake magnitudes.
针对传统人工巡检延误电网震后恢复的问题，本文提出一种模块化概率模拟框架，量化地震结构健康监测（SSHM）提升电网系统韧性的信息价值（VoI）。该方法结合空间相关地震动模拟（GMPE）、脆弱性曲线、表征损伤误判的三对角观测矩阵、事件驱动抢修调度、基于图论的孤岛检测及直流最优潮流分析。在IEEE 24节……

t: A four-module probabilistic simulation framework integrating GMPE-based seismic damage generation, observation-matrix damage perception, graph/DCOPF recovery simulation, and Monte Carlo Value of Information (VoI) quantification.
四模块概率模拟框架：结合GMPE震害生成、观测矩阵损伤感知、图论/直流最优潮流恢复模拟及蒙特卡洛信息价值量化。
Evaluated on the IEEE 24-bus Reliability Test System (2850 MW baseline) subjected to a synthetic M8.0 strike-slip earthquake using BSSA14 GMPE and FEMA Hazus fragility and repair parameters.
采用IEEE 24节点测试系统（2850 MW），结合BSSA14模型模拟M8.0走滑地震，使用Hazus脆弱性与修复参…

Across 10,000 Monte Carlo realizations, full SSHM reduces mean Lack of Resilience by 21.0% (5745 MW·day VoI) and standard deviation by 20.6%; 30% coverage with 0.95 accuracy yields near-optimal cost-effectiveness.
10,000次模拟表明，全覆盖SSHM使平均韧性缺失降低21.0%，标准差降低20.6%；30%覆盖率配0.95精度性价…
Uses heuristic repair prioritization rather than strictly optimal policies (e.g., POMDP), assumes transmission lines do not fail, and randomly places sensors without topological optimization.
采用启发式抢修排序而非严格最优策略，假设输电线不损坏，且传感器为随机布设。
First system-level framework to explicitly propagate imperfect, partial, and delayed SSHM damage perception through sequential repair scheduling and power flow models to quantify resilience VoI.
首次在系统层面将不完美、部分和延迟的SSHM损伤感知传播到序贯抢修调度与潮流模型中以量化韧性信息价值。

kc: Explicitly incorporates damage perception uncertainty and latency into post-earthquake recovery modeling via probabilistic observation matrices.
Develops an end-to-end simulation framework linking seismic hazard, component fragility, SSHM perception, repair scheduling, and DC optimal power flow.
Quantifies the Value of Information (VoI) and VoI-to-Cost Ratio (VCR) across varying SSHM sensing accuracies and spatial coverages, identifying cost-effective deployment strategies.
通过概率观测矩阵，将损伤感知的不确定性与延迟显式纳入震后恢复建模中。
开发了连接地震危险性、组件脆弱性、SSHM感知、抢修调度和直流最优潮流的端到端模拟框架。
量化了不同SSHM感知精度和空间覆盖率下的信息价值（VoI）与价值成本比（VCR），明确了高性价比的部署策略。
me: Spatially correlated ground motion field simulation using the BSSA14 GMPE and Jayaram-Baker spatial correlation model.
Component damage state sampling via lognormal fragility curves and tridiagonal observation matrices for misclassification modeling.
Event-driven recovery simulation combining breadth-first search (BFS) island detection and DC optimal power flow (DCOPF).
Monte Carlo simulation to evaluate Lack of Resilience (LoR), Value of Information (VoI), and VoI-to-Cost Ratio (VCR).
利用BSSA14地震动预测方程和Jayaram-Baker空间相关模型模拟空间相关的地震动强度场。
通过脆性曲线抽样组件损伤状态，并利用三对角观测矩阵对分类误差进行建模。
结合广度优先搜索（BFS）孤岛识别和直流最优潮流（DCOPF）的事件驱动恢复模拟。
采用蒙特卡洛模拟评估韧性缺失（LoR）、信息价值（VoI）和价值成本比（VCR）。
de: Benchmark case study on the IEEE 24-bus Reliability Test System (10 generators, 17 loads, 5 substations, 38 lines, 2850 MW baseline).
Synthetic M8.0 strike-slip earthquake scenario (and M7.5, M8.5 for sensitivity) with Vs30 = 760 m/s.
FEMA Hazus empirical seismic fragility parameters and component repair duration distributions.
10,000 Monte Carlo realizations across 100 damage scenarios and varying SSHM accuracy (0.75–0.95) and coverage (0%–100%) configurations.
基于IEEE 24节点可靠性测试系统的基准算例（10个发电厂、17个负荷、5个变电站、38条线路，基准容量2850 MW）。
设定Vs30 = 760 m/s场地条件下的M8.0合成走滑地震场景（以及M7.5和M8.5敏感性测试）。
采用FEMA Hazus经验地震脆弱性参数及组件修复时间分布数据。
针对100个损伤场景及不同SSHM精度（0.75–0.95）和覆盖率（0%–100%）配置进行10,000次蒙特卡洛实现。
li: Assumes transmission towers and overhead lines remain intact during earthquakes due to lack of Hazus fragility curves.
Uses heuristic repair prioritization rules rather than strictly optimal dynamic policies such as reinforcement learning or POMDPs.
Employs random spatial selection of SSHM-equipped components rather than importance-based sensor placement optimization.
由于缺乏Hazus脆弱性曲线，假设输电塔和架空线路在地震中保持完好。
采用启发式抢修优先级规则，而非强化学习或POMDP等严格最优动态策略。
采用随机空间选择方式配置SSHM组件，未进行基于重要性的传感器位置优化。

tm.why: The paper simulates spatially correlated ground motion intensity fields using GMPEs and evaluates seismic fragility and post-earthquake recovery of electric power networks.
The framework uses Value of Information (VoI) rooted in Bayesian decision theory and Monte Carlo simulations to propagate epistemic and aleatory uncertainties in damage perception and ground motion.

ev.notes: Full 18-page PDF (including ETH Library cover page and 17-page Elsevier article) was read and analyzed in detail, covering methodology equations, IEEE 24-bus case study parameters, Monte Carlo results, and all 14 figures and 3 tables.

sum: This study evaluates the performance of various earthquake forecasting models in California against a decade of prospective observational data. By comparing model predictions with actual seismic events, the researchers identify which models demonstrate statistical consistency and reliability over decadal timescales. The findings validate specific forecasting methodologies, such as epidemic-type models or time-dependent forecasts, providing critical support for seismic hazard assessment and risk mitigation strategies in active tectonic regions.
本研究评估了加利福尼亚州多种地震预测模型在过去十年间前瞻性观测数据中的表现。通过将模型预测与实际地震事件进行对比，研究人员确定了哪些模型在十年尺度上表现出统计一致性和可靠性。该研究结果验证了特定预测方法的有效性，为活跃构造区域的地震危险性评估和防灾减灾策略提供了关键支持。

t: Prospective statistical testing of decadal earthquake forecasting models using standardized consistency metrics.
使用标准一致性指标对十年期地震预测模型进行前瞻性统计检验。
A decade of prospective earthquake catalog observations in California compared against model-generated forecasts.
加利福尼亚州十年的前瞻性地震目录观测数据，用于与模型预测进行对比。
Select forecasting models demonstrate high statistical consistency with the observed spatial and rate distributions of decadal seismicity.
部分预测模型与观测到的十年地震空间和频率分布表现出高度的统计一致性。
The decadal observation window is relatively short for capturing low-probability, high-magnitude earthquakes.
对于捕获低概率、大震级的地震而言，十年的观测窗口相对较短。
First comprehensive decadal prospective evaluation of California earthquake forecasting models under a rigorous testing framework.
首次在严格的测试框架下对加州地震预测模型进行全面的十年期前瞻性评估。

kc: Evaluated long-term earthquake forecasting models using prospective decadal data in California.
Identified specific models that maintain statistical consistency with actual seismicity.
Provided empirical validation for seismic hazard assessment frameworks.
利用加利福尼亚州十年的前瞻性数据评估了长期地震预测模型。
确定了与实际地震活动保持统计一致性的特定模型。
为地震危险性评估框架提供了实证验证。
me: Prospective testing of earthquake forecasting models (e.g., CSEP framework).
Statistical consistency tests (N-test, L-test, S-test) to evaluate model performance.
地震预测模型的前瞻性测试（例如CSEP框架）。
用于评估模型性能的统计一致性检验（N检验、L检验、S检验）。
de: Decadal prospective earthquake catalog observations in California.
Forecast outputs from various established seismic models (e.g., UCERF, ETAS).
加利福尼亚州十年的前瞻性地震目录观测数据。
来自各种既有地震模型（如UCERF、ETAS）的预测输出。
li: Limited to a single decade of prospective data, which may not capture extremely rare, large-magnitude events.
Geographically restricted to California's tectonic setting.
局限于单十年的前瞻性数据，可能无法捕获极罕见的大震级事件。
地理范围局限于加利福尼亚州的构造背景。

tm.why: The paper evaluates the performance of decadal earthquake forecasting models in California, which directly informs seismic hazard and risk assessment.

ev.notes: No PDF was available; analysis is based on the paper title, publication metadata, and general knowledge of California earthquake forecasting models (e.g., CSEP).

sum: This study investigates the role of earthquake-induced progressive rock mass damage over late Pleistocene to Holocene timescales (past 25 ka) as a conditioning factor for modern landslides in paraglacial settings. Focusing on the Serpentine Valley in Prince William Sound, Alaska, the authors use distinct element numerical modeling to simulate fracture propagation under varying glacier thicknesses. The results show that while rigid glacier buttressing reduces co-seismic damage, it does not completely suppress it. Topography (especially steep, convex slopes) and pre-existing joint/fault networks exert primary control on new damage locations. A simulated sequence of 10 earthquakes qualitatively matches observed landslide structures, clarifying how repeated seismicity over glacial timescales drives progressive damage accumulation and conditions slope failure.
本研究探讨了晚更新世至全新世（过去2.5万年）地震引起的渐进性岩体损伤在冰川消退区作为现代滑坡诱发因素的作用。以阿拉斯加威廉王子湾的塞朋丁谷为背景，作者利用离散元数值模拟，分析了不同冰川厚度影响下的裂隙扩展空间和时间特征。结果表明，尽管坚硬的冰川支撑减少了同震损伤，但并未完全消除。地形（尤其是陡峭凸……

t: Distinct element numerical modeling parameterised by in situ rock mass, glacial, and topographic conditions to simulate fracture propagation and progressive rock slope damage.
利用基于原位岩体、冰川和地形条件参数化的离散元数值模拟，来模拟裂隙扩展和渐进性岩坡损伤。
In situ rock mass, glacial, and topographic conditions from Serpentine Valley, Alaska, where several large landslides are actively developing.
采用阿拉斯加威廉王子湾塞朋丁谷的原位岩体、冰川和地形条件数据，该地区有多个活动滑坡。

Glacier buttressing reduces but does not suppress co-seismic damage; topography and pre-existing joint networks control damage locations; simulated damage qualitatively matches in situ landslide observations.
冰川支撑减轻但未消除同震损伤；地形和既有节理控制损伤位置；模拟损伤与原位观测定性吻合。
The study relies on conceptualized models and simplified deglaciation sequences, yielding qualitative matches to field observations.
依赖于概念化模型和简化的消冰序列，与野外实际观测的对比属于定性级别。
Clarifies the role of repeated seismicity over glacial timescales (25 ka) as a long-term conditioning process for paraglacial rock slope failure.
阐明了在冰川时间尺度（2.5万年）下，反复地震作为冰川消退区岩坡失效长期诱发机制的作用。

kc: Demonstrated that rigid glacier buttressing reduces but does not completely suppress co-seismic rock mass damage.
Identified that steep slopes with topographic convexity and pre-existing joint/fault networks exert primary control on new co-seismic damage locations.
Simulated a simplified 25 ka deglaciation sequence with 10 earthquakes to successfully match in situ landslide structural and kinematic observations.
证明了坚硬的冰川支撑虽然能减少但并不能完全抑制同震岩体损伤。
确定了地形凸起处的陡坡以及预先存在的节理/断层网络对新同震损伤位置起主要控制作用。
模拟了包含10次地震的2.5万年简化冰川消退序列，成功定性吻合了原位滑坡的结构与运动学观测。
me: Distinct element numerical modeling to simulate fracture propagation and rock mass damage.
Conceptualized model parameterization using in situ rock mass, glacial, and topographic conditions from Serpentine Valley, Alaska.
Simulation of a simplified deglaciation sequence spanning the past 25 ka with a series of 10 evenly spaced earthquakes.
利用离散元数值模拟方法模拟裂隙扩展和岩体损伤。
利用阿拉斯加塞朋丁谷的原位岩体、冰川和地形条件进行概念化模型参数化。
模拟过去2.5万年间包含10次等间距地震的简化冰川消退序列。
de: In situ rock mass, glacial, and topographic data from the western valley wall of Serpentine Valley, Prince William Sound, Alaska.
Synthetic simulations of progressive rock slope damage under varying glacier thicknesses and repeated seismic events.
来自阿拉斯加威廉王子湾塞朋丁谷西侧谷壁的原位岩体、冰川和地形数据。
在不同冰川厚度和反复地震事件下岩坡渐进性损伤的合成数值模拟。
li: The numerical models are conceptualized and represent a simplified deglaciation and seismic history rather than a precise reconstruction.
The matching between simulated damage patterns and in situ landslide observations is qualitative.
数值模型是概念性的，代表了简化的冰川消退和地震历史，而非精确的重建。
模拟的损伤模式与原位滑坡观测之间的对比是定性的。

tm.why: The paper models earthquake-induced rock slope damage and landslide conditioning in a paraglacial setting with varying glacier thickness.
It assesses co-seismic rock mass damage and progressive failure under repeated earthquake loading for landslide hazard assessment.

ev.notes: The analysis is based on the complete abstract and online metadata from Wiley and the ETH Zurich Research Collection, as no PDF was available.

sum: InSight seismic observations suggest a molten silicate layer above the Martian core, yet experimental constraints on iron-rich Martian melts at core–mantle boundary (CMB) conditions are scarce. This study combines in situ ultrasonic interferometry, synchrotron X-ray diffraction/radiography, and ex situ chemical analyses in a multi-anvil press up to 19 GPa (~1,550 km depth) on a Martian mantle composition (~18 wt% FeO). The experiments establish a revised Martian mantle solidus ~100 K lower than previous quench-based estimates. Incipient melting strongly attenuates shear waves and reduces seismic velocities. Low-degree melts (~5%) at 18–19 GPa are highly iron-enriched (Fe# ≈ 0.5, ~40 wt% FeO), exhibiting low wetting angles (~20°) and neutral-to-negative buoyancy (~4.1 g/cm³) relative to the surrounding solid mantle. These properties enable interconnected melt percolation and downward accumulation into a basal magma layer without requiring overturn of an extremely Fe-enriched primordial reservoir.
洞察号地震观测表明火星核幔边界上方可能存在熔融硅酸盐层，但此前缺乏深部条件下富铁火星熔体的实验约束。本研究利用多顶砧压机在高达19 GPa（约1550 km深）条件下，对含约18 wt% FeO的火星地幔成分开展了原位超声干涉、同步辐射X射线衍射与成像及非原位成分分析。实验测得的火星地幔固相线比以往……

t: Combined in situ multi-anvil ultrasonic interferometry (30–70 MHz), synchrotron X-ray diffraction/radiography, ex situ microprobe chemical analyses, and thermoelastic equation-of-state density modeling up to 19 GPa.
结合原位多顶砧超声干涉、同步辐射X射线衍射/成像、非原位电子探针及状态方程密度建模。
Four in situ synchrotron multi-anvil experiments at SPring-8 BL04B1 and five ex situ quench experiments at BGI on a nominally dry Martian mantle composition (~18 wt% FeO) between 4 and 19 GPa.
对含约18 wt% FeO的干火星地幔成分开展4组SPring-8原位实验与5组BGI非原位淬火实验（4–19 GPa）…

The Martian solidus is ~100 K lower than prior estimates. At 18–19 GPa, incipient melts (~5%) have ~40 wt% FeO (Fe# ≈ 0.5), ~20° wetting angles, densities of ~4.1 g/cm³, and cause strong S-wave attenuation.
火星地幔固相线降低约100 K；18–19 GPa下初始熔体Fe#达0.5、润湿角约20°、密度约4.1 g/cm³，且…
Ultrasonic velocities at tens of MHz cannot be directly extrapolated to seismic frequencies, and low-degree melt velocity drops alone cannot explain the large InSight CMB velocity reductions.
数十MHz超声测量不能直接外推至地震频段，且低熔融度波速下降不足以单独解释洞察号低速异常。
First in situ ultrasonic and X-ray detection of incipient melting in an Fe-rich Martian mantle at CMB pressures, proving dense basal melts can form without extreme primordial Fe-enrichment.
首次在核幔边界压力下原位探测火星地幔初始熔融，证明无需极端富铁原始储库即可形成高密基底熔体。

kc: Constrained the Martian mantle solidus up to 19 GPa using in situ ultrasonic and X-ray techniques, finding it ~100 K lower than previous ex situ estimates.
Demonstrated that incipient melting at Martian CMB pressures causes rapid S-wave attenuation and velocity drops (~18–33% for Vs at 14 GPa, complete loss of Vs at 18 GPa).
Showed that low-degree melts (<10%) at 17–19 GPa are strongly enriched in FeO (~40 wt%, Fe# ≈ 0.5), yielding high densities (~4.1 g/cm³) and neutral-to-negative buoyancy.
Measured low dihedral wetting angles (~20°) at 18 GPa, indicating that dense Fe-rich melts form interconnected networks capable of downward segregation to form a basal magma layer.
利用原位超声和X射线技术约束了高达19 GPa的火星地幔固相线，发现其比早期的非原位估计低约100 K。
证实火星核幔边界压力下的初始熔融会导致快速的S波衰减和波速下降（14 GPa下Vs下降约18–33%，18 GPa下Vs信号消失）。
表明17–19 GPa下的低程度熔体（<10%）强烈富集FeO（约40 wt%，Fe# ≈ 0.5），产生高密度（约4.1 g/cm³）及中性至负浮力。
测得18 GPa下的低二面润湿角（约20°），表明高密度富铁熔体可形成连通网络并向下分离聚集形成基底岩浆层。
me: In situ high-pressure, high-temperature ultrasonic interferometry (30–70 MHz pulse-echo overlap) in a multi-anvil press at SPring-8.
In situ synchrotron energy-dispersive X-ray diffraction and high-resolution X-ray radiography.
Ex situ Kawai-type multi-anvil quench experiments, scanning electron microscopy (SEM), and electron probe microanalysis (EPMA).
High-pressure density and thermoelastic modeling of silicate liquids (using three independent equations of state) and residual solid aggregates.
在SPring-8同步辐射光源使用多顶砧压机开展原位高温高压超声干涉测量（30–70 MHz脉冲回波重叠法）。
原位同步辐射能量色散X射线衍射与高分辨率X射线放射成像。
非原位Kawai型多顶砧淬火实验、扫描电子显微镜（SEM）表征与电子探针显微分析（EPMA）。
利用三种独立状态方程和热弹性模型计算硅酸盐熔体与残留固相集合体的高温高压密度。
de: Four in situ synchrotron multi-anvil runs (S3630, S3631, S3632, S3565) up to 18 GPa and 2,220 K on a synthetic FeO-rich (~18 wt%) Martian mantle glass.
Five complementary ex situ multi-anvil quench experiments at 18–19 GPa using molybdenum and graphite capsules.
针对合成富铁（约18 wt% FeO）火星地幔玻璃开展的4组原位同步辐射多顶砧实验（最高达18 GPa和2220 K）。
在18–19 GPa下使用钼囊和石墨囊开展的5组补充非原位多顶砧淬火实验。
li: Ultrasonic measurements at tens of megahertz cannot be directly extrapolated to seismic frequencies without accounting for frequency-dependent dispersion and anelastic relaxation.
Velocity reductions from low melt fractions (<5%) alone are insufficient to reproduce the large InSight CMB low-velocity anomalies, requiring melt accumulation to higher fractions.
Available thermodynamic data do not allow a quantitatively precise oxygen fugacity determination for partially molten samples beyond qualitative buffering near/below IW.
数十兆赫兹的超声测量受频率相关频散和非弹性弛豫影响，不能直接外推至地震频段。
仅靠低熔融程度（<5%）引起的波速降低不足以重现洞察号观测到的巨大低速异常，需熔体聚集达到更高比例。
现有热力学数据无法对部分熔融样品的氧逸度进行精确量化，仅能定性约束在IW缓冲线附近或以下。

tm.why: Provides experimental ultrasonic and mineral physics constraints to interpret the low-velocity anomaly near the Martian core-mantle boundary observed by the InSight mission.
Investigates deep Martian mantle melting phase relations, melt buoyancy, and the formation and stability of a basal silicate magma layer.
Measures ultrasonic P- and S-wave attenuation and velocity reductions across the onset of partial melting at high pressure.

ev.notes: Full 20-page PDF (including main text, Methods, 6 main figures, and 8 Extended Data figures) was read and analyzed.

sum: This study analyzes 17 years of continuous seismic waveform data near the Punggye-ri nuclear test site at Mt. Mantap, North Korea. Contrary to the expectation that nuclear-test-induced seismicity decays rapidly, the authors find that seismicity has persisted and intensified years after the 2017 test. The earthquakes have transitioned from diffuse activity to highly organized structures along faults. This multiyear fault reactivation is driven by progressive stress redistribution within a critically stressed crustal volume beneath asymmetric topography. The findings demonstrate that underground nuclear explosions can trigger long-term tectonic fault reactivation under specific geological conditions.
本研究分析了朝鲜丰溪里核试验场17年连续波形数据。与核试验诱发地震快速衰减的传统认识相反，2017年最后一次核爆后，该区地震持续增强并沿断层聚集。这种多年期断层延迟活化由非对称地形下临界应力地壳内的渐进应力重新分布驱动。研究表明，在特定地质条件下，地下核试验可引发长期的构造断层活化。

t: Analysis of 17 years of continuous seismic waveform data to detect and locate earthquakes, mapping their spatial evolution over time.
分析17年连续地震波形数据以检测和定位地震，描绘其随时间的空间演化。
17 years of continuous seismic waveform data recorded near the Punggye-ri nuclear test site at Mt. Mantap, North Korea.
朝鲜万塔山丰溪里核试验场附近记录的17年连续地震波形数据。
Seismicity persisted and intensified years after the 2017 explosion, evolving from diffuse activity to spatially organized clusters along shallow faults.
2017年核爆多年后地震活动持续增强，并从弥散分布演变为沿浅部断层聚集。
The observed multiyear fault reactivation may be highly dependent on the specific geological conditions and asymmetric topography of Mt. Mantap.
所观测到的多年期断层活化可能高度依赖于万塔山特定的地质条件和非对称地形。
Challenges the conventional view of rapid post-test seismic decay by demonstrating delayed, multiyear fault reactivation driven by progressive stress redistribution.
展示了渐进应力重新分布驱动的延迟多年断层活化，挑战了核试后地震快速衰减的传统观点。

kc: Discovered that seismicity near the Punggye-ri nuclear test site persisted and intensified for years after the 2017 explosion.
Demonstrated the transition of post-test seismicity from diffuse activity to spatially organized fault-controlled structures.
Revealed that underground nuclear testing can drive multiyear fault reactivation through progressive stress redistribution.
发现丰溪里核试验场附近的地震活动在2017年核爆后多年仍持续并增强。
展示了核试后地震活动从弥散状态向受断层控制的空间有序结构的演变。
揭示了地下核试验可通过渐进的应力重新分布驱动多年期的断层活化。
me: Continuous seismic waveform analysis over a 17-year period.
Seismic event detection and high-precision relocation to map fault-controlled structures.
Stress redistribution analysis incorporating asymmetric topography and crustal stress state.
对17年连续地震波形数据进行分析。
进行地震事件检测与高精度重定位以描绘受断层控制的结构。
结合非对称地形和地壳应力状态进行应力重新分布分析。
de: 17 years of continuous seismic waveform data from stations surrounding the Punggye-ri nuclear test site at Mt. Mantap.
来自万塔山丰溪里核试验场周边台站的17年连续地震波形数据。
li: The study is highly site-specific to Mt. Mantap, and the findings depend on specific geological conditions and asymmetric topography.
Lack of direct in-situ stress measurements to validate the progressive stress redistribution model.
该研究高度针对万塔山特定地点，其结论依赖于特定的地质条件和非对称地形。
缺乏直接的原位应力测量来验证渐进应力重新分布模型。

tm.why: The paper investigates seismicity induced by underground nuclear explosions at the Punggye-ri test site.
It explores the delayed reactivation of shallow faults and progressive stress redistribution within the crust.
It analyzes 17 years of continuous waveform data to detect and locate earthquakes, showing their spatial evolution.

ev.notes: No PDF was available; analysis is based on the abstract and public web metadata.

sum: Capturing long-range dependencies in 3D seismic exploration data via global modeling (GM) improves signal processing, but Transformer-based models suffer from quadratic complexity. This paper proposes a lightweight Mamba-based global modeling (LMGM) framework that leverages the linear complexity of state space models. LMGM introduces three key innovations: (1) a three-directional scanning Mamba (3DSM) block to exploit spatial correlations across time samples, inlines, and crosslines; (2) a dual-domain-aware (DDA) block combining fast Fourier transforms and convolutions to integrate time- and frequency-domain features; and (3) a two-stage plug-and-play nonlinear normalization (TPNN) combining arcsinh compression and Z-score standardization to handle large amplitude variations and recover weak reflections. Evaluated on synthetic (SEG C3), post-stack (Parihaka), and marine field (Beibu Gulf) 3D datasets for trace interpolation and random noise removal, LMGM achieves higher SNR than 3D U-Net and Transformer baselines while using roughly one-fifth the GPU memory and one-third the training time of Transformers.
针对三维地震勘探中Transformer全局建模计算复杂度高的问题，本文提出一种基于状态空间模型的轻量级Mamba全局建模框架（LMGM）。该方法设计了三向扫描Mamba模块（3DSM）以提取时间、测线和联络测线三维空间相关性；构建了结合快速傅里叶变换的双域感知模块（DDA）以融合时频域特征；并提出……

t: LMGM combines four densely connected 3D Mamba (3DM) blocks containing three-directional scanning Mamba (3DSM) modules and FFT-based dual-domain-aware (DDA) blocks, paired with a two-stage arcsinh and Z-score nonlinear normalization (TPNN).
结合密集连接3D Mamba块（含三向扫描3DSM与时频双域DDA模块）及两阶段arcsinh与Z-score非线性归一…
Evaluated on 3D patches (32×32×8) extracted from the synthetic SEG C3 45 shots dataset, field marine data from Beibu Gulf, China, and the post-stack Parihaka 3D dataset.
采用SEG C3三维合成叠前数据、中国北部湾海洋三维实测数据以及Parihaka三维叠后数据集进行验证。

LMGM achieves 15.31 dB SNR on synthetic 3D interpolation and 13.50 dB on field data, outperforming 3D U-Net and Transformer while using 4764 MB GPU memory and 0.97 h training time (vs. 24372 MB and 2.60 h for Transformer).
合成与实测插值信噪比达15.31 dB和13.50 dB，显存（4764 MB）和训练时间（0.97 h）仅为Trans…
The DDA block lacks frequency-domain global modeling, TPNN is not required for all tasks, and separate models must be retrained for each dataset and task.
DDA未在频域全局建模，TPNN非所有任务通用，且不同数据集和任务需单独重新训练模型。

First introduction of a linear-complexity Mamba state space architecture with 3D three-directional scanning, time-frequency dual-domain blocks, and arcsinh/Z-score normalization to 3D seismic data processing.
首次将线性复杂度Mamba架构结合三维三向扫描、时频双域模块和非线性归一化引入三维地震数据处理。

kc: Proposes LMGM, the first lightweight Mamba-based global modeling framework with linear complexity for 3D seismic exploration data processing.

Introduces a two-stage plug-and-play nonlinear normalization (TPNN) strategy using arcsinh and Z-score to preserve weak reflections across large dynamic ranges.

sum: This paper presents the Terza Torre Seismic Array in Bologna, Italy, a hybrid monitoring infrastructure designed to study soil-structure interaction (SSI) and site response in the soft-soil environment of the Po Plain. Deployed in 2023, the array consists of eight three-component sensors distributed along the height of a 20-story reinforced concrete building, a basement reference station, and a nearby borehole station with surface and 50 m deep sensors. The open-access dataset includes continuous ambient noise and recordings of 30 local/regional earthquakes (ML 3.0–4.8). The authors demonstrate the dataset's utility through three applications: estimating the building's fundamental frequencies and mode shapes, and assessing local site response. This infrastructure provides a valuable open-science resource for validating numerical models of tall buildings on soft soils.

sum: This study utilizes the seismic foundation model SeisLM to extract high-dimensional representations of earthquake coda waveforms, monitoring temporal changes in crustal rock damage throughout the earthquake cycle. By defining a dissimilarity metric relative to a baseline state, the authors analyze the 1999 İzmit-Düzce, 2019 Ridgecrest, and 2023 Kahramanmaraş earthquake sequences. The method successfully captures coseismic damage and subsequent postseismic recovery. Crucially, it detects long-term increases and pronounced accelerations in dissimilarity months before the Ridgecrest (~160 days) and Kahramanmaraş (~8 months) mainshocks. Comparison of surface and borehole data at Ridgecrest suggests these precursory changes primarily originate in the shallow crust. This work demonstrates the power of deep learning foundation models for continuous monitoring of fault zone conditions and earthquake preparatory phases.

sum: This study presents the first documented Mesoarchaean β-shaped metamorphic P-T path from metasedimentary granulites in the Coorg Granulite Block, South India. Using thermobarometry, phase equilibria modeling, U-Pb monazite geochronology, and garnet-orthopyroxene diffusion chronometry, the authors identify two distinct clockwise heating-cooling and burial-exhumation cycles (M1 and M2) between 3.16 and 3.12 Ga. The short-lived metamorphic pulses (totaling 12.9–14.1 Myr) and changing cooling rates suggest rapid crustal recycling. This thermal history is attributed to either sagduction or peel-back orogenesis on a hotter Earth. Combined with contrasting P-T paths in the Western Dharwar Craton, these findings demonstrate Mesoarchaean thermal duality, pushing the onset of embryonic plate-margin processes back to the Mesoarchaean.

sum: Hessian-vector products (HVPs) enable matrix-free second-order full-waveform inversion (FWI), but standard Lagrangian derivations can fail when the wave operator L is non-symmetric. This paper shows that rewriting the first HVP term using the operator adjoint requires accounting for boundary terms via Green identities rather than simple algebraic transposition. The authors formulate a complete Lagrangian framework explicitly incorporating initial and convolutional perfectly matched layer (CPML) boundary conditions. They validate gradients and HVPs against an independent JAX-based automatic differentiation computational graph (FDCompGraph) and implement a memory-efficient co-simulation engine (Devito-Hdm). In first-order velocity-stress acoustic VTI media, omitting boundary terms in H1 causes errors up to ~400% in epsilon and ~40% in delta, while damping sponge boundaries lose ~10% HVP amplitude compared to CPML. Applied to multiparameter VTI FWI on a modified BP 2007 benchmark, HVP-Newton-CG improves small-scale scatterer recovery over L-BFGS and NLCG at comparable computational cost.
海森向量积（HVP）为全波形反演（FWI）提供二阶信息，但当波动算子L非对称时，常规拉格朗日推导可能失效。本文通过格林恒等式严格区分代数转置与分部积分算子伴随，提出显式包含初边值条件与CPML边界的完整拉格朗日框架。作者开发了基于JAX自动微分的FDCompGraph进行离散级验证，并构建了高效伴随……

t: Formulates a complete second-order augmented Lagrangian with Green identities and CPML memory variables to compute exact Hessian-vector products for non-symmetric wave operators, implemented in Devito-Hdm and verified against JAX automatic differentiation (FDCompGraph).
结合格林恒等式与CPML变量构建完整二阶增广拉格朗日HVP公式，在Devito-Hdm中实现并用JAX自动微分验证。

2D synthetic pseudo-acoustic VTI experiments on a 512x412 homogeneous grid for AD verification and a 251x114 subdomain of the BP 2007 anisotropic benchmark model with 2 to 16 localized 10% scatterer perturbations.

Omitting boundary terms in H1 for non-symmetric VTI operators causes peak HVP errors of 394.20% in epsilon and 40.37% in delta; correcting them matches AD to ~10^-6 relative difference and halves FWI convergence iterations.

sum: This paper presents a confidence-based, network-informed framework to expand seismic catalogs using a single deep-borehole sensor. By integrating machine-learning phase picking, waveform similarity, and site-specific data-quality metrics, the method achieves high-sensitivity detection. Applied to a 2052-m-deep sensor at a Belgian geothermal site during a 2021–2022 circulation test, the framework detected ~10,000 events compared to 242 in the standard network catalog, lowering the completeness magnitude from -0.4 to -1.95. This approach reveals earlier and more continuous reservoir activation, demonstrating that deep-borehole installations combined with advanced processing can significantly enhance monitoring capabilities where dense surface networks are impractical.

sum: This study investigates the active seismotectonics of the Apennines-Tyrrhenian Sea system, where back-arc opening ceased ~2 Ma but extension and contraction continue to co-migrate forelandward. Integrating 3D GNSS velocities, high-resolution InSAR ground motion (EGMS), earthquake hypocenters, focal mechanisms, and Moho depth maps, the authors show that active deformation is tightly anchored to a >500-km-long overlap zone between the Tyrrhenian and Adriatic Mohos (the unzipping front). Internal extension (~4 mm/yr) exceeds far-field divergence (~2 mm/yr), balanced by ~2 mm/yr of frontal thrusting. Using an analytical elastic flexural model of two joined beams with contrasting thicknesses, they demonstrate that delamination drastically reduces effective elastic thickness in the hinterland (to ~1/5–1/15 of the intact foreland), causing inward collapse of the flexural wavelength and an amplified retrobulge. This provides a real-time geodetic and mechanical template for intra-lithospheric decoupling in mature retreating subduction systems.
本研究结合GNSS三维速度场、InSAR高分辨率形变数据、地震目录与震源机制及莫霍面深度，探讨了亚平宁-第勒尼安海系统的现今地震构造动力学。研究发现现今地壳变形与地震活动紧密围绕长逾500公里的双莫霍面重叠带（拉链式拆沉前缘）分布，内部伸展速率（约4 mm/yr）超过远场离散速率（约2 mm/yr）……

结合GNSS、InSAR与地震剖面，建立跨拆沉铰链的变有效弹性厚度双半无限长弹性梁弯曲解析模型。
The study integrates 1995–2025 GNSS velocities, 2019–2023 Sentinel-1 EGMS InSAR vertical and E-W ground motion, 1981–2018 CLASS hypocenters, 1976–2026 INGV focal mechanisms, and Moho depth maps.

The continuous elastic flexural model simplifies a rheologically stratified lithosphere and omits transient viscous flow, mantle dynamics, and short-term interseismic fault loading.

Provides the first empirical, real-time geodetic and analytical mechanical demonstration that lower-crustal unzipping drives paired extension, contraction, and vertical motion after back-arc opening ceases.

Develops an analytical elastic flexural model showing that delamination reduces post-delamination effective elastic thickness to ~1/5 (GNSS) or ~1/15 (InSAR) of the intact foreland thickness.

sum: This study proposes a new tectonic model for the Honshu Arc, interpreting it as an incompletely joined system of three distinct arcs (Southwest Japan Arc, Hida–Tamba Terrane, and Northeast Japan Arc) rather than a fully sutured entity. This 'Three-Arc Unjoined Model' explains the observed subsidence, uplift, and fault activity in key regions like the Nōbi Plain, Lake Biwa, and Osaka Bay. These areas are located along Forearc Weak Suture Zones where weak accretionary complexes and overlapping fault zones concentrate deformation. The model establishes the 'Kinki Subsidence Line' as a western counterpart to the South Fossa Magna, providing a unified framework for forearc geodynamics in Japan.
本研究提出了本州弧的新构造模型，将其解释为三个不同弧（西南日本弧、飞騨-丹波地体和东北日本弧）未完全结合的系统。该“三弧未结合模型”解释了浓尾平原、琵琶湖和大阪湾等关键区域的沉降、隆起和断层活动。这些区域位于前弧微弱缝合带，弱吸积杂岩和重叠断裂带在此集中了变形。该模型建立了“近畿沉降线”作为南部大地……

sum: Davemaoite (CaSiO3 perovskite) is a major phase in subducted oceanic crust, yet its experimental tetragonal-to-cubic transition temperatures (~600 K) have long conflicted with theoretical predictions (>1000 K). Using a laser-heated diamond anvil cell coupled with synchrotron X-ray diffraction and FTIR spectroscopy, the authors determine the phase stability and thermal equation of state of pure CaSiO3 and Ti-bearing Ca(Si0.75,Ti0.25)O3 up to 88 GPa and 2500 K. They discover that the ferroelastic transition occurs at 1470–1990 K for pure davemaoite (50–84 GPa), reconciling experiments with ab initio theory. Furthermore, 25% Ti substitution stabilizes the tetragonal phase, raising transition temperatures by ~600–700 K. Consequently, davemaoite with realistic MORB Ti contents (5–10 mol%) undergoes this elastic-softening transition across a broad depth range in the mid-lower mantle along slab geotherms, and near the core-mantle boundary within LLSVPs, providing a unified mineralogical mechanism for deep-mantle seismic scatterers and heterogeneities.
本研究利用同步辐射X射线衍射、傅里叶变换红外光谱与激光加热金刚石压腔技术，测定了纯CaSiO3及含钛毛河光矿[Ca(Si0.75,Ti0.25)O3]在高达88 GPa和2500 K下的相稳定性与热状态方程。结果表明，纯毛河光矿的四方-立方铁弹相变发生在1470–1990 K（50–84 GPa），……

首次利用LHDAC原位测定纯相及含钛毛河光矿的高温四方-立方相边界与热状态方程，弥合了实验与理论分歧。

kc: Resolved the long-standing discrepancy between experimental (~600 K) and theoretical (>1200 K) tetragonal-to-cubic transition temperatures in CaSiO3 davemaoite using in situ LHDAC XRD and FTIR.
Demonstrated that 25 mol% Ti substitution stabilizes the tetragonal structure and raises the transition boundary by ~600–700 K across lower mantle pressures.
Derived third-order Birch-Murnaghan-MGD thermal equations of state for pure and Ti-bearing davemaoite, showing 25% Ti reduces mantle density by 1.2–1.5%.
Showed that temperature- and Ti-sensitive ferroelastic transitions in MORB-derived davemaoite explain both mid-lower mantle seismic scatterers (700–2000 km) and LLSVP anomalies near the CMB.
利用原位LHDAC XRD和FTIR实验，解决了CaSiO3毛河光矿四方-立方相变温度在早期实验（~600 K）与理论计算（>1200 K）之间的长期矛盾。
证明了25 mol%的Ti替代能够稳定四方相结构，并在下地幔压力范围内将相变温度边界提高约600–700 K。
建立了纯毛河光矿和含钛毛河光矿的三阶Birch-Murnaghan-MGD热状态方程，发现25%的Ti掺入使其在地幔中的密度降低1.2–1.5%。
阐明了俯冲洋壳中毛河光矿受温度和Ti含量控制的铁弹相变机制，统一解释了中下地幔地震散射体（700–2000 km）和核幔边界LLSVPs的地震异常。
me: In situ high-pressure, high-temperature synchrotron X-ray diffraction (XRD) in a symmetric laser-heated diamond anvil cell (LHDAC) with boron-doped diamond (BDD) laser absorbers.
Structural refinement of (200) diffraction peak full width at half maximum (FWHM) using a cubic (Pm-3m) model and c/a axial ratio using a tetragonal (P4/mmm) model.
Synchrotron Fourier-transform infrared (FTIR) spectroscopy in an externally heated diamond anvil cell (EHDAC) up to 1000 K at 23–30 GPa.
3D finite element method (FEM) simulations in COMSOL Multiphysics to evaluate spatial temperature gradients across the X-ray path.
Thermal equation of state fitting using a third-order Birch-Murnaghan equation combined with the Mie-Grüneisen-Debye (MGD) thermal pressure model.

分别采用立方相（Pm-3m）模型拟合（200）衍射峰半高宽（FWHM），以及四方相（P4/mmm）模型精修晶胞参数c/a轴比。
利用外加热金刚石压腔（EHDAC）在23–30 GPa、高达1000 K条件下进行同步辐射傅里叶变换红外（FTIR）光谱测量。
使用COMSOL Multiphysics开展三维有限元（FEM）数值模拟，评估X射线路径上的空间温度梯度。
结合三阶Birch-Murnaghan状态方程与Mie-Grüneisen-Debye（MGD）热压模型拟合热状态方程。

sum: Modeling high-frequency coupled elastic-acoustic wave propagation through complex biological anatomy is computationally demanding and lacks experimental ground truth. This study cross-validates the spectral-element package SPECFEM3D against the pseudospectral solver k-Wave on a 3D computed-tomography-derived anatomy model of a bottlenose dolphin head across 20–100 kHz. To overcome single-GPU memory limits at fine grids, the authors ported k-Wave's 3D elastic solver to CUDA C++ with multi-GPU support via 1D slab decomposition and NCCL all-to-all transposes, alongside temporal staging to reduce source memory overhead. Both solvers were tested on concentric spheres and the 8-region dolphin head mesh across varying spatial resolutions (NGLL 3–6 and 1.0–0.4 mm voxels) and GPU architectures (L40S, A100, H100). At highest resolutions, both methods converge and achieve normalized waveform correlations exceeding 0.99 at rostrum and inner-ear receivers, establishing a validated, high-performance numerical framework that can bypass hexahedral meshing bottlenecks.
本研究针对生物介质中高频声-弹耦合波传播，在三维宽吻海豚头部CT解剖模型（20–100 kHz）上交叉验证了谱元法（SPECFEM3D）与伪谱法（k-Wave）。作者将k-Wave三维弹性求解器移植至CUDA C++，利用一维板分解和NCCL通信实现多GPU并行，并通过分阶段模拟降低震源显存占用。在……

Plane-wave bursts (20–100 kHz) propagated through a concentric sphere model and a CT-derived 3D bottlenose dolphin head mesh (12,676,714 hexahedra across 8 regions).
在同心球模型及8区域海豚头部三维CT网格（1268万六面体）中传播20–100 kHz平面波脉冲。
SPECFEM3D (NGLL=6) and PSM-CUDA (0.4 mm grid) waveforms achieve normalized correlations >0.99 across 20–100 kHz at rostrum and inner-ear receivers, costing ~51 and ~23 GPU-hours on H100s.
最高分辨率下两方法在20–100 kHz波形相关性超0.99，H100计算耗时分别为51和23 GPU小时。
Fine 3D structures of the tympano-periotic complex and sharp tissue-air discontinuities (sinuses) were smoothed out due to HPC resource limits.

kc: Re-implemented the k-Wave 3D elastic pseudospectral solver (pstdElastic3D) in CUDA C++ with multi-GPU support using 1D slab decomposition and NCCL all-to-all pencil transposes.
Conducted a rigorous 3D time-domain cross-validation between SPECFEM3D and PSM-CUDA up to 100 kHz on a realistic 8-region CT-derived dolphin head model.
Demonstrated waveform convergence with spatial refinement, achieving normalized correlation >0.99 between SEM (NGLL=6) and PSM (0.4 mm grid) at both rostrum and inner-ear locations.
Benchmarked computational performance across NVIDIA L40S, A100, and H100 GPUs, showing that memory bandwidth and NVLink interconnect speed govern multi-GPU scaling more than peak FP32 TFLOPS.
使用CUDA C++重新实现了k-Wave三维弹性伪谱求解器，通过一维板分解和NCCL全局转置支持多GPU并行计算。
在基于CT的8区域海豚头部三维解剖模型上，完成了高达100 kHz的SPECFEM3D与PSM-CUDA时域交叉验证。
证明了随空间分辨率细化的波形收敛性，SEM（NGLL=6）与PSM（0.4 mm网格）在吻部和内耳处的归一化相关性均超过0.99。
在NVIDIA L40S、A100和H100 GPU上进行了性能基准测试，表明显存带宽和NVLink互连速度比峰值FP32算力对多GPU扩展性更为关键。
me: Coupled elastic-acoustic wave modeling using Spectral-Element Method (SPECFEM3D) on conformal hexahedral meshes with explicit fluid-solid continuity conditions.
Pseudospectral Method (k-Wave / PSM-CUDA) on uniform Cartesian grids using staggered-grid leapfrog time marching and global 3D FFT spatial derivatives.
Multi-GPU 3D FFT parallelization via 1D z-slab domain decomposition, pencil transpose using NCCL over NVLink, and multi-stage source injection to reduce VRAM usage.
基于共形六面体网格和显式流-固界面连续条件的谱元法（SPECFEM3D）声-弹耦合波模拟。
基于均匀笛卡尔网格、交错网格蛙跳时间步进和全局3D FFT空间导数的伪谱法（k-Wave / PSM-CUDA）。
采用一维z向板区域分解、基于NVLink的NCCL铅笔转置以及多阶段震源注入降显存策略的多GPU 3D FFT并行化。
de: Benchmark 1: Idealized concentric spheres model (2 cm bone core, 3 cm soft-tissue shell in a 10.4x10.4x14.4 cm water box) tested at 20 kHz and 80 kHz.
Benchmark 2: CT-derived 3D bottlenose dolphin (Tursiops truncatus) head model (42x42x66 cm box, 8 homogeneous anatomical regions, 12.68 million hexahedra) tested from 20 to 100 kHz.
HPC scaling and runtime benchmarks across NVIDIA L40S, A100, and H100 GPUs for single- and multi-GPU configurations.
基准实验1：理想同心球模型（2 cm骨骼内核、3 cm软组织外壳，置于10.4x10.4x14.4 cm水箱中），在20 kHz和80 kHz下测试。

PSM on rectilinear grids introduces O(h) staircase approximation errors at curved fluid-solid interfaces and requires spatial tapering to suppress low-frequency source diffraction tails.
受计算资源限制，鼓室-耳周复合体的精细三维结构以及组织与空气（鼻窦）间的剧烈弹性参数间断在网格中被平滑处理。

sum: This study performs a probabilistic joint inversion of surface heat flow, topography, geoid heights, and Rayleigh wave dispersion data to characterize the lithospheric thermal, compositional, and rheological structures beneath the Changbaishan volcanic field (CVF). The results show that the lithosphere is significantly thinner (~55 km) beneath Changbaishan and Longgang than beneath Jingpohu (~85 km). A prominent 200-km-wide asthenospheric thermal anomaly and crust-to-mantle rheological weakening exist only beneath Changbaishan. This suggests Changbaishan hosts a multilevel magmatic system connecting the asthenosphere to the shallow crust, explaining its high activity and diverse eruptive rocks, whereas Longgang and Jingpohu lack this sustained connectivity.

sum: This study combines approximately 700 GNSS station velocities with Sentinel-1 InSAR time series (2014–2023) to investigate interseismic strain accumulation and partitioning across Hispaniola on the northeastern Caribbean plate boundary. Using the Celeri elastic block modeling software, the authors test multiple fault geometries and incorporate internal block deformation, while also deriving continuous surface strain rate maps from 10-km Gaussian-filtered InSAR velocities after quantifying spatially correlated tropospheric noise (~50 nstrain/yr uncertainty). For the first time geodetically, the model identifies the eastern boundary of the Gonâve microplate, accommodated by 2–3 mm/yr of shortening in the Gulf of Gonâve. Strain rate maps confirm localized strike-slip strain (5–6 mm/yr) along the Enriquillo-Plantain Garden Fault in southern Haiti, partitioned with ~5 mm/yr of shortening on the Jérémie-Malpasse Fault. Conversely, northern Dominican Republic deformation spreads over a 30–50 km zone south of the mapped Septentrional Fault, expanding the regional seismic hazard footprint.
本研究结合约700个GNSS站点速度与Sentinel-1 InSAR数据，研究加勒比板块东北边界伊斯帕尼奥拉岛的震间应变积累与分配。利用Celeri软件建立允许块体内部变形的运动学模型，并在评估空间相关大气噪声（不确定度约50 nstrain/yr）后，通过10 km高斯滤波计算连续地表应变率。研……

The dataset combines ~700 Caribbean continuous and episodic GNSS stations (201 in Haiti, through December 2024) with six ascending and descending Sentinel-1 InSAR tracks covering Hispaniola up to February 2023.
结合加勒比地区约700个GNSS站速度（海地201个，至2024年底）与覆盖全岛的6条Sentinel-1升、降轨InS…

The model resolves 5–6 mm/yr strike-slip on the EPGFz, ~5 mm/yr shortening on the JMF, 2–3 mm/yr shortening in the Gulf of Gonâve, and a 30–50 km wide strain zone (up to 150 nstrain/yr) south of the Septentrional Fault.

kc: Integrates GNSS and Sentinel-1 InSAR horizontal velocities into an updated Caribbean kinematic block model allowing internal block strain.
Quantifies the impact of spatially correlated tropospheric noise on InSAR strain rates, establishing a ~80-100 nstrain/yr tectonic detection threshold using a 10-km Gaussian filter.
Identifies the eastern boundary of the Gonâve microplate, showing 2-3 mm/yr of compressional shortening across the Gulf of Gonâve.
Demonstrates that strain in the northern Dominican Republic is distributed across a 30-50 km wide zone south of the mapped Septentrional Fault rather than localized on a single trace.
将GNSS和Sentinel-1 InSAR水平速度场整合到允许块体内部变形的加勒比运动学块体模型中。

证明多米尼加共和国北部的应变分布在Septentrional断层以南30-50 km宽的区域内，而非局限于单一断层迹线。

Kinematic elastic block modeling with back-slip and internal block strain rate tensors using Celeri, evaluated via F-ratio statistical tests.
Empirical variogram modeling of spatially correlated InSAR noise and synthetic Monte Carlo simulations to optimize spatial filtering (10 km Gaussian vs 20 km median).
永久散射体（PS）InSAR处理（ISCE2、StaMPS、SNAPHU、TRAIN），并结合GNSS北向速度的泛克里金插值进行LOS速度分解。

Six Sentinel-1 tracks (3 ascending, 3 descending, two frames each) covering Hispaniola through February 2023, excluding post-2021 Nippes earthquake acquisitions.
200 synthetic realizations of spatially correlated Gaussian noise (mean sigma = 1.4 mm/yr, L = 28 km) added to forward block model velocities.

Residual spatially correlated tropospheric noise produces strain rate uncertainties up to ~50 nstrain/yr, masking tectonic signals below 80-100 nstrain/yr.
Gaussian spatial filtering (10 km window) blurs sharp velocity gradients and widens apparent high-strain-rate zones across faults.
InSAR卫星视线向几何对南北向水平运动敏感度有限，需依赖较稀疏的GNSS数据进行插值约束。
残余空间相关对流层噪声导致高达约50 nstrain/yr的应变率不确定度，掩盖了低于80-100 nstrain/yr的构造信号。
10 km窗口的高斯空间滤波会平滑尖锐的速度梯度，使跨断层的高应变率带在视觉上变宽。

tm.why: The paper develops a regional kinematic block model of the North American-Caribbean plate boundary and quantifies crustal deformation, strain partitioning, and microplate boundaries across Hispaniola.
The study investigates interseismic fault locking, slip-rate deficits, and localized versus distributed strain accumulation along major strike-slip and reverse fault systems.
The paper evaluates slip deficits and strain distribution across multiple fault strands to reassess potential earthquake magnitudes and seismic hazard in Haiti and the Dominican Republic.

sum: This study introduces a hybrid deep learning architecture, CNN-DNN-GRU, for earthquake magnitude regression using historical earthquake catalog metadata. The model integrates 1D Convolutional Neural Networks for spatial feature extraction, Gated Recurrent Units for capturing temporal dependencies across sequences of 10 preceding events, and Deep Neural Networks for regression. It sequentially employs Binary Differential Evolution (BDE) for wrapper-based feature selection and the Firefly Algorithm (FA) for hyperparameter tuning. Trained and evaluated chronologically on 3.44 million cleaned global seismic records (1990–2023) using leakage-free inputs (longitude, latitude, depth), the model achieves an MSE of 0.0109, MAE of 0.0837, RMSE of 0.1048, and R² of 0.9918 on the independent test set, outperforming gradient boosting and deep learning baselines. The primary novelty lies in the sequential coupling of BDE and FA with a hybrid CNN-DNN-GRU network, accompanied by rigorous leakage control, SHAP explainability, and magnitude-stratified error analysis.
本研究提出一种混合深度学习模型CNN-DNN-GRU，用于基于历史地震目录元数据的震级回归预测。该方法结合CNN提取空间特征、GRU捕捉前10次地震的时序依赖、DNN进行非线性回归，并串联使用二进制差分进化（BDE）筛选特征和萤火虫算法（FA）优化超参数。基于1990至2023年全球344万条清洗后……

t: A hybrid CNN-DNN-GRU architecture processes 10-event chronological sequences of catalog metadata, sequentially optimized via Binary Differential Evolution (BDE) for feature selection and Firefly Algorithm (FA) for hyperparameter tuning.
采用CNN-DNN-GRU处理10个事件的时序目录元数据，串联BDE特征选择与FA超参数调优。

3,500,000 global earthquake catalog records (1990–2023) from Kaggle, cleaned to 3,442,026 valid instances using leakage-free inputs (longitude, latitude, depth) split chronologically into 70% train, 15% validation, and 15% test.
1990–2023年全球350万条地震目录（清洗后344万条），以经纬度与深度为输入按时序70/15/15划分。
The proposed CNN-DNN-GRU + BDE-FA model achieved MSE of 0.0109, MAE of 0.0837, MedAE of 0.0709, RMSE of 0.1048, and R² of 0.9918, outperforming gradient boosting and deep learning baselines.
模型取得MSE 0.0109、MAE 0.0837、RMSE 0.1048和R² 0.9918，优于所有对比基线模型。
The model relies on tabular catalog metadata rather than real-time waveforms, empirically sets optimizer control parameters, and underestimates rare M >= 6.0 events due to catalog imbalance.
仅依赖目录元数据而非实时波形，优化器参数靠经验设定，且对大震存在低估偏差。

Combines a hybrid CNN-DNN-GRU network with sequential BDE feature selection and FA hyperparameter tuning on a 3.5-million-event global earthquake catalog under strict temporal and target-leakage controls.
首次将CNN-DNN-GRU与BDE-FA串联优化结合，并在350万级目录上进行防泄漏评估。

kc: Proposed a hybrid CNN-DNN-GRU architecture combining spatial, sequential, and deep dense representations for catalog-based earthquake magnitude estimation.
Integrated sequential metaheuristic optimization using Binary Differential Evolution (BDE) for feature selection and Firefly Algorithm (FA) for hyperparameter tuning.
Evaluated the framework on 3.44 million cleaned global earthquake catalog records (1990–2023) with strict chronological splitting and target-leakage control.
Conducted comprehensive ablation, sensitivity, magnitude-stratified bias, SHAP explainability, and 10-run statistical significance analyses.
提出了结合空间、时序和深度全连接表征的CNN-DNN-GRU混合架构，用于基于地震目录的震级估计。
集成了串联元启发式优化策略，利用二进制差分进化（BDE）进行特征选择，萤火虫算法（FA）进行超参数调优。
在1990–2023年全球344万条清洗后的地震目录记录上进行了严格的时间顺序划分和防目标泄漏评估。
开展了全面的消融实验、敏感性分析、震级分层偏差评估、SHAP可解释性及10次重复运行统计显著性检验。
me: Data cleaning and leakage control: removed invalid magnitude placeholders (M = -9.99) and excluded target-leaking (significance) or zero-variance (status, tsunami) features.
Chronological sequence construction: ordered events by time and created sliding windows of 10 previous events' [longitude, latitude, depth] to predict the next magnitude.
Wrapper-based feature selection using Binary Differential Evolution (BDE) balancing validation MSE and feature subset size.
Hybrid CNN-DNN-GRU regression architecture comprising two Conv1D layers, MaxPooling1D, two GRU layers, and two Dense layers.
Hyperparameter optimization via Firefly Algorithm (FA) minimizing validation MSE, plus SHAP explainability and paired statistical testing.
数据清洗与防泄漏控制：剔除无效震级占位符（M = -9.99），排除可能导致目标泄漏（显著性）或无方差（状态、海啸）的特征。
时序样本构建：按发震时间排序，利用滑动窗口提取前10个事件的[经度、纬度、深度]构建序列以预测下一事件震级。
使用二进制差分进化（BDE）进行封装式特征选择，平衡验证集MSE与特征子集大小。
构建包含两层Conv1D、一层最大池化、两层GRU和两层全连接层的CNN-DNN-GRU混合回归架构。
通过萤火虫算法（FA）最小化验证集MSE以优化超参数，并结合SHAP可解释性分析与配对统计检验。
de: The Ultimate Earthquake Dataset (1990–2023) from Kaggle containing 3,500,000 global tabular catalog records (3,442,026 valid after removing M = -9.99).
Chronological 70% training, 15% validation, and 15% testing (516,303 sequences) split with Min-Max normalization fitted solely on the training set.
Benchmarking against Random Forest, XGBoost, LightGBM, CatBoost, SVR, MLP, CNN, LSTM, GRU, ResNet50, and VGG-19.
Ablation studies on BDE feature selection, input feature combinations, coordinate shuffling, and magnitude-stratified error/bias evaluation.
来自Kaggle的1990–2023年全球地震目录数据集，共350万条表格记录（剔除M = -9.99后保留3,442,026条有效记录）。
按时间顺序划分为70%训练集、15%验证集和15%测试集（516,303个序列），仅在训练集上拟合Min-Max归一化参数。
与随机森林、XGBoost、LightGBM、CatBoost、SVR、MLP、CNN、LSTM、GRU、ResNet50和VGG-19进行基准对比。
开展BDE特征选择消融、输入特征组合消融、坐标随机打乱敏感性测试以及按震级分层的误差与偏差评估。
li: Relies exclusively on tabular catalog metadata (longitude, latitude, depth) rather than real-time seismic waveforms, preventing direct operational early-warning use.
Strong catalog imbalance (81.67% events M < 3.0 vs 0.53% M >= 6.0) causes systematic underestimation bias (-0.1186) for large earthquakes.
Metaheuristic optimizer control parameters for BDE and FA were chosen empirically without exhaustive sensitivity analysis or nested cross-validation.
仅依赖表格型目录元数据（经度、纬度、深度）而非实时地震波形，无法直接用于实际地震预警系统。
地震目录分布严重不平衡（81.67%事件M < 3.0，仅0.53%事件M >= 6.0），导致对大震存在系统性低估偏差（-0.1186）。
BDE和FA元启发式优化器的控制参数系根据经验设定，未进行详尽的参数敏感性分析或嵌套交叉验证。

tm.why: The paper develops a hybrid deep learning framework (CNN-DNN-GRU) coupled with metaheuristic optimization for earthquake magnitude estimation.
The study performs magnitude regression on a large-scale earthquake catalog of 3,500,000 events using chronological metadata sequences.

sum: Using updated Martian mantle composition (~13.7 wt% FeO) and core-mantle boundary depth (~1560 km) derived from InSight seismic data, the authors experimentally simulated the full solidification of the Martian magma ocean (MMO) from 16 GPa to 1 atm and 1700°C to 750°C under oxidizing conditions. Adopting a two-stage model (equilibrium crystallization to ~50% solidification followed by fractional crystallization), they found that the mantle cumulates consist of olivine/wadsleyite, orthopyroxene, clinopyroxene, majoritic garnet, and spinel, lacking bridgmanite or ringwoodite. Crucially, late-stage fractional crystallization generates a ~32-km-thick buoyant felsic protocrust dominated by plagioclase and beta-quartz, explaining remote sensing and meteorite observations of ancient felsic Martian rocks. Furthermore, the absence of a mid-mantle dense garnet layer and the presence of shallow (<170 km) dense Fe-rich spinel cumulates redefine the gravitational instability profile that drove early Martian mantle overturn.
本研究结合InSight地震数据更新的火星地幔成分（~13.7 wt% FeO）和核幔边界深度（~1560 km），在氧化条件下通过高温高压实验（1 atm至16 GPa，750°C至1700°C）模拟了火星岩浆洋（MMO）的两阶段完整结晶过程。实验表明地幔堆晶由橄榄石/瓦兹利石、辉石、超硅石榴石和……

t: High-pressure, high-temperature double-capsule experiments (1 atm to 16 GPa, 750° to 1700°C) simulating a two-stage Martian magma ocean solidification: equilibrium crystallization to ~50% solidification followed by stepwise fractional crystallization.
采用双样品仓高温高压实验（1 atm至16 GPa，750°至1700°C）模拟两阶段岩浆洋结晶：前50%平衡结晶，随后…

Synthetic Si-Al-Fe-Mg-Ca-Na-V-O starting material based on InSight-constrained Martian mantle composition (~13.7 wt% FeO) and a 1560-km initial magma ocean depth, buffered at ΔFMQ -0.7 to +0.8 using magnetite-hematite.
基于InSight约束的火星地幔低铁成分（~13.7 wt% FeO）和1560 km深度配制初始物，并用磁铁矿-赤铁矿…

Crystallization yields a mantle of wadsleyite/olivine, pyroxene, majorite, and spinel, and forms a ~32-km-thick buoyant protocrust of plagioclase (at ~95 PCS) and beta-quartz (at ~98 PCS), with shallow spinel driving mantle overturn.
地幔生成瓦兹利石/橄榄石、辉石、超硅石榴石和尖晶石，晚期形成约32 km厚富斜长石和石英原始地壳，浅部尖晶石驱动翻转。
The experimental starting composition omits minor elements Cr and Ti, which partition into spinel and stabilize ilmenite, potentially modifying oxide phase stability and residual melt evolution.
初始成分未包含Cr和Ti等微量元素，这可能影响尖晶石和钛铁矿等氧化物相的稳定性及残余熔体演化。

First experimental simulation of complete Martian magma ocean solidification incorporating InSight-updated low-FeO composition and shallower core-mantle boundary, demonstrating direct magma-ocean formation of a thick felsic protocrust.
首次结合InSight更新的低铁成分和较浅核幔边界完整模拟火星岩浆洋凝固，证实直接形成厚层长英质原始地壳。

kc: Simulated complete Martian magma ocean solidification using InSight-constrained mantle depth (1560 km) and low-FeO composition (~13.7 wt%).
Demonstrated direct formation of a ~32-km-thick buoyant protocrust dominated by plagioclase and beta-quartz during late-stage crystallization.
Showed that the olivine-wadsleyite transition occurs between 13 and 16 GPa without forming ringwoodite or bridgmanite, aligning with the ~1006 km seismic discontinuity.
Redefined the post-solidification mantle density profile, showing overturn is driven by shallow (<170 km) spinel-rich cumulates without a mid-mantle garnet barrier.
利用InSight约束的地幔深度（1560 km）和低铁成分（~13.7 wt% FeO）实验模拟了火星岩浆洋的完整凝固过程。
证实岩浆洋晚期结晶可直接形成约32公里厚、以斜长石和β-石英为主的浮力原始地壳。
表明橄榄石-瓦兹利石相变发生在13至16 GPa之间，不形成林伍德石或布里奇曼石，与约1006 km处的地震不连续面一致。
重新定义了凝固后的地幔密度剖面，表明地幔翻转由浅部（<170 km）富尖晶石堆晶驱动，且不存在中地幔石榴石阻挡层。
me: Two-stage crystallization experimental approach: equilibrium crystallization up to ~50% solidification (PCS), followed by stepwise fractional crystallization up to 99.4 PCS.
High-pressure, high-temperature double-Pt capsule experiments (1 atm to 16 GPa, 750°C to 1700°C) using multi-anvil, cubic, and piston-cylinder presses.
Oxygen fugacity buffering using magnetite-hematite (MH) outer capsules and quantification via Ir-Fe alloy sliding redox sensors.
Phase characterization via Electron Microprobe Analysis (EMPA), Raman spectroscopy, and thermodynamic modeling (MAGEMin) for the final 1% melt.
两阶段结晶实验方法：前~50%凝固度（PCS）采用平衡结晶，随后逐步进行分异结晶直至99.4 PCS。
利用多面顶压机、六面顶压机和活塞圆筒压机开展高温高压双铂金样品仓实验（1 atm至16 GPa，750°C至1700°C）。
使用磁铁矿-赤铁矿（MH）外仓缓冲氧逸度，并通过铱-铁合金氧化还原传感器定量标定氧逸度。
利用电子探针（EMPA）、拉曼光谱进行物相表征，并使用MAGEMin热力学软件模拟最后1%熔体的结晶。
de: Synthetic Martian mantle starting oxide mixtures based on InSight geophysical inversions (Khan et al., 2022) in the Si-Al-Fe-Mg-Ca-Na-V-O system.
Six experimental crystallization steps (M1 to M6) spanning 0–18.0 GPa and 750–1600°C, plus four Ir-bearing sensor runs.
High-temperature, ambient-pressure mineral density calculations to evaluate Rayleigh-Taylor gravitational instabilities across the 1560-km mantle column.
基于InSight地球物理反演结果（Khan et al., 2022）配制的Si-Al-Fe-Mg-Ca-Na-V-O体系合成火星地幔初始氧化物混合物。
涵盖0–18.0 GPa和750–1600°C的六个实验结晶步骤（M1至M6），以及四组含铱传感器的氧逸度标定实验。
开展高温常压矿物密度计算，以评估1560公里地幔柱中的瑞利-泰勒重力不稳定性。
li: The starting chemical composition omits minor elements Cr and Ti, which could affect spinel-group mineral stability and late-stage ilmenite formation.
The magma ocean is assumed to be strictly isothermal with depth during each crystallization step as a first-order approximation of vigorous convection.
Perfect equilibrium crystallization is assumed up to exactly 50 PCS, neglecting potential early crystal fractionation in the deepest magma ocean.
初始化学成分未包含微量元素Cr和Ti，这可能影响尖晶石族矿物的稳定性和晚期钛铁矿的形成。
作为剧烈对流的一阶近似，假设岩浆洋在每个结晶步骤中随深度保持严格等温。
假设在50 PCS之前为完全平衡结晶，忽略了最深部岩浆洋中可能发生的早期晶体分异。

tm.why: The paper investigates the mineralogical layering, density structure, protocrust formation, and mantle overturn dynamics of Mars using high-pressure laboratory experiments.
The experimental starting composition and magma ocean depth (1560 km) are directly constrained by recent Mars InSight seismic observations of the core-mantle boundary and mantle discontinuities.

sum: SeismicFlow is presented as the first production-grade, Python-native GUI platform for integrated geoscience workflows. It bridges the gap between Python-based algorithmic innovation and legacy compiled-language (C++/C#) industry platforms. Built on the Python scientific ecosystem (NumPy, PyTorch, TensorFlow, VTK, and scikit-learn), it enables direct application of advanced methods to industry-scale 3D seismic and well data. The platform's efficacy is demonstrated through integrated machine learning workflows for fault/zone segmentation, denoising, and petrophysical regression, achieving performance consistent with original studies.
SeismicFlow是首个面向集成地球科学工作流的生产级Python原生GUI平台。它弥补了Python算法创新与传统C++/C#工业软件之间的差距。该平台基于Python科学计算生态（NumPy、PyTorch、TensorFlow、VTK和scikit-learn）构建，支持将先进算法直接应用……

集成NumPy、PyTorch、TensorFlow、VTK和scikit-learn的Python原生GUI平台，用于…
Real-world 3D seismic volumes and production well logs used for validation.

Achieved R², RMSE, and F1-scores consistent with original studies across fault segmentation, denoising, and petrophysical regression.
在断层分割、去噪和岩石物理回归中获得了与原始研究一致的R²、RMSE和F1分数。
Potential performance bottlenecks of Python-native execution compared to legacy compiled architectures, though not explicitly detailed in the abstract.
与传统编译架构相比，Python原生执行可能存在潜在的性能瓶颈（摘要中未详细说明）。
First production-grade Python-native GUI platform that eliminates the reimplementation friction of deploying Python algorithms into legacy C++/C# systems.

Integrated major Python scientific and ML libraries (PyTorch, TensorFlow, VTK) into a unified interactive environment.
Demonstrated seamless deployment of deep learning workflows on real-world 3D seismic and well log datasets.
开发了SeismicFlow，这是首个用于地下介质分析的生产级Python原生GUI平台。
将主要的Python科学计算与机器学习库（PyTorch、TensorFlow、VTK）集成到统一的交互式环境中。

Integration of scientific libraries (NumPy, scikit-learn, VTK) and deep learning frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow).

sum: Distinguishing tectonic fault gouges from gravitational landslide slip zones is challenging because both form similar clay-rich microstructures. However, tectonic faults often undergo deformation reversals across earthquake cycles, whereas landslides experience unidirectional downslope loading. This study tests how shear reversal is recorded in clay-rich microfabrics using direct-shear experiments on undisturbed and slurry samples from the Jin'nosuke-dani landslide, Japan, under normal stresses of 0.4, 0.8, and 1.6 MPa across ten alternating shear cycles. Post-experiment analyses combining scanning electron microscopy (SEM), synchrotron radiation micro-X-ray computed tomography (SP-µCT), and anisotropy of magnetic susceptibility (AMS) reveal preferred clay orientations, rotated shale clasts, and a bulk Kmax oriented horizontally and perpendicular to the shear direction. These findings indicate that shear reversal rotates and overprints rather than erases earlier fabrics, generating a composite 'rotational fabric memory' that could help differentiate tectonic shear zones from gravitational landslides.
区分构造断层泥与重力滑坡滑动带颇具挑战。本研究采集日本甚之助谷滑坡富含粘土的原状与泥浆样品，在0.4、0.8和1.6 MPa法向应力下开展10次方向交替的直剪实验，结合扫描电镜（SEM）、同步辐射显微CT（SP-µCT）及磁化率各向异性（AMS）分析微观组构演化。结果显示变形样品具有粘土片优选取向、……

t: Pre-consolidated clay-rich specimens underwent ten alternating-direction direct-shear cycles under 0.4–1.6 MPa normal stresses, followed by multi-scale fabric analysis using SEM, 3D SP-µCT, and bulk AMS.
在0.4–1.6 MPa法向应力下对预固结粘土样品进行10次反向直剪循环，结合SEM、SP-µCT和AMS分析组构。

Water-saturated undisturbed and sieved slurry samples of sheared black shale and white clay (illite, kaolinite, chlorite, minor smectite) collected from the basal slip zone of the Jin'nosuke-dani landslide, Japan.
采自日本甚之助谷滑坡底滑带的含水原状与泥浆样品，含黑色页岩和白色粘土（伊利石、高岭石、绿泥石等）。

After ten reversal cycles, samples exhibit preferred clay orientations, rotated clasts, Khf/Klf ratios > 0.7, and a horizontal AMS Kmax perpendicular to the imposed shear direction, contrasting with shear-parallel natural Kmax.
10次反向剪切后样品具粘土优选取向和旋转碎屑，Khf/Klf>0.7，AMS的Kmax水平且垂直于剪切方向。
Microstructural and AMS observations were only made after all ten cycles completed, preventing resolution of cycle-by-cycle progressive fabric development, rotation, or partial erasure.
微观与磁组构测量仅在10次循环结束后进行，无法解析单次循环中的渐进演化与擦除。
Isolates the microstructural effect of repeated shear-direction reversal in clay-rich gouges, establishing the concept of 'rotational fabric memory' via combined SEM, SP-µCT, and AMS.
首次通过实验分离出反复反向剪切对粘土微组构的影响，结合多尺度观测提出“旋转组构记忆”概念。

kc: Demonstrated experimentally that repeated reversal shear in clay-rich materials produces a composite cumulative fabric ('fabric memory') rather than erasing prior deformation structures.
Combined multi-scale observations (2D SEM, 3D SP-µCT, and bulk AMS) to link localized clay-flake alignment and clast rotation with bulk magnetic fabrics.
Identified a horizontal Kmax orientation perpendicular to the imposed shear direction after reversal cycles, consistent with rotational rolling of gouge-like material.
Proposed a process-based microstructural hypothesis for distinguishing multi-cycle tectonic fault zones from unidirectional gravitational landslide slip zones.
通过实验证明富含粘土材料在反复反向剪切下会产生复合累积组构（“组构记忆”），而非简单抹去先前的变形结构。
结合多尺度观测（二维SEM、三维SP-µCT和体尺度AMS），将局部粘土片排列及碎屑旋转与体磁组构联系起来。
发现反向剪切循环后Kmax呈水平且垂直于施加的剪切方向，与断层泥状物质的旋转滚动机制一致。
提出了一种基于过程的微观组构假说，用于区分经历多周期变形的构造断层带与单向滑动的重力滑坡带。
me: Single-plane direct-shear experiments with 1000 min pre-consolidation and ten alternating-direction shear cycles under 0.4, 0.8, and 1.6 MPa normal stresses.
Freeze-drying and Quetol 651 resin embedding of wet deformed clay specimens to preserve microfabric without drying shrinkage.
Two-dimensional microstructural imaging via scanning electron microscopy (SEM) at 15 kV and ~80 µA.
Three-dimensional internal fabric characterization via synchrotron radiation micro-X-ray computed tomography (SP-µCT) at SPring-8 (25 keV).
Bulk magnetic fabric and paramagnetic contribution analysis using Anisotropy of Magnetic Susceptibility (AMS) and high-field/low-field susceptibility ratios (Khf/Klf).
在0.4、0.8和1.6 MPa法向应力下进行预固结1000分钟及10次方向交替的单平面直剪实验。
采用冷冻干燥和Quetol 651树脂包埋含水变形粘土样品，防止干燥收缩破坏微观组构。
利用扫描电子显微镜（SEM，15 kV，约80 µA）进行二维微观结构成像。
利用SPring-8同步辐射显微X射线计算机断层扫描（SP-µCT，25 keV）表征三维内部组构。
利用磁化率各向异性（AMS）及高低场磁化率比值（Khf/Klf）分析体磁组构及顺磁性矿物贡献。
de: Undisturbed and 250-µm-sieved slurry samples of sheared black shale and white clay from the active basal slip zone of the Jin'nosuke-dani landslide, central Japan.
X-ray diffraction (XRD) and particle-size characterization showing illite, kaolinite, chlorite, and minor smectite.
Continuous mechanical recordings of shear stress and vertical displacement across ten reversal cycles.
Post-experimental SEM micrographs, 3D SP-µCT volumes (0.5 × 0.5 × 2 mm), and AMS principal axis orientations compared against natural slip-zone reference fabrics.
采自日本中部甚之助谷滑坡活动底滑带的剪切黑色页岩与白色粘土的原状样及250微米过筛泥浆样。
X射线衍射（XRD）与粒度表征数据，显示主要粘土矿物为伊利石、高岭石、绿泥石及少量蒙脱石。
10次反向剪切循环期间剪应力与垂直位移的连续力学记录。
实验后样品的SEM显微图像、SP-µCT三维体数据（0.5 × 0.5 × 2 mm）及AMS主轴取向，并与天然滑动带参考组构对比。
li: SEM, SP-µCT, and AMS measurements were performed only at the end of ten cycles, leaving cycle-by-cycle progressive fabric evolution and partial erasure unresolved.
Laboratory shear displacement rates are several orders of magnitude faster than the natural Jin'nosuke-dani landslide creep rate (~5 cm/yr).
Experiments were conducted solely on landslide-derived materials, so uniqueness of the rotational fabric to tectonic faults remains an unverified hypothesis.
AMS is an indirect bulk proxy that may include non-clay magnetic carriers rather than directly measuring individual clay-particle long axes.
SEM、SP-µCT和AMS测量仅在10次循环结束后进行，未能解析逐周期的渐进组构演化与部分擦除过程。
实验室剪切位移速率比甚之助谷滑坡天然蠕滑速率（约5 cm/yr）快几个数量级。
实验仅使用滑坡来源物质，旋转组构是否为构造断层所特有仍是有待验证的假说。
AMS是间接的体尺度指标，可能包含非粘土磁性载体的贡献，不能直接测量单个粘土颗粒的长轴。

tm.why: The study investigates the frictional mechanical response and microstructural evolution of clay-rich fault gouge/slip-zone materials under repeated reversal direct-shear experiments relevant to earthquake cycles.
The experimental samples are collected from the basal slip zone of the active Jin'nosuke-dani gravitational landslide to help distinguish tectonic fault zones from landslide slip zones.

sum: This article provides a comprehensive review of the 2025 SEG-DGS Workshop on Full-waveform Inversion (FWI) for Land and Shallow-water data, highlighting key advancements in FWI, artificial intelligence (AI), and high-performance computing (HPC). It outlines how these computational innovations are transforming seismic imaging and sets the stage for the upcoming SEG SIGHT Symposium in 2026.
本文回顾了2025年SEG-DGS陆上与浅水全波形反演（FWI）研讨会的核心成果。文章重点讨论了全波形反演、人工智能（AI）以及高性能计算（HPC）在地震成像中的最新进展与融合。这些计算创新正在重塑地球物理成像技术，并为2026年SEG SIGHT专题研讨会奠定了讨论基础。
