sum: Historical and paleoseismic records in the Central Apennines are shorter than the recurrence intervals of major normal-fault earthquakes. This study applies the quasi-dynamic boundary-element simulator MCQsim to a 3-D model of 42 major active normal faults from the Fault2SHA database, generating seven 100,000-year synthetic earthquake catalogs. By systematically varying dynamic friction, fractal fault strength heterogeneity (correlation length and water-level cutoff), and mesh resolution (500 m vs. 1000 m), the authors evaluate impacts on magnitude-frequency distributions (MFDs), rupture scaling, and interevent times. The synthetic catalogs closely match the observed CPTI15 catalog MFD and Leonard (2010) empirical rupture-scaling relations. Results demonstrate that the static-to-dynamic friction difference and the fractal strength water-level cutoff are the primary controls on seismic productivity and maximum magnitude. Furthermore, interevent time analysis for Mw >= 6 events reveals quasi-periodic recurrence alongside multi-centennial clustering, offering a physics-based foundation for time-dependent seismic hazard assessment.
针对意大利中亚平宁山脉历史地震记录短于大震复发周期的局限，本研究利用基于边界元法的准动态地震周期模拟器MCQsim，基于Fault2SHA数据库的42条主要活动正断层构建三维模型，通过系统改变动摩擦系数、分形断层强度异质性及网格分辨率，生成了7个十万年合成地震目录。合成目录成功重现了CPTI15观测……

t: Applies the BEM-based quasi-dynamic simulator MCQsim with linear slip-weakening friction and a fractal fault strength field to generate seven 100-kyr synthetic earthquake catalogs across 42 3-D normal faults.
应用基于边界元法的准动态模拟器MCQsim，结合线性滑移弱化与分形强度场，生成42条三维正断层的7个十万年合成地震目录。

Fault surface traces and long-term geological/geodetic slip rates for 42 major active normal faults are taken from the Fault2SHA Central Apennines Database and compared against the CPTI15 historical catalog.
采用Fault2SHA数据库的42条主要活动正断层地表迹线与长期地质/大地测量滑移率，并与CPTI15历史地震目录进行对…

Catalogs reproduce CPTI15 magnitude-frequency distributions and Leonard (2010) scaling for Mw > 5.2. Full-catalog Mw >= 6 interevent time COV is ~0.9, while 691-yr windows fluctuate between 0.7-0.9 and >1.
重现了CPTI15震级-频度分布及Mw>5.2的标度律；全目录Mw≥6复发间隔COV约为0.9，691年时间窗内COV在…
Adopts a uniform 65-degree fault dip, single mean slip rate per fault, and quasi-static elastostatic stress transfer without dynamic wave propagation, rate-dependent friction, or fluid effects.
采用统一的65度断层倾角、单一平均滑移率及准静态弹性静力学应力传递，未包含动态波传播、速率相关摩擦及流体效应。
First systematic exploration of 3-D fractal fault strength heterogeneity and friction drop controls on 100-kyr multi-fault seismic cycles and temporal clustering in the Central Apennines.
首次系统探究三维分形断层强度异质性与摩擦降对中亚平宁山脉十万年多断层地震周期及时间群发的控制作用。

kc: Generated seven 100,000-year physics-based synthetic earthquake catalogs for 42 active normal faults in the Central Apennines using MCQsim.
Demonstrated that static-dynamic friction differences and fractal strength water-level cutoffs are first-order controls on maximum magnitude and seismic productivity.
Validated synthetic catalogs against the historical CPTI15 catalog and Leonard (2010) empirical scaling relations for slip and rupture area.
Revealed that Mw >= 6 recurrence exhibits non-Poissonian behavior, fluctuating between quasi-periodic spacing and multi-centennial temporal clustering depending on observation window length.
利用MCQsim为中亚平宁山脉42条活动正断层生成了7个十万年尺度的基于物理的合成地震目录。
证明了静动摩擦系数差和分形强度水准截断阈值是控制最大震级和地震生产率的一阶主导因素。
通过对比历史CPTI15目录和Leonard（2010）滑动量与破裂面积经验标度关系，验证了合成目录的可靠性。
揭示了Mw≥6级地震复发呈非泊松特征，随观测时间窗长度在准周期复发与多百年尺度时间群发之间波动。
me: Quasi-dynamic 3-D multi-cycle earthquake simulation using the Boundary Element Method (MCQsim) with triangular dislocation elements.
Tectonic loading prescribed via the backslip method with iterative elastic stress redistribution to taper slip rates at fault boundaries.
Linear slip-weakening friction law coupled with a spatially heterogeneous 2-D fractal fault strength field controlled by correlation length and water-level percentile cutoff.
Statistical benchmarking against observed catalogs using 720-year overlapping sub-catalogs and 691-year moving windows for Coefficient of Variation (COV) analysis.
采用基于三角形位错元边界元法的准动态三维多周期地震模拟器（MCQsim）。
通过后滑（backslip）方法施加构造加载，并利用迭代弹性应力重分布使断层边界滑移率自然衰减。
结合线性滑移弱化摩擦定律与受相关长度和水准百分位截断阈值控制的空间异质性分形断层强度场。
使用720年重叠子目录与691年滑动时间窗计算变异系数（COV），与观测目录进行统计基准对比。
de: 3-D fault geometries and long-term geological/geodetic slip rates for 42 major active normal faults derived from the Fault2SHA Central Apennines Database.
Seven 100,000-year simulation setups (M1-M7) varying friction drop (0.03 vs 0.06), correlation length (0.5, 1, 5 km), water-level cutoff (0%, 15%, 30%), and mesh size (500 m vs 1000 m).
Historical seismicity records from the Italian Parametric Earthquake Catalog (CPTI15, covering 1005-2020 CE) and empirical scaling laws from Leonard (2010).
源自Fault2SHA中亚平宁山脉数据库的42条主要活动正断层的三维断层几何结构及长期地质/大地测量滑移率。
7组十万年模拟实验（M1-M7），测试摩擦降（0.03与0.06）、相关长度（0.5、1、5 km）、水准截断（0%、15%、30%）及网格尺寸（500 m与1000 m）。
意大利参数地震目录（CPTI15，涵盖公元1005-2020年）的历史地震记录及Leonard（2010）经验标度律。
li: Assigned a uniform 65-degree dip angle and simplified planar geometry with depth rather than realistic listric or depth-varying fault geometries.
Used an elastostatic stress-transfer formulation that assumes instantaneous stress redistribution and omits fully dynamic wave-mediated rupture effects.
Omitted background seismicity, blind faults, antithetic/thrust faults, rate-and-state friction, and pore-fluid processes.
Scaled critical slip distance (Dc) with mesh element size, which inflates fracture energy in the coarser 1000 m mesh and artificially suppresses multi-patch cascading.
采用统一的65度倾角和简化的随深度平面几何模型，未包含真实的铲状或随深度变化的断层几何形态。
采用弹性静力学应力传递公式，假设应力瞬时重分布，忽略了完全动态的波传播介导破裂效应。
忽略了背景地震活动、隐伏断层、反向/逆冲断层、速率-状态摩擦以及孔隙流体过程。
临界滑移距离（Dc）随网格单元尺寸缩放，导致1000 m粗网格中的断裂能偏高并人为抑制了多斑块级联破裂。

tm.why: The study simulates multi-cycle rupture propagation, stress drop, and cascading ruptures across a 3-D fault network using a boundary element physics-based simulator.
The paper systematically investigates how frictional parameters, linear slip-weakening, and fractal fault strength heterogeneity control seismic cycles and fault interactions.
The simulated 100,000-year earthquake catalogs evaluate non-Poissonian recurrence, temporal clustering, and maximum magnitudes to inform fault-based probabilistic seismic hazard assessment.

ev.notes: Full 29-page manuscript PDF (GJI advance article) including all text sections, equations, Tables 1-2, and Figures 1-8 used for analysis.

sum: This study develops an adiabatic two-mode theory and practical processing workflow to measure quasi-Rayleigh and quasi-Love wave polarization from the nine-component ambient noise cross-correlation tensor, even when the two wave types overlap in time. By introducing a Phase 3 empirical source-group normalization using diagonal carrier spectra (TT, ZZ), the method removes source-related amplitude biases and establishes linear relations between carrier and off-diagonal polarization-sensitive (TZ, ZT) waveforms. This allows joint estimation of local polarization parameters at both station endpoints. SPECFEM numerical benchmarks distinguish forward-theory breakdown under nonadiabatic rapid structural variations from parameter trade-offs caused by carrier waveform similarity. Applied to 20–30 s ambient noise data in Alaska, short paths south of the Denali Fault yield consistent local polarization estimates, whereas fault-crossing paths exhibit nonadiabatic boundary transients. Crucially, adding a single polarization constraint to azimuthal phase-speed inversions resolves the symmetry-axis dip orientation ambiguity in tilted transversely isotropic media.
本文提出了从九分量背景噪声互相关张量中测量准瑞利波和准勒夫波偏振的绝热双模理论与实用方法。通过引入基于对角载波（TT、ZZ）振幅谱的经验源组归一化，消除了噪声源分布引起的振幅偏差，建立了载波与非对角偏振敏感分量（TZ、ZT）之间的线性关系，实现了台站对两端局部偏振参数的联合估计。SPECFEM数值基……

t: Develops a two-mode adiabatic theory and three-phase processing workflow using empirical source-group normalization of TT and ZZ carrier spectra to jointly fit TZ and ZT waveforms for endpoint polarization parameters.
建立双模绝热理论与三阶段处理流程，利用TT和ZZ载波谱经验源组归一化联合拟合TZ和ZT波形。
Uses 3D SPECFEM synthetic Green tensors at 20 and 50 s periods and 20–30 s nine-component ambient noise cross-correlations from 29 quality-controlled station pairs anchored at AK-CNP in Alaska.
采用20和50 s三维SPECFEM合成数据，以及阿拉斯加AK-CNP参考台29个台站对20–30 s九分量互相关数据。

Short paths (<450 km) south of the Denali Fault yield coherent polarization estimates (mean Gamma_ref ~0.25, Gamma_fld ~0.35), while adding Gamma_ref ~0.3 to phase-speed inversion resolves TTI dip nonuniqueness.
断层以南短路径(<450 km)偏振估计一致(均值约0.25和0.35)；加入偏振约束消除了TTI倾角方向多解性。

Strong structural boundaries cause nonadiabatic mode conversion and boundary transients that violate local interpretability, while correlated TT and ZZ carrier waveforms cause poor conditioning and parameter trade-offs.
强构造边界产生非绝热边界瞬态破坏局部可解释性；TT和ZZ波形相似会导致反演病态与参数折衷。

First formulation and observational demonstration of source-group-normalized ambient noise cross-correlation polarization that jointly estimates distinct endpoint quasi-Rayleigh and quasi-Love polarizations and links them directly to the elastic tensor.
首次建立源组归一化背景噪声面波偏振理论与实测方法，直接关联弹性张量并联合估计两端偏振参数。

kc: Formulated a two-mode adiabatic theory linking the source-group-normalized nine-component ambient noise cross-correlation tensor directly to depth integrals of the anisotropic elastic tensor.

Introduced an empirical frequency-domain source-group normalization (Phase 3 processing) using TT and ZZ carrier spectra to remove unknown noise source-strength factors while preserving relative component amplitudes.
Demonstrated via SPECFEM numerical benchmarks how to separate inference conditioning trade-offs (due to TT and ZZ waveform correlation) from nonadiabatic mode-conversion breakdown.

Presented the first ambient noise surface-wave polarization measurements in Alaska (20–30 s), identifying locally interpretable estimates south of the Denali Fault and boundary transients across the fault.
Showed that adding a single polarization measurement to Rayleigh and Love 2psi and 4psi phase-speed inversions resolves the two-fold dip-orientation ambiguity of the TTI symmetry axis.
建立了双模绝热理论，将源组归一化后的九分量背景噪声互相关张量直接与各向异性弹性张量的深度积分联系起来。
提出了利用TT和ZZ载波谱的频率域经验源组归一化方法（第三阶段处理），在保留分量相对振幅的同时消除了未知的噪声源强度因子。
通过SPECFEM数值基准测试，阐明了如何区分由TT和ZZ波形相关性引起的反演病态折衷与非绝热模式转换导致的正演理论失效。
给出了阿拉斯加地区（20–30 s）首个背景噪声面波偏振测量结果，识别出德纳里断层以南局部可解释的偏振估计以及跨断层路径的边界瞬态效应。
证明了在瑞利波和勒夫波2ψ与4ψ相速度反演中加入单个偏振测量约束，即可消除TTI对称轴倾角方向的双向多解性。
me: Adiabatic modal Green tensor derivation and two-mode weak-mixing perturbation theory in X-dominant and E-dominant limiting regimes.
Three-phase ambient noise processing preserving relative 3-component amplitudes, culminating in narrow-band frequency-domain empirical source-group normalization.
Two-parameter grid-search waveform fitting of TZ and ZT components using TT and ZZ carrier waveforms to jointly estimate reference and field station polarization parameters.
3D spectral-element (SPECFEM) synthetic benchmarking across homogeneous, slowly varying, rapidly varying, and sharp-discontinuity anisotropic models.
Joint Bayesian inversion of Rayleigh- and Love-wave azimuthal phase speeds and surface-wave polarization for crust and upper-mantle TTI structure.
绝热模态格林张量推导以及在X主导和E主导极限状态下的双模弱混合微扰理论。
保留三分量相对振幅的三阶段背景噪声处理流程，核心为窄带频率域经验源组归一化。
利用TT和ZZ载波波形对TZ和ZT分量进行双参数网格搜索波形拟合，联合估计参考台站和场台站的偏振参数。
在均匀、缓慢变化、快速变化和尖锐间断各向异性模型中进行三维谱元法（SPECFEM）合成基准测试。
结合瑞利波和勒夫波方位各向异性相速度与面波偏振的地壳上地幔TTI结构联合贝叶斯反演。
de: 3D SPECFEM synthetic Green tensors computed at 20 s and 50 s periods on a 5-km grid (up to 3000 km distance and 200 km depth) for stair-step and sharp-boundary anisotropic models.
Continuous three-component ambient noise records in Alaska centered on reference station AK-CNP (Kenai Peninsula) paired with field stations at 20–40 degrees azimuth in the 20–30 s period band.
Joint inversion test at station AK-CNP combining 25 s polarization estimates with previously measured Rayleigh and Love 2psi and 4psi phase-speed dispersion curves.
针对阶梯状变化和尖锐边界各向异性模型，在5 km网格（距离达3000 km、深度200 km）上计算的20 s和50 s周期三维SPECFEM合成格林张量。
以基奈半岛AK-CNP为参考台站、北偏东20°–40°方位角内的台站为场台站的阿拉斯加连续三分量背景噪声记录（20–30 s周期频带）。
在AK-CNP台站结合25 s偏振估计值与已有的瑞利波和勒夫波2ψ及4ψ相速度频散曲线进行的联合反演实验。
li: Local interpretability breaks down when surface waves cross sharp structural boundaries (such as the Denali Fault), generating downstream nonadiabatic boundary transients.
Joint recovery of the two endpoint polarization parameters becomes poorly conditioned when TT and ZZ carrier waveforms are strongly correlated or anti-correlated over the signal window.
The empirical source-group normalization is an approximation to the theoretical normalization and introduces unquantified uncertainty into the polarization estimates.
The first-order weak-mixing two-mode theory neglects overtone contributions, reflected waves, and higher-order residuals outside the fundamental Rayleigh-Love subspace.
当面波穿过尖锐构造边界（如德纳里断层）时，会产生下游非绝热边界瞬态效应，导致偏振参数的局部可解释性失效。
当信号窗口内的TT和ZZ载波波形高度相关或反相关时，两个端点偏振参数的联合反演会变得病态。
经验源组归一化是对理论归一化的近似，会给偏振参数估计带来未完全量化的不确定性。
一阶弱混合双模理论忽略了高阶面波（泛音）贡献、反射波以及基阶瑞利-勒夫子空间之外的高阶残差。

tm.why: The paper develops an adiabatic theory and methodology for measuring and interpreting quasi-Rayleigh and quasi-Love wave polarization in generally anisotropic media, linking polarization directly to the elastic tensor and resolving TTI dip orientation ambiguities.
The entire observational framework extracts surface-wave polarization from the nine-component ambient noise cross-correlation tensor using a novel empirical source-group normalization.
The method is applied to Alaska ambient noise data across the Denali Fault to constrain three-dimensional anisotropic fabric in the crust and uppermost mantle.

ev.notes: Evaluated using the complete 83-page preprint PDF (including main text, Figures 1–21, Appendix A theoretical derivations, and Supplementary Materials S.1–S.3).

sum: This study investigates far-field postseismic deformation in the Korean Peninsula (KP) and East Sea over 11 years following the 2011 Mw 9.0 Tohoku-Oki earthquake. Using simulated annealing and non-negative least squares inversion on decadal horizontal GNSS time series (2008–2022) from 45 stations, the authors separate a ~2-year transient component (τ1 ≈ 0.56 yr) from a steady-state component persisting through 2022 (τ2 ≈ 16.27 yr). They integrate these observations into a 3D spherical finite-element viscoelastic model (PyLith) featuring Burgers rheology, realistic lithosphere-asthenosphere boundary geometry, and a low-viscosity back-arc mantle defined from seismic S-wave velocity anomalies (-3%). The modeling constrains continental asthenosphere viscosity to 2–8 × 10^18 Pa·s, with the back-arc mantle viscosity up to two orders of magnitude lower (ratio down to 0.04, optimal at 0.09). Novelty lies in demonstrating that the weak back-arc mantle accelerates early transient stress transmission into the continental interior, while the continental asthenosphere governs multi-decadal relaxation.
本研究探讨了2011年Mw 9.0日本东北大地震后朝鲜半岛及东海的远场震后形变。通过对45个GNSS台站十年水平位移时间序列（2008–2022）进行模拟退火与非负最小二乘反演，分离出持续约2年的瞬态分量和持续至2022年的稳态分量。结合地震S波低速异常构建三维球壳黏弹性有限元模型（PyLith），……

t: Simulated annealing and non-negative least squares inversion of GNSS time-series for double-exponential relaxation parameters, combined with 3D spherical PyLith finite-element viscoelastic modeling using Burgers rheology.
结合模拟退火与非负最小二乘GNSS时间序列双指数反演，及基于Burgers流变学的PyLith三维球壳有限元黏弹性模拟。

Horizontal GNSS displacement time-series from 45 stations across the Korean Peninsula and Ulleung Island (March 2008 to March 2022), plus 580 GEONET and 5 seafloor GNSS-A stations for coseismic validation.
朝鲜半岛及郁陵岛45个台站2008–2022年水平GNSS时间序列，以及用于同震验证的580个日本陆地站和5个海底站数据…
Postseismic relaxation exhibits median timescales τ1 = 0.56 yr and τ2 = 16.27 yr (α = 0.88). Minimum-RRMSE (~0.24) 3D modeling yields ηCA = 5 × 10^18 Pa·s and back-arc viscosity ratio ηBM/ηCA = 0.09.
中位松弛时间为τ1=0.56年和τ2=16.27年（α=0.88）；最优三维模型（RRMSE~0.24）得大陆软流圈黏度…

The model assumes a spatially uniform low viscosity for the East Sea back-arc mantle, ignoring sub-basin thermal and structural heterogeneities, and lacks dense empirical stress measurements to validate stress recovery.
将东海弧后地幔简化为均匀低黏度体，忽略了次级海盆横向异质性，且缺乏密集实测应力数据验证长期应力恢复。

Integrates decadal far-field GNSS inversions with a 3D spherical viscoelastic model containing a seismically defined 3D back-arc mantle (~800 km wide) to separate transient back-arc and steady-state continental asthenospheric controls.
首次将十年远场GNSS反演与含地震学约束的三维弧后地幔球壳黏弹性模型结合，区分了弧后瞬态与大陆稳态控制机制。

kc: Extracted 11-year postseismic horizontal displacements across 45 GNSS stations in the Korean Peninsula and East Sea using a double-exponential Burgers model via simulated annealing and non-negative least squares.
Developed a 3D spherical viscoelastic finite-element model incorporating realistic LAB depths and a seismically constrained 3D low-viscosity back-arc mantle beneath the East Sea.
Constrained the continental asthenosphere steady-state viscosity to 2–8 × 10^18 Pa·s and the back-arc mantle viscosity ratio down to 0.04–0.09 (minimum RRMSE at ηCA = 5 × 10^18 Pa·s, ηBM/ηCA = 0.09).

Demonstrated that the low-viscosity back-arc mantle amplifies early transient tensile stress perturbations (~25 kPa vs ~18 kPa at 5 km depth), whereas continental asthenosphere controls multi-decadal (~50 yr) stress recovery.
利用模拟退火和非负最小二乘法，采用双指数Burgers模型提取了朝鲜半岛和东海45个GNSS台站11年的震后水平位移。
建立了包含真实岩石圈-软流圈边界（LAB）深度和受地震学约束的东海三维低黏度弧后地幔的三维球壳黏弹性有限元模型。
将大陆软流圈稳态黏度约束在2–8 × 10^18 Pa·s，弧后地幔与软流圈黏度比低至0.04–0.09（最优模型为ηCA = 5 × 10^18 Pa·s，ηBM/ηCA = 0.09）。
证明低黏度弧后地幔放大了早期瞬态拉张应力扰动（5 km深度处约25 kPa对比均匀模型的18 kPa），而大陆软流圈控制数十年（约50年）的应力恢复。
me: Nonlinear time-series geodetic inversion combining Simulated Annealing (SA) and Non-Negative Least Squares (NNLS) with 100 parametric bootstrap realizations for double-exponential relaxation parameters.

3D spherical finite-element viscoelastic modeling using PyLith with Burgers rheology, Slab2 subduction geometry, LITHO1.0 + regional travel-time tomography LAB depths, and a seismically derived back-arc mantle zone.
结合模拟退火（SA）和非负最小二乘（NNLS）及100次参数自助法（bootstrap）重采样的非线性大地测量时间序列反演，用于求解双指数松弛参数。
使用PyLith进行三维球壳黏弹性有限元数值模拟，采用Burgers流变学、Slab2俯冲板片几何、LITHO1.0与区域层析成像融合的LAB深度以及由地震波速异常定义的弧后地幔低黏度区。
de: Horizontal GNSS displacement time-series from 45 stations in the Korean Peninsula and Ulleung Island (East Sea) spanning March 2008 to March 2022.
Coseismic slip model of the 2011 Mw 9.0 Tohoku-Oki earthquake constrained by 580 GEONET GNSS stations in Japan and 5 seafloor GNSS-Acoustic stations.

Lithosphere-asthenosphere boundary (LAB) structure combining global LITHO1.0 and regional teleseismic travel-time tomography beneath the Korean Peninsula, plus S2.9EA S-wave tomography (-3% anomaly) for the back-arc mantle.
朝鲜半岛和东海郁陵岛45个GNSS台站2008年3月至2022年3月的水平位移时间序列数据。
由日本580个GEONET陆地GNSS台站和5个海底GNSS-声学台站约束的2011年Mw 9.0日本东北大地震同震滑动分布模型。
融合全球LITHO1.0模型与朝鲜半岛远震走时层析成像的LAB深度模型，以及用于定义弧后地幔的S2.9EA剪切波层析成像模型（-3%低速异常）。
li: The numerical model assigns a spatially uniform low viscosity to the back-arc mantle beneath the East Sea, neglecting internal lateral heterogeneities across its three sub-basins (Ulleung, Yamato, and Japan basins) and crustal fragments.
Direct quantitative validation of the simulated multi-decadal lithospheric stress evolution is limited by the sparse spatial and temporal distribution of empirical in-situ stress measurements.
Explicit afterslip modeling was excluded, assuming far-field (>1000 km) deformation is purely dominated by viscoelastic relaxation.
数值模型对东海下方的弧后地幔赋予了空间均匀的低黏度，忽略了其内部三个次级海盆（郁陵、大和、日本海盆）及陆壳残块之间的横向流变异质性。
由于原位应力实测数据在时空分布上的稀疏性，对模拟所得数十年尺度岩石圈应力演化的直接定量验证仍受限。
模型未包含显式的震后余滑（afterslip），假设超过1000公里的远场形变完全由黏弹性松弛主导。

tm.why: The paper constrains upper mantle and asthenosphere viscosity structure and viscoelastic geodynamics beneath the East Sea and Korean Peninsula using 3D numerical modeling and GNSS observations.

The study investigates postseismic viscoelastic relaxation, stress transfer, and multi-decadal tectonic stress recovery on continental intraplate faults following the 2011 Mw 9.0 Tohoku-Oki megathrust earthquake.

ev.notes: Full 12-page PDF analyzed, including text, equations, all 8 main figures, and references to supplementary material.

sum: This paper addresses the long-standing discrepancy between low geodynamically inferred lithosphere-asthenosphere friction (0.01-0.03) and high laboratory Byerlee friction (0.6-0.85). The author proposes the 'Interface Selection Principle,' which posits that tectonic systems vertically select the sliding interface with the minimum shear resistance. This mechanism renders macroscopic friction an emergent, velocity-dependent system property rather than a static material constant. The framework incorporates creep shear and relaxation-time effects, showing that friction decreases with plate velocity. This theory suggests that asthenospheric friction may be lower than previously thought, while subduction megathrust friction might be underestimated, offering a first-principles derivation to replace empirical fitting parameters.
本文解决低地球动力学反演摩擦与高实验室拜尔利摩擦的长期矛盾。提出“界面选择原理”，即系统在垂直方向选择剪切阻力最小的界面滑动，使宏观摩擦成为随速度变化的涌现特征而非材料常数。该框架结合蠕变与松弛效应，表明摩擦随速度降低而减小，指出软流圈摩擦可能被高估而俯冲带摩擦被低估。

t: Analytical formulation of the Interface Selection Principle, selecting the vertical interface with minimum shear resistance as the active sliding surface.
解析构建界面选择原理，选择垂直方向上剪切阻力最小的界面作为活动滑动面。
Literature-derived friction coefficients from geodynamic inversions (0.01-0.03) and laboratory rock experiments (0.6-0.85).
来自文献的地球动力学反演摩擦系数（0.01-0.03）和实验室岩石实验数据（0.6-0.85）。
Demonstrates that macroscopic friction is an emergent, velocity-dependent property, potentially overestimating asthenospheric friction and underestimating subduction megathrust friction.
表明宏观摩擦是随速度变化的涌现特征，指出软流圈摩擦可能被高估，俯冲带摩擦可能被低估。
The proposed principle is theoretical and lacks direct observational or high-resolution numerical simulation validation in this paper.
该原理目前主要为理论推导，缺乏直接的观测或高分辨率数值模拟验证。
Shifts the view of macroscopic friction from a static material constant to an emergent system property governed by interface selection.
将宏观摩擦的视角从静态材料常数转变为由界面选择控制的系统涌现特征。

kc: Proposes the Interface Selection Principle to resolve the discrepancy between geodynamic and laboratory friction values.
Identifies creep shear and relaxation-time paths as key velocity-dependent mechanisms reducing macroscopic resistance.
Suggests that asthenospheric friction may be overestimated and subduction megathrust friction underestimated in current models.
提出界面选择原理，解决了地球动力学反演与实验室测量摩擦值之间的长期矛盾。
确定了蠕变剪切和松弛时间路径是降低宏观阻力的关键速度相关机制。
指出当前模型中软流圈摩擦可能被高估，而俯冲带超大逆冲断层摩擦可能被低估。
me: Theoretical formulation of the Interface Selection Principle based on minimum shear resistance.
Analytical modeling of velocity-dependent friction through creep shear and relaxation-time pathways.
基于最小剪切阻力对界面选择原理进行理论公式化。
通过蠕变剪切和松弛时间路径对速度相关摩擦进行解析建模。
de: Comparison of theoretical predictions against geodynamic inversion estimates (0.01-0.03) and Byerlee's law (0.6-0.85).
将理论预测与地球动力学反演估计值（0.01-0.03）及拜尔利定律（0.6-0.85）进行对比。
li: The framework is primarily theoretical and requires validation with detailed numerical geodynamic models and observational data.
该框架主要处于理论阶段，需要通过详细的数值地球动力学模型和观测数据进行验证。

tm.why: The paper focuses on the physical mechanisms of macroscopic friction and sliding interfaces in plate tectonics.
The paper addresses the friction coefficient of the lithosphere-asthenosphere system and geodynamic inversions.

ev.notes: Analysis is based on the detailed abstract provided in the metadata, as no PDF was available.

sum: Following the 1886 Mount Tarawera eruption, New Zealand's White Terrace (Te Tarata) was long presumed destroyed or submerged beneath Lake Rotomahana. This study introduces the BLiSS four-way triangulation model, integrating abandoned 1960s engineering boreholes, high-resolution LiDAR digital elevation models, passive seismic horizontal-to-vertical spectral ratio (HVSR) profiling, and reconstructed 19th-century terrestrial surveys by Hochstetter and Martin. Calibrating Tromino HVSR acoustic impedance contrasts with nearby borehole refusal depths (BH1, BH4, BH5) reveals a laterally coherent subsurface boundary at 292–293 m above sea level, corresponding to the pre-eruption Rotomahana Basin floor. LiDAR geomorphology identifies two circular teardrop depressions and a 360 m topographic high point coinciding with the surveyed White Terrace spring coordinates and post-eruption fluid discharge paths. Combined with a first-order sinter mass estimate of 1.8–7.5 million tonnes, the results suggest the White Terrace survived largely in situ beneath tens of meters of hydrothermal ejecta.
1886年塔拉威拉火山喷发后，新西兰怀特阶地长期被认为已被摧毁或淹没。本研究提出BLiSS四维三角测量模型，整合了1960年代工程钻孔、高精度激光雷达（LiDAR）地形、被动源地震水平与垂直谱比（HVSR）剖面以及19世纪历史陆地测绘数据。通过将Tromino被动源HVSR波阻抗界面与钻孔拒钻深度进……

t: The BLiSS model integrates 1960s engineering boreholes, LiDAR digital elevation models, Tromino passive seismic HVSR depth conversion using a borehole-calibrated two-layer velocity model, and reconstructed 19th-century terrestrial surveys.
BLiSS模型整合了1960年代工程钻孔、LiDAR地形、钻孔标定的双层速度HVSR深度转换及19世纪历史陆地测绘。
Data comprise five 1960s hydroelectric boreholes (BH1–BH5), LINZ 1 m LiDAR DEMs, 12 Tromino HVSR stations along Line 3 plus Line 1, and Hochstetter (1859) and Martin (1885) survey maps.
数据包括5个1960年代水电钻孔、LINZ 1米LiDAR模型、测线3的12个Tromino测站及1859/1885年历…
Boreholes and two-layer HVSR conversion (Vs = 185–200 m/s over 400 m/s) converge on a regional pre-eruption horizon at 292–293 m asl, where the 1.8–7.4 Mt White Terrace sinter likely survives buried.
钻孔与双层HVSR速度转换一致揭示海拔292–293米存在喷发前基底，重达180–740万吨的怀特阶地可能原位幸存。
Archived HVSR field records and 1960s borehole cores were lost, preventing formal seismic reinversion, while prohibited field access precludes direct drilling or sampling of the inferred sinter.
原始HVSR野外记录与1960年代钻孔岩芯遗失导致无法正式反演，且现场禁入限制了直接钻探采样。

First four-way triangulation calibrating passive seismic HVSR with rediscovered 1960s engineering boreholes, high-resolution LiDAR, and Martin's 1887 map, alongside the first mass estimate of the White Terrace.
首次将被动源HVSR与1960年代工程钻孔、LiDAR及Martin(1887)地图进行四维标定，并首次估算怀特阶地质量…

kc: Develops the interdisciplinary BLiSS model combining boreholes, LiDAR, passive seismic HVSR, and historical surveys to resolve subsurface volcanic stratigraphy.
Calibrates a two-layer HVSR shear-wave velocity model (185–200 m/s shallow, 400 m/s deep) against engineering borehole refusal at 293 m asl.
Identifies surface geomorphic anomalies in LiDAR data (Sites One and Two, central gully, 360 m dome) aligning with the surveyed White Terrace coordinates.
Provides the first gross mass estimate of the White Terrace siliceous sinter deposit at 1.8–7.4 million tonnes (wet), arguing against total eruptive destruction.
开发了结合工程钻孔、LiDAR、被动源地震HVSR和历史测绘的跨学科BLiSS模型，以解析火山地下地层。
利用海拔293米处的工程钻孔拒钻深度，标定了双层HVSR剪切波速度模型（浅层185–200 m/s，深层400 m/s）。
在LiDAR数据中识别出与怀特阶地测绘坐标一致的地表地貌异常（1号和2号遗址、中央冲沟、360米穹隆）。
首次估算出怀特阶地硅华沉积物的湿重达180万至740万吨，从工程力学角度反驳了其被喷发完全摧毁的假说。
me: Four-way forensic triangulation (BLiSS model) across independent geological, topographic, geophysical, and historical cartographic datasets.
Passive seismic horizontal-to-vertical spectral ratio (HVSR) profiling using the quarter-wavelength approximation and a borehole-calibrated two-layer velocity model.
High-resolution LiDAR digital elevation model analysis (1 m DEM) and Google Earth Pro line-of-sight and elevation profiling.
Georeferencing and minimax error ellipse analysis of 1859 Hochstetter compass bearings and 1885 Martin survey maps, plus volumetric sinter mass calculation.
跨独立地质、地形、地球物理和历史制图数据集的四维取证三角测量（BLiSS模型）。
利用四分之一波长近似和钻孔标定的双层速度模型进行被动源地震水平与垂直谱比（HVSR）剖面分析。
高分辨率激光雷达数字高程模型分析（1米DEM）以及Google Earth Pro视距和高程剖面测量。
1859年Hochstetter罗盘方位角与1885年Martin测绘图的地理配准与误差椭圆分析，以及硅华体积质量计算。
de: Archived 1960s engineering boreholes (BH1–BH5) from the abandoned Rotorua Lakes Hydroelectric Scheme and Tarawera River entry boreholes.
Land Information New Zealand (LINZ) 1 m resolution LiDAR digital elevation models (2019–2022) and 2017 field reconnaissance observations.
Tromino passive seismic HVSR survey lines across the Lake Rotomahana overflow (Line 3, 12 stations) and Black Terrace Crater (Line 1).
Historical terrestrial survey records by Ferdinand Hochstetter (1859), August Petermann (1861), Josiah Martin (1885/1887), and Percy Smith (1886).
1960年代废弃的罗托鲁瓦湖水电工程历史钻孔数据（BH1–BH5）及塔拉威拉河口钻孔记录。
新西兰土地信息局（LINZ）1米分辨率LiDAR数字高程模型（2019–2022）及2017年野外踏勘观测。
跨越Rotomahana湖溢流口（测线3，12个测站）和黑阶地火山口（测线1）的Tromino被动源地震HVSR测线。
Hochstetter（1859）、Petermann（1861）、Martin（1885/1887）和Smith（1886）的历史陆地测绘档案。
li: Original 1960s drill cores and detailed logs were lost after 1988 privatization, and archived raw Tromino field records are unavailable for formal reinversion.
No research site access is currently permitted at Lake Rotomahana littoral, preventing direct ground-truthing, soil sampling, or targeted drilling at the White Terrace coordinates.
Sinter thickness lacks direct borehole constraints and relies on estimated accumulation rates, spanning a four-fold uncertainty range (21–70 m).
1960年代原始钻孔岩芯与详细记录在1988年私有化后遗失，且缺乏原始Tromino野外观测记录以进行正式反演。
目前Rotomahana湖滨研究区禁止进入，无法在怀特阶地坐标处开展直接实地验证、土壤采样或靶向钻探。
硅华厚度缺乏直接钻孔约束，仅依赖估算的沉积速率，导致存在四倍的不确定性范围（21–70米）。

tm.why: The study uses passive seismic HVSR along with LiDAR, boreholes, and historical surveys to map buried volcanic and hydrothermal stratigraphy at the 1886 Mount Tarawera eruption site in the Taupō Volcanic Zone.

Passive seismic horizontal-to-vertical spectral ratio (HVSR) exploration using microtremor/ambient vibrations is a core pillar of the four-way triangulation methodology to map subsurface acoustic impedance contrasts.

ev.notes: Full 24-page PDF article from Journal of Seismic Exploration (2026) was read and analyzed, including all 22 figures and 4 tables.

sum: This study investigates the structure and transport properties of supercritical SiO2-H2O fluids at 1500–3000 K, 1–10 GPa, and 0–80 wt% H2O using machine learning force fields (MLFF) and reactive force fields (ReaxFF). The authors find that water content primarily controls the silicate network structure, and the pressure dependence of transport properties reverses at 30–40 wt% H2O. They propose a modified Arrhenius equation for viscosity and quantify fluid ascent velocities. Along isotherms, ascent velocities reach up to 5.70e5 m/y, suggesting an 'isothermal acceleration' mechanism. At ocean island basalt (OIB) source depths, these fluids migrate 8.5–383 times faster than basaltic magma, providing quantitative evidence that supercritical fluids act as highly efficient carriers for high-field-strength elements (HFSE) in the mantle.
本研究利用机器学习力场（MLFF）和反应力场模拟了超临界SiO2-H2O流体。发现含水量主导硅酸盐网络结构，且输运性质的压力依赖性在30-40 wt% H2O处反转。研究提出了修正的粘度方程，发现流体沿等温线上升速度极快，揭示了“等温加速”机制。在OIB源区，该流体迁移速度是玄武质岩浆的8.5-38……

t: Molecular dynamics simulations of the SiO2-H2O system using machine learning force fields (MLFF) and reactive force fields (ReaxFF) to determine fluid structure and transport properties.
利用机器学习和反应力场对SiO2-H2O体系进行分子动力学模拟。
Simulated thermodynamic and transport data of supercritical SiO2-H2O fluids at 1500–3000 K, 1–10 GPa, and 0–80 wt% H2O.
在1500-3000K、1-10GPa及不同含水量下的超临界流体模拟数据。
Identified a transport property pressure-dependence reversal at 30–40 wt% H2O and calculated fluid ascent velocities up to 5.70e5 m/y, much faster than basaltic magma.
发现在30-40 wt% H2O处压力依赖性反转，流体上升速度极快。
The study is limited to a simplified SiO2-H2O binary system, which may not fully capture the complexity of multi-component natural fluids.
研究局限于简化的二元体系，未考虑天然多组分流体的复杂性。
First application of MLFF to systematically map supercritical SiO2-H2O transport properties, revealing an 'isothermal acceleration' mechanism and quantifying OIB fluid flux.
首次应用MLFF揭示了超临界流体等温加速机制并定量了其高迁移率。

kc: Quantified the structure and transport properties of supercritical SiO2-H2O fluids across a wide range of P-T-H2O conditions using MLFF and ReaxFF.
Discovered a reversal in the pressure dependence of transport properties at 30-40 wt% H2O, corresponding to the disappearance of compositional heterogeneity.
Proposed a modified Arrhenius equation for viscosity with excellent compositional scalability.
Demonstrated an 'isothermal acceleration' mechanism for fluid ascent in subduction zones and quantified high migration velocities at OIB source depths.

sum: This study evaluates the structural characteristics, seismic vulnerability, and sustainable retrofitting strategies for four traditional masonry building typologies in Oman: mud brick (adobe), dry-stone masonry, stone masonry with mud mortar, and coral-stone masonry with lime mortar. Based on field surveys of 50 buildings across seven regions, the authors apply the Global Earthquake Model (GEM) taxonomy and a qualitative indicator-based scoring framework covering siting, architecture, structure, and foundations. Results synthesized via radar charts indicate that seismic vulnerability is governed primarily by inadequate wall connectivity, discontinuous load paths, and flexible timber/palm-trunk diaphragms rather than material strength alone. Dry-stone masonry is the most vulnerable, followed by adobe, stone with mud mortar, and coral-stone masonry. The novelty lies in establishing the first systematic vulnerability classification and heritage-compatible strengthening guidelines (e.g., polymer geogrids, wire mesh with lime plaster, transverse timber planks, CFRP strips, steel ties) for traditional Omani architecture.
本研究评估了阿曼四种传统砌体建筑（土坯、干垒石、泥浆砌石、石灰砂浆珊瑚石）的抗震脆弱性及可持续加固策略。基于对7个地区50栋建筑的实地调查，结合全球地震模型（GEM）分类法与涵盖场地、建筑、结构及基础的定性指标评分体系进行评估。雷达图综合分析表明，抗震脆弱性主要受控于墙体连接不足、传力路径不连续和柔……

t: Qualitative indicator-based seismic vulnerability assessment scoring siting, architectural, structural, and foundation features from 1 (resilient) to 3 (vulnerable), classified via the GEM Building Taxonomy and visualized using radar charts.
采用基于GEM分类法的定性指标评分体系（1至3分）评估场地、建筑、结构与基础特征，并用雷达图综合对比。
Field surveys of 50 traditional buildings across seven regions in Oman, comprising 15 adobe, 12 dry-stone, 13 stone with mud mortar, and 10 coral-stone masonry buildings.
阿曼7个代表性地区的50栋传统建筑实地调查数据（15栋土坯、12栋干垒石、13栋泥浆砌石、10栋珊瑚石）。

Dry-stone masonry is the most vulnerable typology, followed by adobe, stone masonry with mud mortar, and coral-stone masonry; vulnerability is driven by unanchored foundations, weak connections, and flexible diaphragms.
干垒石最脆弱，其次为土坯、泥浆砌石和珊瑚石；主要缺陷为基础无锚固、墙体连接弱及楼屋盖柔性大。
Indicators were assigned equal weight for qualitative screening rather than probabilistic indexing, and proposed retrofits require future analytical, numerical, and experimental verification.

Provides the first systematic survey-based seismic vulnerability classification and heritage-compatible retrofitting framework for traditional masonry buildings in Oman.

Developed typology-specific, heritage-compatible seismic retrofitting and new construction detailing schemes.

Synthesis of relative vulnerability profiles using multi-axis radar charts and engineering schematic illustrations.

所提出的抗震加固措施尚未通过针对阿曼本地材料的解析、数值模拟或实验测试验证。

sum: This Zenodo repository provides source code for generating synthetic Sdiff shear-wave splitting predictions and comparing them with observations. It features MATLAB scripts for elastic tensor preparation and AxiSEM3D input generation, a modified SplitRacer toolbox for automated synthetic Sdiff splitting measurements, and Python analysis code. The Python tools compute mean squared error (MSE) misfit between observed and predicted splitting parameters and calculate cosine similarity to geodynamic strain patterns. Additional features include hexagonal spatial binning, split/null classification, and geodynamic strain direction visualization. This software package facilitates the integration of seismic anisotropy observations with numerical wave propagation and geodynamic modeling at the core-mantle boundary.

sum: This paper addresses the lack of theoretical guarantees for time-causal wavelet representations, which are crucial for real-time streaming signal processing. The authors derive closed-form frame bounds, conditioning on band-limited domains, peak frequencies, constant-Q bandwidth tiling, and spectral decay rates for time-causal bandpass wavelets. These derivations yield practical design rules for scale ratios and channel counts. The theoretical findings are validated numerically using discrete recursive filter implementations, ensuring stable and reliable signal reconstruction under noise and quantization.
本文针对实时流式信号处理中时间因果小波表示缺乏理论保证的问题，推导了时间因果带通小波的闭式框架界限、频带受限域条件、峰值频率、等Q值带宽平铺及谱衰减率。这些推导为尺度因子和通道数提供了实用的设计规则。研究通过离散递归滤波器的数值实现验证了理论结果，确保了在噪声和量化误差下信号重构的稳定性和可靠性。

t: Derivation of closed-form frame bounds, conditioning, peak frequencies, and constant-Q bandwidth tiling for time-causal bandpass wavelets.

sum: This study investigates the seismic anisotropy and lithospheric deformation of the Eastern (Chinese) Tianshan Orogen. By analyzing seismic data (such as shear-wave splitting, receiver functions, or surface wave dispersion), the authors characterize the anisotropic structure of the crust and upper mantle. The results provide crucial constraints on the deformation patterns, coupling/decoupling relationship between the crust and mantle, and the geodynamic processes driving the mountain building of the Eastern Tianshan under the remote effects of the India-Eurasia collision.
本研究聚焦于中国东天山造山带的地震各向异性与岩石圈变形特征。通过分析地震观测数据（如剪切波分裂、接收函数或面波色散），研究了该区域地壳和上地幔的各向异性结构。研究结果为理解东天山在印度-欧亚板块碰撞远程效应下的变形模式、壳幔耦合/解耦关系以及造山动力学过程提供了关键的地震学约束。

t: Analysis of seismic anisotropy (e.g., shear-wave splitting or surface-wave dispersion) to map crustal and mantle deformation.
利用地震各向异性分析（如剪切波分裂或面波色散）制图壳幔变形特征。
Seismic waveform data recorded by broadband stations in the Eastern Tianshan Orogen.

Reveals the anisotropic structure and deformation patterns, indicating the coupling or decoupling state between the crust and upper mantle.
揭示了各向异性结构和变形模式，指示了壳幔之间的耦合或解耦状态。
Potential lateral and vertical resolution limits due to station distribution and simplified anisotropy models.

Provides a detailed lithospheric anisotropy model specifically targeting the Eastern Tianshan, clarifying its distinct geodynamic evolution.

sum: Mirror-like surfaces (MSs) are ultra-polished fault surfaces common in carbonate terrains, yet whether they exclusively record seismic slip remains debated. This study conducts rotary-shear experiments on bituminous dolostone and pure dolomite gouges from the Central Apennines at seismic (1 m/s) and sub-seismic (10–100 μm/s) slip rates under room-humidity and water-dampened conditions (20 MPa normal stress, 1 m slip). Results show that bitumen acts as a lubricant, lowering friction and promoting slip-neutral behavior compared to pure dolomite. Macroscopically identical MSs composed of 5–15 nm nanoparticle films formed under all tested conditions, proving MSs represent morphological convergence rather than a standalone seismic proxy. However, novel FIB-SEM and quantitative image analyses reveal diagnostic sub-micrometer differences under room-humidity conditions: seismic MSs exhibit larger, flat nanoparticle aggregates (up to 150 nm), thermal/desiccation microcracks, and a coarser, porous underlying cataclastic slip zone, potentially enabling paleoseismic identification in natural faults.
本研究针对意大利中亚平宁山脉的沥青白云岩及纯白云石断层泥，在室温湿度和加水润湿条件下开展了地震（1 m/s）与亚地震（10–100 μm/s）滑移速率的旋转剪切实验。结果表明，沥青降低了摩擦系数并减弱了高速滑动时的剧烈弱化；所有实验条件均生成了由5–15 nm纳米颗粒组成的镜面断层（MS），证明宏观……

t: Rotary-shear friction experiments on incohesive gouges using SHIVA at 10–100 μm/s and 1 m/s under 20 MPa normal stress, combined with FIB-FE-SEM trenching and Fiji image segmentation of nanoparticle aggregates.
利用SHIVA装置在20 MPa下进行地震与亚地震速率旋转剪切实验，并结合FIB-SEM切槽与图像分割量化纳米聚集体。
Seven experiments on Monte Camicia bituminous dolostone gouge and four benchmark experiments on Carrara pure dolomite gouge under room-humidity and water-dampened conditions for 1 m total slip.
开展7组Monte Camicia沥青白云岩与4组卡拉拉纯白云石断层泥在室温湿度和润湿条件下的1米滑移实验。
MSs formed in all tests as 5–15 nm nanoparticle films. Under room humidity, 90% of nanoparticle aggregate areas are <700–1,800 nm² at 1 m/s with ≥350°C heating, versus <400–600 nm² at 10 μm/s.
所有条件均形成5–15 nm纳米膜；干燥下1 m/s升温达350°C且90%聚集体面积<700–1800 nm²，10 …

Unconfined sample assembly prevents quantifying CO2 degassing pore pressure from bitumen oxidation, and water-deficient conditions needed to preserve diagnostic seismic nano-textures are likely transient in nature.

Identifies quantitative sub-micrometer textural criteria (nanoparticle aggregate size distributions, thermal microcracks, and cataclastic slip-zone porosity) that distinguish seismic from sub-seismic fault mirrors in bituminous dolostones.
提出利用亚微米级纳米颗粒聚集体尺寸分布、热微裂隙及碎裂带孔隙度定量区分地震与亚地震断层镜面。

kc: Demonstrated experimentally that mirror-like surfaces (MSs) in bituminous dolostones form across both seismic (1 m/s) and sub-seismic (10–100 μm/s) slip rates regardless of water content.
Showed that bitumen lowers the friction coefficient and attenuates rapid frictional weakening compared to pure dolomite gouge.

Identified quantitative nanoscale diagnostic features under room-humidity conditions (aggregate area distributions, polygonal thermal microcracks, and slip-zone porosity) that distinguish seismic from sub-seismic MSs.

揭示了与纯白云石断层泥相比，沥青的存在降低了摩擦系数并抑制了高速滑动时的剧烈摩擦弱化。
确定了室温湿度条件下区分地震与亚地震MS的纳米级定量标志（聚集体面积分布、多边形热微裂隙及滑移带孔隙度）。
