使用SHIVA装置在20 MPa正应力、1 m位移及10 μm/s、100 μm/s和1 m/s滑移速率下进行旋转剪切摩擦实验。
利用双束FIB-FE-SEM进行高分辨率二次电子（SE）表面成像及平行/垂直滑移方向的聚焦离子束切槽观测。
使用Fiji软件（CLAHE滤波与阈值分割）对纳米颗粒聚集体面积进行二维定量统计，并结合晶界扩散烧结模型进行理论计算。
de: Seven rotary-shear experiments on bituminous dolostone gouge (<250 μm) from the Monte Camicia fault zone (Central Apennines, Italy) under room-humidity and water-dampened conditions.
Four benchmark rotary-shear experiments on 100% Carrara dolomite gouge under matching loading and humidity conditions.
Microstructural comparison with natural mirror-like fault surfaces collected from the Fornaca Valley outcrop.
对采自意大利中亚平宁山脉Monte Camicia断层带的沥青白云岩断层泥（<250 μm）进行了7组室温湿度和加水润湿条件下的旋转剪切实验。
在相同加载和湿度条件下对100%卡拉拉纯白云石断层泥进行了4组基准对比剪切实验。
与采自Fornaca山谷露头的天然沥青白云岩镜面断层样品进行了微观结构对比。
li: The experimental gouge holder is unconfined, preventing quantification of CO2 degassing pressure and effective normal stress reduction during thermal oxidation of bitumen.
SEM interaction volume and secondary electron escape depth are comparable to the 5–15 nm nanoparticle size, making reported particle dimensions estimates.
Diagnostic seismic microstructures only develop clearly under water-deficient conditions, which are likely transient or uncommon in permeable natural fault zones.
实验样品夹具非密封，无法定量评估沥青热氧化释放CO2引起的孔隙增压及有效正应力降低效应。
SEM电子束相互作用体积和二次电子逃逸深度与5–15 nm颗粒尺寸相当，因此颗粒尺寸测量值仅为近似估计。
区分地震滑移的微观结构特征仅在缺水条件下显著，而天然高渗透断层带中缺水条件可能非常短暂或罕见。

tm.why: The study performs rotary-shear friction experiments at seismic and sub-seismic slip rates to investigate the frictional behavior and microstructural evolution of mirror-like fault surfaces.
It examines coseismic frictional heating, dynamic slip weakening, and microstructural signatures that distinguish seismic rupture from aseismic creep in carbonate faults.

ev.notes: Full 19-page article PDF including abstract, methods, mechanical curves, FIB-SEM micrographs, quantitative image analysis, sintering calculations, and natural fault comparisons was used.

sum: This study evaluates the seismic performance of mountain-adjacent tunnels in the Loess Plateau using shake-table model tests. The authors propose a concrete mix design using polypropylene-fiber-reinforced concrete (PFRC). Tests show that concrete strength peaks at 0.9% fiber content, a 15% improvement over ordinary concrete. Under seismic loading, the PGA amplification factor of the loess slope increases nonlinearly with elevation, showing quadratic amplification at the crest. Crucially, the PFRC lining reduces bending moments at the arch, invert arch, and side walls by 8.9% to 15.2% compared to ordinary concrete. This reduction is attributed to high damping and energy dissipation from fiber friction and crack control, demonstrating PFRC's potential for improving tunnel seismic resilience in loess regions.
本研究通过振动台试验评估黄土傍山隧道抗震性能。提出聚丙烯纤维增强混凝土（PFRC）衬砌，在0.9%掺量下强度提升15%。试验表明边坡PGA随高度非线性放大。相比普通衬砌，PFRC弯矩响应降低8.5%~15.2%。纤维引入形成高阻尼结构，通过摩擦和控裂持续耗能，显著提升了黄土隧道的抗震性能。

t: Shake-table physical model testing combined with concrete mix design optimization for polypropylene-fiber-reinforced concrete tunnel linings.
结合聚丙烯纤维增强混凝土衬砌配合比优化的振动台物理模型试验。
Experimental measurements of concrete strength, slope PGA amplification factors, and tunnel lining bending moments under simulated seismic shaking.
模拟地震振动下混凝土强度、边坡PGA放大系数及隧道衬砌弯矩的实验测量数据。
Optimal fiber content of 0.9% improves concrete strength by 15% and reduces tunnel lining bending moments by 8.5% to 15.2%.
0.9%的最佳纤维掺量使混凝土强度提高15%，并降低隧道衬砌弯矩8.5%至15.2%。
Potential scale effects of the physical model and lack of long-term environmental durability testing of the fiber-reinforced concrete.
物理模型的潜在比例效应以及缺乏纤维增强混凝土的长期环境耐久性测试。
A new seismic performance evaluation method for loess mountainside tunnels using high-damping polypropylene-fiber-reinforced concrete linings.
提出了一种利用高阻尼聚丙烯纤维增强混凝土衬砌的黄土傍山隧道抗震性能评估新方法。

kc: Proposed a novel seismic performance evaluation method for mountain-adjacent tunnels under coupled earthquake and slope deformation.
Determined the optimal polypropylene fiber content (0.9%) for tunnel lining concrete, achieving a 15% strength improvement.
Demonstrated that PFRC linings reduce seismic bending moments by up to 15.2% through high-damping energy dissipation.
提出了地震与边坡变形耦合作用下傍山隧道抗震性能评估的新方法。
确定了隧道衬砌混凝土中聚丙烯纤维的最佳掺量（0.9%），使强度提高了15%。
证实了PFRC衬砌通过高阻尼能量耗散可将地震弯矩降低高达15.2%。
me: Shake-table physical model testing of a mountainside tunnel in a loess slope.
Concrete mix design optimization for polypropylene-fiber-reinforced concrete (PFRC).
Bending moment and PGA amplification factor analysis under simulated seismic excitation.
黄土边坡傍山隧道的振动台物理模型试验。
聚丙烯纤维增强混凝土（PFRC）的配合比设计优化。
模拟地震激发下的弯矩和PGA放大系数分析。
de: Physical shake-table model tests simulating loess slope and tunnel lining responses.
Mechanical testing of concrete specimens with varying polypropylene fiber contents (0% to over 0.9%).
Measurements of PGA amplification along the slope and bending moments at multiple lining locations (arch, invert, side walls).
模拟黄土边坡和隧道衬砌响应的物理振动台模型试验。
不同聚丙烯纤维含量（0%至0.9%以上）混凝土试件的力学性能测试。
沿边坡的PGA放大及衬砌多个位置（拱顶、仰拱、侧墙）弯矩的测量。
li: The physical model scale and boundary conditions may not fully capture all real-world, full-scale 3D geological complexities.
Long-term durability and degradation of polypropylene fibers under environmental weathering in loess were not evaluated.
物理模型比例和边界条件可能无法完全模拟实际全尺寸三维地质的复杂性。
未评估黄土环境下聚丙烯纤维的长期耐久性与降解情况。

tm.why: The paper evaluates the seismic performance and PGA amplification factors of tunnels and slopes under earthquake loading using shake-table tests.

ev.notes: The analysis is based on the comprehensive abstract and metadata provided, as no full PDF was available.

sum: This dataset presents microearthquake catalogs from the TDBnet temporary seismic experiment in northern Mongolia (August 2023 to December 2024), targeting the Tsetserleg–Bulnay–Dungen fault junction. The network comprised 15 temporary and 5 permanent stations. Earthquakes were detected and picked using PhaseNet, associated via PyOcto, and located with NonLinLoc. Relative relocations were performed using HypoDD, and focal mechanisms were determined using FMNEAR. The resulting broadband (BB) and short-period (SP) catalogs provide critical observations of long-lasting aftershocks from the 1905 Mw >= 8 earthquake sequence, offering insights into fault structure and seismotectonics in the region.
该数据集包含蒙古北部TDBnet临时台网（2023-2024）的微震目录，旨在研究1905年Mw>=8地震序列的长期余震。利用PhaseNet自动拾取、PyOcto关联、NonLinLoc定位及HypoDD相对重定位，并用FMNEAR计算震源机制。该高精度目录为揭示断裂带深部结构和活动性提供了关键数……

t: Automated workflow combining PhaseNet for deep-learning phase picking, PyOcto for association, NonLinLoc for absolute location, and HypoDD for relative relocation.
结合PhaseNet深度学习拾取、PyOcto关联、NonLinLoc绝对定位和HypoDD相对重定位的自动工作流。
Seismic data from 15 temporary TDBnet stations (broadband and short-period) and 5 permanent stations in northern Mongolia from 2023 to 2024.
2023至2024年间蒙古北部15个TDBnet临时台站和5个永久台站记录的地震数据。
High-resolution broadband and short-period microearthquake catalogs detailing long-lasting aftershocks around the 1905 Mw >= 8 earthquake fault junction.
详述1905年Mw>=8地震断裂交汇处长期余震的高分辨率宽频带和短周期微震目录。
Temporary dense short-period deployment was limited to five months, and relative relocations/focal mechanisms are only partially complete.
临时密集短周期部署仅持续五个月，且相对重定位和震源机制仅部分完成。
First high-resolution microearthquake catalog capturing century-scale long-lasting aftershocks of the 1905 Mongolia earthquake sequence using modern ML-based processing.
首次利用现代机器学习处理技术，获取蒙古1905年大地震百年尺度长期余震的高分辨率微震目录。

kc: Provides a high-resolution microearthquake catalog for the 1905 Mw >= 8 earthquake rupture zone in Mongolia.
Applies a modern machine-learning-based workflow (PhaseNet + PyOcto) to temporary network data.
Delivers both absolute and relative relocations along with focal mechanisms.
提供了蒙古1905年Mw >= 8地震破裂带的高分辨率微震目录。
将现代机器学习工作流（PhaseNet + PyOcto）应用于临时台网数据处理。
提供了绝对定位、相对重定位以及震源机制解。
me: PhaseNet for deep-learning-based phase picking.
PyOcto for event association.
NonLinLoc with a local 1D velocity model for absolute location.
HypoDD for relative double-difference relocation.
FMNEAR for focal mechanism determination.
使用PhaseNet进行基于深度学习的震相拾取。
使用PyOcto进行地震事件关联。
使用NonLinLoc结合本地一维速度模型进行绝对定位。
使用HypoDD进行双差相对重定位。
使用FMNEAR确定震源机制解。
de: TDBnet temporary seismic experiment consisting of 15 three-component stations (5 broadband, 10 short-period).
Data from 5 permanent Mongolian seismic stations.
Two catalogs: Broadband (BB) and Short-Period (SP) covering August 2023 to December 2024.
TDBnet临时地震观测，包含15个三分量台站（5个宽频带，10个短周期）。
来自5个蒙古永久地震台站的数据。
两个目录：覆盖2023年8月至2024年12月的宽频带（BB）和短周期（SP）目录。
li: The short-period dense deployment was limited to a five-month duration (May to October 2024).
Relative relocations and focal mechanisms are only available for a subset of the events.
短周期密集台网部署时间有限，仅持续了五个月（2024年5月至10月）。
相对重定位和震源机制解仅适用于部分地震事件。

tm.why: The dataset provides microearthquake catalogs generated using automated detection, phase-picking, association, and relocation workflows.
The catalogs target the Tsetserleg–Bulnay–Dungen fault junction to investigate long-lasting aftershocks of the 1905 Mw >= 8 earthquake sequence.

ev.notes: Analysis is based entirely on the detailed Zenodo abstract and metadata, as no PDF was available.

sum: The Progressive Failure (PF) experiment at the Mont Terri Underground Rock Laboratory investigates structurally controlled damage evolution around an unsupported 0.6 m wide borehole intersecting the Main Fault in Opalinus Clay shale, representing a 1:6.5 scale nuclear waste drift. Using six parallel monitoring boreholes for 3D structural characterization and a novel automated close-range photogrammetric system coupled with SegFormer-based deep learning segmentation, the authors tracked borehole convergence, desiccation cracking, breakouts, and fault slip over four years across ventilation, transient resaturation, and saturated phases. Results show that initial desaturation during ventilation strengthened the rock mass via suction, limiting fault slip and breakout growth despite inducing desiccation cracks. Conversely, subsequent natural resaturation reduced rock strength and stiffness, triggering up to 30 mm of normal fault slip, 18–20% breakout area expansion, and delayed 1–3 cm radial convergence within the scaly-clay Main Fault.
本研究在Mont Terri地下岩石实验室开展渐进破坏（PF）原位实验，通过钻穿Opalinus粘土岩主断层的0.6米无支护实验钻孔（1:6.5比例核废料处置巷道模型）及6个监测孔，结合定制自动化近景摄影测量系统与SegFormer深度学习分割算法，连续四年监测了通风、再饱和及完全饱和阶段的孔壁收敛……

t: Automated close-range structure-from-motion photogrammetry (6,700 images per traverse producing 500–700 million points) combined with a SegFormer deep learning semantic segmentation model to quantify borehole convergence, breakouts, cracks, and fault slip.
结合自动化近景SfM摄影测量（每次生成5–7亿点云）与SegFormer深度学习语义分割，定量提取孔壁收敛、崩落、裂纹与…
One 0.6 m wide unsupported experiment borehole (BPF7) and six parallel 131 mm monitoring boreholes (BPF1–6) drilled through the Main Fault at Mont Terri URL, surveyed 24 times over four years.
Mont Terri实验室穿过主断层的1个0.6米无支护实验孔与6个131毫米平行监测孔，四年间开展24期摄影测量与温湿…

Ventilation desaturation stabilized the borehole, whereas resaturation triggered 18–20% breakout expansion, crack opening rates of 0.13–0.17 m/day, up to 30 mm fault slip, and 1–3 cm convergence in the Main Fault.
通风去饱和使钻孔稳定，而再饱和触发了18–20%崩落扩张、0.13–0.17米/天裂纹扩展、30毫米断层滑移及主断层1–…

Borehole scale (1:6.5) and moderate fault intersection angles (~40°) prevented wedge collapse; moreover, Mont Terri's shallow stress state and rock properties cannot be directly transferred to deeper repository sites.
1:6.5缩比尺寸与约40°断层交角限制了大型楔体垮塌；浅部实验室的应力与岩石性质不能直接外推至深部处置库。

Unprecedented sub-millimetric 4-year time-lapse photogrammetric tracking of progressive failure, fault reactivation, and saturation-dependent damage around an unsupported excavation in faulted clay shale.
首次以亚毫米级精度对断层泥页岩无支护开挖面开展长达四年的自动化时移摄影测量，揭示了饱和度控制的断层活化与渐进破坏。

kc: Designed and operated a 4-year in-situ experiment (1:6.5 scale repository drift) intersecting the Main Fault and secondary tectonic faults at the Mont Terri URL.
Developed an automated close-range photogrammetric system and SegFormer deep-learning workflow to map sub-millimetric 3D convergence, breakouts, cracks, and fault slip.
Demonstrated that ventilation desaturation stabilizes clay shale excavations, whereas resaturation triggers up to 30 mm fault reactivation and delayed 1–3 cm convergence in the scaly-clay fault zone.
设计并开展了为期4年的Mont Terri地下实验室穿主断层原位实验（1:6.5核废料巷道缩比模型）。
开发了自动化近景摄影测量系统与SegFormer深度学习工作流，实现亚毫米级三维收敛、崩落、裂纹及断层滑移提取。
证实通风去饱和可稳定泥页岩开挖面，而自然再饱和会触发高达30毫米的断层活化及主断层带内延迟的1–3厘米径向收敛。
me: In-situ multi-borehole array logging using optical televiewer (OPTV) and core mapping to build a 3D structural model of the Main Fault and secondary fault sets.
Automated close-range structure-from-motion (SfM) photogrammetry using a motorized rail-mounted 24-MP camera system producing 500–700 million point clouds per survey.
Semantic segmentation of unwrapped borehole RGB imagery using a SegFormer deep learning architecture (95.2% accuracy) to quantify breakout areas and skeletonized crack lengths.
利用光学钻孔电视（OPTV）与岩芯编录开展原位多钻孔阵列测井，建立主断层与次级断层组的三维结构模型。
采用步进电机导轨搭载2400万像素相机的自动化近景运动恢复结构（SfM）摄影测量，单次测量生成5–7亿点云。
利用SegFormer深度学习架构对展开的钻孔RGB图像进行语义分割（准确率95.2%），定量提取崩落面积与骨架化裂纹长度。
de: One central 0.597 m wide, 12.9 m long unsupported experiment borehole (BPF7) and six ~14.2 m long, 131 mm diameter monitoring boreholes (BPF1–6) at Mont Terri URL.
24 automated photogrammetric surveys (12 analyzed in detail) collected between October 2020 and August 2024 across controlled ventilation (~65% RH) and natural resaturation (~95–99% RH) phases.
Continuous relative humidity and temperature monitoring inside BPF7 and at four radial rock depths (0.01–0.24 m), plus water inflow hydrochemical analyses.
Mont Terri地下实验室1个直径0.597米、长12.9米的无支护中心实验钻孔（BPF7）及6个直径131毫米、长约14.2米的平行监测孔（BPF1–6）。
2020年10月至2024年8月在受控通风（~65% RH）与自然再饱和（~95–99% RH）阶段采集的24期（详细分析12期）自动化摄影测量数据。
实验孔内及孔壁4个径向深度（0.01–0.24米）的温湿度连续监测数据，以及钻孔渗水水化学分析数据。
li: Due to technical and financial constraints, the borehole intersected faults at moderate angles (20°–60°, typically ~40°) rather than the most critical acute angles (<20°) and at a 1:6.5 scale.

The SegFormer deep learning model could not assign multiple labels per pixel, excluding cracks opening along pre-existing faults, and required cropping the borehole invert covered by the rail platform.
No local in-situ stress measurements exist directly at the PF site, and Mont Terri rock properties and shallow stresses (250–320 m) cannot be directly transferred to deeper (850 m) repository sites.
受技术与经费限制，实验孔仅以1:6.5缩比尺寸及中等交角（20°–60°，典型约40°）穿过断层，未能模拟最危险的极锐角（<20°）及1:1全尺寸情况。
SegFormer深度学习模型无法对单像素分配多重标签（排除了沿既有断层张开的裂纹），且需裁剪被导轨平台遮挡的钻孔底部图像。
实验点缺乏局部原位应力实测数据，且Mont Terri浅部（250–320米）岩石力学性质与应力状态不能直接外推至深部（850米）潜在处置库场址。

tm.why: The paper investigates fault reactivation, aseismic fault slip up to 30 mm, and progressive rock mass damage along tectonic faults intersecting an underground borehole in clay shale.

ev.notes: Full 16-page PDF from ETH Library / Engineering Geology (vol. 372, 2026, 108993) was analyzed, including all text sections, Table 1, and Figures 1–9.

sum: This study presents a new database of oxygen, hydrogen, helium, neon, and argon isotope ratios from submarine volcanoes (Edifice C, Three Sisters, Orca, and Gebra Seamount) in the Bransfield Strait, Antarctica. By analyzing volcanic rocks, glasses, and mineral inclusions, the authors trace magma sources and plumbing system processes. Oxygen and helium isotopes indicate a magma source influenced by the subduction of the Phoenix Plate, while hydrogen isotopes suggest magma degassing involving recycled sediment-fluid components. These findings support existing models of sub-slab mantle flow and enhance our understanding of submarine volcanism in this active, logistically challenging region.
本研究提供了南极布兰斯菲尔德海峡海底火山（Edifice C、Three Sisters、Orca和Gebra海山）的氧、氢、氦、氖和氩同位素新数据库。通过分析火山岩、玻璃及矿物包裹体，追踪了岩浆源与管道系统过程。氧和氦同位素结果表明岩浆源受到凤凰板块俯冲的影响，而氢同位素则指示了包含回收沉积物-流……

t: Oxygen, hydrogen, helium, neon, and argon isotope geochemistry of volcanic rocks, glasses, and mineral/fluid inclusions.
对火山岩、玻璃及矿物/流体包裹体进行氧、氢、氦、氖、氩同位素地球化学分析。
Rock, glass, clinopyroxene, and olivine samples from submarine volcanoes Edifice C, Three Sisters, Orca, and Gebra Seamount in the Bransfield Strait.
采集自布兰斯菲尔德海峡Edifice C、Three Sisters、Orca和Gebra海山的岩石、玻璃、单斜辉石和橄…
Oxygen and helium isotopes indicate a magma source influenced by Phoenix Plate subduction; hydrogen isotopes show degassing with recycled sediment-fluid components.
氧和氦同位素指示受凤凰板块俯冲影响的岩浆源；氢同位素显示含回收沉积物流体的脱气特征。
Geochemical sampling is restricted to accessible submarine volcanic edifices under harsh Antarctic conditions.
受南极恶劣条件限制，地球化学采样仅限于部分可到达的海底火山体。
First comprehensive stable and noble gas isotope database for these specific submarine volcanoes in the Bransfield Strait.
首次针对布兰斯菲尔德海峡这些特定海底火山建立完整的稳定和惰性气体同位素数据库。

kc: Presents a novel database of stable (O, H) and noble gas (He, Ne, Ar) isotopes for submarine volcanoes in the Bransfield Strait.
Constrains the influence of the subducting Phoenix Plate on the regional magma source.
Provides geochemical evidence for magma degassing involving recycled sediment-fluid components.
提供了布兰斯菲尔德海峡海底火山稳定（氧、氢）和惰性气体（氦、氖、氩）同位素的新数据库。
约束了俯冲的凤凰板块对该区域岩浆源的影响。
为涉及回收沉积物-流体组分的岩浆脱气过程提供了地球化学证据。
me: Oxygen and hydrogen isotope geochemistry of volcanic rocks, glass, clinopyroxene, and olivine.
Helium, neon, and argon isotope systematics measured in melt and fluid inclusions.
火山岩、玻璃、单斜辉石和橄榄石的氧、氢同位素地球化学分析。
熔体和流体包裹体中氦、氖、氩同位素系统分析。
de: Geochemical measurements from submarine volcanoes Edifice C, Three Sisters, Orca, and Gebra Seamount in the Bransfield Strait, Antarctica.
采集自南极布兰斯菲尔德海峡Edifice C、Three Sisters、Orca和Gebra海山等海底火山的地球化学测量数据。
li: The study relies on geochemical sampling, which is spatially limited due to the difficult accessibility and harsh weather conditions of Antarctica.
该研究依赖于地球化学采样，由于南极地区交通不便和恶劣的气候条件，采样在空间上受到限制。

tm.why: The paper investigates the magma plumbing systems and sources of submarine volcanoes in the Bransfield Strait.
The study uses isotopes to constrain sub-slab mantle flow and magma sources influenced by subduction.

ev.notes: Analyzed using the provided abstract and public metadata since no PDF was available.

sum: This study presents an integrated geodetic and remote-sensing analysis of contemporary crustal deformation and fault kinematics in the Nainital region, northwestern India. By combining four years of GPS observations (2013–2017) and persistent-scatterer InSAR (PSInSAR) from ALOS PALSAR, the authors resolve deformation partitioning across the Garampani–Kathgodam Fault (G-KF). Two-dimensional elastic dislocation modeling reveals fault slip rates of 1.6–4.8 mm/yr and locking depths of 2.0–7.2 km. The Main Boundary Thrust (MBT) and G-KF show the highest seismic-moment accumulation rates, equivalent to Mw 6 and Mw 5 earthquakes, respectively. The novelty lies in the integration of GPS and PSInSAR to provide high-resolution spatial and temporal constraints on Himalayan fault kinematics, offering critical model-based hazard indicators for regional seismic risk assessment.
本研究联合GPS、PS-InSAR与二维运动学建模，分析了印度奈尼塔尔的地壳形变。结果表明主要断层滑移率为1.6-4.8 mm/yr，闭锁深度为2.0-7.2 km。主边界断裂与G-KF的地震矩累积速率分别相当于Mw 6和Mw 5级地震。该研究集成多源大地测量数据，为喜马拉雅活跃断裂的地震危险性评估……

t: The study integrates GPS horizontal/vertical velocity analysis, PSInSAR processing of ALOS PALSAR data, and 2D elastic dislocation modeling to estimate fault kinematics.
集成GPS速度场分析、ALOS PALSAR的PSInSAR处理以及二维弹性位错建模。
The dataset consists of four years of GPS observations (2013–2017) from 22 stations and 11 ascending L-band ALOS PALSAR scenes.
包含22个站点的四年GPS观测数据（2013-2017）和11景升轨ALOS PALSAR影像。
Fault slip rates are estimated at 1.6–4.8 mm/yr with locking depths of 2.0–7.2 km, indicating Mw 6 and Mw 5 equivalent moment accumulation rates.
断层滑移率为1.6-4.8 mm/yr，闭锁深度为2.0-7.2 km，存在Mw 6和5级地震矩累积。
The analysis relies on simplified 2D elastic dislocation modeling and a relatively short geodetic observation window.
依赖于简化的二维弹性位错模型，且大地测量观测时间跨度较短。
First integration of GPS and PSInSAR to resolve deformation partitioning and quantify slip rates across the Garampani–Kathgodam Fault.
首次联合GPS与PSInSAR解析加兰帕尼-卡特戈达姆断裂的形变分配并定量约束滑移率。

kc: Quantified contemporary crustal deformation and strain rates in the Nainital region using integrated GPS and PSInSAR.
Estimated fault slip rates (1.6–4.8 mm/yr) and locking depths (2.0–7.2 km) for major faults including the MBT and G-KF.
Evaluated model-based seismic-moment accumulation rates, identifying Mw 6 and Mw 5 equivalent earthquake potentials.
利用GPS和PS-InSAR联合观测，定量评估了奈尼塔尔地区的现代地壳形变与应变率。
估算了包括MBT和G-KF在内的主要断层的滑移率（1.6-4.8 mm/yr）和闭锁深度（2.0-7.2 km）。
评估了基于模型的地震矩累积速率，识别出相当于Mw 6和Mw 5级的潜在地震危险性。
me: Persistent-Scatterer Interferometry (PSInSAR) processing of ALOS PALSAR L-band data.
GPS horizontal and vertical velocity analysis in the ITRF2014 reference frame.
Two-dimensional kinematic and elastic dislocation fault modeling.
对ALOS PALSAR L波段数据进行永久散射体干涉测量（PSInSAR）处理。
在ITRF2014参考框架下进行GPS水平和垂直速度场分析。
二维运动学与弹性位错断层建模。
de: Four years of GPS observations (2013–2017) from 22 stations in northwestern India.
Eleven ascending L-band ALOS PALSAR scenes processed for PSInSAR.
来自印度西北部22个站点的四年（2013-2017年）GPS观测数据。
用于PSInSAR处理的11景升轨L波段ALOS PALSAR影像。
li: The 2D kinematic model simplifies complex 3D fault geometries and heterogeneous crustal structures.
The temporal span of geodetic data (3-4 years) is relatively short compared to long-term earthquake cycles.
二维运动学模型简化了复杂的三维断层几何结构和非均匀地壳结构。
大地测量数据的时间跨度（3-4年）相对于长期地震周期而言较短。

tm.why: The paper estimates fault slip rates and locking depths using geodetic data and kinematic modeling.
It investigates contemporary crustal deformation and tectonic partitioning in the Himalayan collision zone.
It evaluates seismic-moment accumulation rates and earthquake potential along active faults to assess regional seismic risk.

ev.notes: Analyzed based on the detailed abstract provided in the metadata.

sum: This study investigates intra-arc deformation around the Irazú–Turrialba Volcanic Complex (ITVC) within the Central Costa Rica Deformed Belt using a 42-station local and regional seismic network operating from April 2018 to March 2019. The authors detected 967 volcano-tectonic earthquakes, inverted travel times for a new local minimum 1D velocity model via Velest, and relocated 665 events using HypoDD. They also determined 27 focal mechanisms using FPFit and inverted for principal stress orientations. Relocated seismicity collapses into six distinct clusters that delineate unmapped fault linkages, a brittle-ductile boundary above mid-crustal magmatic mush zones, and sub-vertical fluid ascent pathways. The novelty lies in demonstrating that the twin volcanoes experience distinct local tectonic regimes: Irazú is dominated by left-lateral transtensional and decompression fracturing influenced by the northwestward escape of the Central America Forearc Sliver, whereas Turrialba accommodates pull-apart kinematics and regional subduction effects.
本研究利用2018年4月至2019年3月期间运行的42个地震台站数据，探讨了哥斯达黎加中部变形带内伊拉苏-图里亚尔瓦火山复合体（ITVC）的弧内变形。作者检测了967次火山构造地震，利用Velest反演了新的局部一维速度模型，并用HypoDD重定位了665个事件，同时通过FPFit计算了27个震源机……

t: The authors inverted travel times from 434 events using Velest to build a local minimum 1D velocity model, relocated 665 earthquakes using HypoDD, and computed first-motion focal mechanisms and stress orientations using FPFit and StressInverse.
用Velest反演局部一维速度模型，通过HypoDD重定位665次地震，并用FPFit和StressInverse计算震…

An 11-month continuous dataset (April 2018–March 2019) from 20 temporary broadband stations and 22 permanent stations (OVSICORI and RSN) around the Irazú–Turrialba Volcanic Complex, yielding 967 detected events and 24,681 manual phase picks.
2018年4月至2019年3月由20个临时和22个固定宽频带台站记录的波形，检出967个事件和24,681个手动拾取震相…

Relocated earthquakes form six clusters delineating an aseismic ductile mush zone (>5–8 km depth), a NW-SE right-lateral fault linking regional segments, and 27 focal mechanisms indicating distinct transtensional and pull-apart stress regimes beneath Irazú and Turrialba.
重定位揭示6个地震簇、无震韧性晶粥带（>5-8 km）及右旋断层；27个震源机制表明两座火山受控于不同的张剪应力体制。

Small event magnitudes (Mw < 2) and low low-frequency SNR prevented full moment tensor inversions for non-double-couple components, while 1D velocity assumptions and limited focal mechanisms restrict fine-scale structural certainty.
微震（Mw < 2）低频信噪比低，无法进行全矩张量反演以解析非双力偶分量；一维模型假设和少量机制解限制了局部精度。

First high-resolution double-difference relocation and local stress inversion at the ITVC using a dense 42-station network, demonstrating that its twin volcanoes respond to distinct regional tectonic regimes.
首次利用42台密集台网对ITVC进行双差重定位与局部应力反演，揭示双火山分别受弧前块体逃逸和俯冲拉分控制。

kc: Derived a new local minimum 1D P- and S-wave velocity model (Vp/Vs = 1.78) and station corrections for the Irazú–Turrialba Volcanic Complex.
Detected 967 local earthquakes (Mc = 1.8, b-value = 0.82) and relocated 665 events using HypoDD into six discrete structural clusters.
Constrained 27 focal mechanisms and local stress tensors showing a mix of strike-slip and normal faulting that bridges regional shear zones and volcanic plumbing.
Proposed a multi-scale conceptual model distinguishing forearc-sliver-influenced deformation at Irazú from pull-apart and subduction-influenced kinematics at Turrialba.
构建了伊拉苏-图里亚尔瓦火山复合体的新局部最小一维P波和S波速度模型（Vp/Vs = 1.78）及台站校正。
检测了967次局部地震（完备震级Mc = 1.8，b值 = 0.82），并使用HypoDD将665个事件重定位为6个离散构造簇。
约束了27个震源机制解和局部应力张量，显示走滑与正断层共同作用，连接了区域剪切带与火山通道系统。
提出了多尺度概念模型，区分了伊拉苏火山受弧前块体影响的变形与图里亚尔瓦火山受拉分和俯冲控制的运动学特征。
me: STA/LTA event detection (P-to-S time <= 3 s) and manual phase picking (12,738 P and 11,943 S picks) in SEISAN.
Wadati diagram analysis for Vp/Vs ratio (1.78) and coupled hypocentre-velocity inversion using Velest and HypoInverse.
Double-difference earthquake relocation using HypoDD with LSQR conjugate gradients combining catalog picks and cross-correlations.
First-motion polarity focal mechanism inversion via FPFit and principal stress tensor inversion using StressInverse and World Stress Map methodology.
在SEISAN中使用STA/LTA进行事件检测（P-S到时差 <= 3秒）并手动拾取震相（12,738个P波和11,943个S波）。
利用和达图分析确定Vp/Vs比值（1.78），并使用Velest和HypoInverse进行震源位置与一维速度联合反演。
结合目录震相与互相关数据，采用基于LSQR共轭梯度法的HypoDD进行双差地震重定位。
利用FPFit进行P波初动极性震源机制反演，并结合StressInverse和世界应力图方法反演主应力方向。
de: Continuous 100 Hz seismic waveforms recorded from April 2018 to March 2019 across 42 broadband stations (20 temporary UNIGE Trillium Compact stations, 16 permanent OVSICORI, and 6 permanent RSN stations).
Catalogue of 967 detected local events, subset of 434 well-constrained events (5,459 P-phases) for 1D velocity inversion, and 665 double-difference relocated events.
Comparison with historical RSN focal mechanism catalog (Mw >= 4.0) and previously published local earthquake and ambient noise tomography models.
2018年4月至2019年3月期间由42个宽频带台站（20个UNIGE临时台站、16个OVSICORI固定台站和6个RSN固定台站）记录的100 Hz连续地震波形。
包含967个局部检测事件的目录，用于一维速度反演的434个高质量事件子集（5,459个P波震相），以及665个双差重定位事件。
与RSN历史震源机制目录（Mw >= 4.0）以及此前发表的地方震和背景噪声层析成像结果进行对比分析。
li: Using a 1D velocity model for 3D volcano-tectonic distributions introduces spatial biases, reflected by strong topographic and structural station corrections.
Low number of resolvable focal mechanisms (27 events) limits statistical confidence in cluster-specific stress inversions such as Cluster 2.
Micro-earthquakes (Mw < 2) had low low-frequency SNR, precluding full moment tensor inversions to resolve non-double-couple volumetric source components.
Cluster 6 is located outside the azimuthal limits of the seismic network, potentially making its HypoDD clustering an algorithmic artefact.
将一维速度模型用于三维火山构造分布会引入空间偏差，这体现在明显的地形和构造台站校正值上。
可解算的震源机制数量较少（27个事件），限制了部分地震簇（如簇2）应力反演的统计置信度。
微震（Mw < 2）在低频段信噪比较低，无法进行全矩张量反演以解析非双力偶体积源分量。
簇6位于地震台网覆盖边界之外，其HypoDD重定位聚集形态可能是算法造成的假象。

tm.why: The study investigates intra-arc volcano-tectonic seismicity, magmatic-hydrothermal interactions, and subsurface structures beneath the Irazú–Turrialba volcanic complex.
The authors detect 967 local earthquakes, invert for a minimum 1D velocity model using Velest, and relocate 665 events using HypoDD.
The paper links local volcano-tectonic fault kinematics and stress inversions to regional block tectonics, oblique subduction, and forearc sliver escape within the Central Costa Rica Deformed Belt.

ev.notes: Full 14-page PDF examined in detail, including abstract, methodology (Velest, HypoInverse, HypoDD, FPFit, StressInverse), results, discussion, and all 8 figures.

sum: This study analyzes the 2024–2025 volcanic unrest at the Santorini Volcanic Complex using Sentinel-1 Persistent Scatterer Interferometry (PSI) and GNSS data. The geodetic observations reveal horizontal movements and uplift of up to 70 mm/yr, exhibiting a radial inflation pattern centered around the Kameni Islands. Geophysical modeling indicates a positive volume rate change at a shallow depth of 3.15 km, which is shallower than the 2011–2012 unrest. The authors suggest that a mixture of magma and gas is causing pressure along Kameni's volcano-tectonic line. This represents the first phase of the unrest, as subsequent GNSS data indicate a shifting deformation pattern.
本研究利用Sentinel-1 PSI和GNSS数据分析了圣托里尼2024-2025年火山活跃期。观测显示卡梅尼群岛周围存在达70毫米/年的径向膨胀。地球物理反演表明在3.15公里浅部存在正体积变化，比2011-2012年更浅，可能是岩浆与气体混合物在构造线产生压力。研究揭示了该活跃期第一阶段特征。

t: Persistent Scatterer Interferometry (PSI) using Sentinel-1 SAR data combined with GNSS displacement measurements and geophysical source modeling.
利用Sentinel-1 SAR数据的时序雷达干涉测量（PSI），结合GNSS位移观测与地球物理源建模。
Sentinel-1 SAR satellite images (both ascending and descending geometries) and data from seven GNSS stations across the Santorini Volcanic Complex spanning summer 2024 to January 2025.
2024年夏季至2025年1月期间，圣托里尼火山群的Sentinel-1 SAR卫星图像及7个GNSS台站的数据。
Observed horizontal movements and uplift up to 70 mm/yr with a radial inflation pattern, modeled as a positive volume rate change at 3.15 km depth.
观测到高达70毫米/年的径向膨胀与抬升，建模表明在3.15公里深度存在正体积变化率。
The study only covers the 'first phase' of the unrest, as subsequent GNSS observations indicate a shifting deformation pattern.
研究仅覆盖了活跃期的“第一阶段”，随后的GNSS观测显示形变模式已发生转变。
First geodetic and geophysical modeling of the 2024–2025 Santorini volcanic unrest, identifying a shallower source compared to the 2011–2012 episode.
首次对圣托里尼2024-2025年火山活跃期进行大地测量与地球物理建模，发现其热源比2011-2012年更浅。

kc: Documented the 2024–2025 Santorini volcanic unrest using combined InSAR and GNSS geodetic datasets.
Modeled a shallow inflation source at 3.15 km depth beneath the Kameni Islands.
Identified a transition in the deformation pattern, marking the end of the first phase of unrest.
结合InSAR和GNSS大地测量数据集，记录了圣托里尼2024-2025年的火山活跃期。
在卡梅尼群岛下方3.15公里深度处模拟出了一个浅部膨胀源。
识别出形变模式的转变，标志着第一阶段活跃期的结束。
me: Persistent Scatterer Interferometry (PSI) for Sentinel-1 SAR data processing.
Decomposition of LOS displacements into vertical and horizontal components.
Geophysical inversion/modeling of the inflation source.
用于Sentinel-1 SAR数据处理的时序雷达干涉测量（PSI）技术。
将视线向（LOS）形变分解为垂直和水平分量。
膨胀源的地球物理反演与建模。
de: Sentinel-1 SAR ascending and descending orbit datasets.
Continuous GNSS data from seven stations across the Santorini Volcanic Complex.
Sentinel-1 SAR升轨和降轨数据集。
来自圣托里尼火山群7个台站的连续GNSS数据。
li: Temporal coverage is limited to the first phase of the unrest (up to January 2025).
Lack of deep seismic or geochemical data integration in the current model.
时间跨度仅限于活跃期的第一阶段（截至2025年1月）。
当前模型中缺乏深部地震或地球化学数据的整合。

tm.why: The paper focuses on geodetic monitoring and geophysical modeling of the 2024-2025 volcanic unrest at the Santorini Volcanic Complex.
The study models crustal deformation and volume changes associated with magmatic processes in the shallow crust.

ev.notes: The analysis is based on the GJI abstract and metadata since no PDF was available.

sum: This study reassesses the origin of mantle-like helium signatures (Rc/Ra up to 2.99) in hot springs of the Capital Region of China. By integrating gas geochemistry, heat flow, geophysical observations, and radiogenic 4He ingrowth calculations, the authors challenge the conventional view of active mantle-fluid input. They show that the region lacks active magmatic degassing characteristics, exhibiting low heat flow and reservoir temperatures. Instead, they propose a tectonic degassing model: mantle helium introduced during Mesozoic magmatism was retained in U- and Th-poor mafic rocks and subsequently remobilized by Cenozoic tectonic uplift, denudation, and strike-slip-extensional deformation. This mechanism explains mantle-like helium anomalies in tectonically active, non-volcanic regions without requiring present-day mantle recharge, providing a new framework for interpreting noble gas anomalies in stable continental interiors.
本研究重新评估了中国首都圈构造交汇带温泉气体中类地幔氦异常（Rc/Ra达2.99）的成因。结合气体地球化学、热流、地球物理观测及放射性4He累积计算，研究表明该区缺乏现代岩浆脱气特征。作者提出一种构造脱气机制：中生代岩浆活动引入的地幔氦被保存在低铀钍基性岩中，并在新生代通过构造抬升、剥蚀及走滑-伸展……

t: Integration of gas geochemistry, heat-flow data, radiogenic helium ingrowth calculations, and geophysical observations to model helium source and transport.
整合气体地球化学、热流数据、放射性氦累积计算及地球物理观测，模拟氦源及运移。
Geochemical data from hot spring gases (helium and carbon isotopes), regional heat flow, and deep seismic velocity structures in the Capital Region of China.
中国首都圈温泉气体的地球化学数据（氦、碳同位素）、区域热流及深部地震速度结构。
High Rc/Ra (2.04-2.99) in hot springs is explained by tectonic degassing of Mesozoic mafic rocks, without requiring active mantle recharge.
温泉中高Rc/Ra（2.04-2.99）源于中生代基性岩的构造脱气，无需现代地幔补给。
A minor, low-flux present-day mantle contribution cannot be entirely ruled out based on the available geochemical and geophysical data.
基于现有地球化学和地球物理数据，无法完全排除微量、低通量的现代地幔贡献。
Proposes tectonic degassing of ancient crustal reservoirs as an alternative mechanism for mantle-like helium anomalies in non-volcanic regions.
提出古老地壳储层构造脱气机制，解释非火山地区类地幔氦异常的新成因。

kc: Challenged the traditional view of active mantle-fluid recharge in the Capital Region of China by proposing a tectonic degassing model of ancient reservoirs.
Demonstrated that ancient U- and Th-poor mafic rocks can retain mantle-like helium signatures over Mesozoic timescales.
Linked Cenozoic tectonic uplift, denudation, and faulting to the remobilization and upward migration of ancient helium.
挑战了中国首都圈存在现代地幔流体补给的传统观点，提出了古老储层构造脱气模型。
证实了低铀、钍的古老基性岩在中生代时间尺度上仍能保留类地幔氦特征。
将新生代构造抬升、剥蚀及断裂作用与古老氦源的重组和向上运移联系起来。
me: Integrated gas geochemistry analysis focusing on helium isotopes and CO2 isotopes.
Conducted radiogenic 4He ingrowth calculations for different lithologies over geological timescales.
Analyzed regional heat-flow data, reservoir temperatures, and deep geophysical velocity structures.
整合了气体地球化学分析，重点关注氦同位素与二氧化碳同位素。
对地质时间尺度下不同岩性的放射性4He累积进行了计算。
分析了区域热流数据、热储温度及深部地球物理速度结构。
de: Air-corrected helium isotope ratios (Rc/Ra) and carbon isotopes of CO2 from hot spring gases in the Capital Region of China.
Geophysical observations including a localized reduced-velocity zone at 50-60 km depth.
Heat-flow and reservoir temperature measurements.
中国首都圈温泉气体的空气校正氦同位素比值（Rc/Ra）及二氧化碳碳同位素数据。
包括50-60公里深度局部低速带在内的地球物理观测资料。
热流及热储温度测量数据。
li: A minor, low-flux present-day mantle contribution cannot be completely excluded.
The exact spatial distribution and volume of the ancient helium-bearing mafic microreservoirs remain poorly constrained.
无法完全排除极微量、低通量的现代地幔流体贡献。
古老含氦基性微储层的具体空间分布和体积仍缺乏精确约束。

tm.why: The paper integrates geophysical observations of lithospheric structure and Mesozoic craton destruction to evaluate tectonic degassing.
The study focuses on geothermal hot springs, gas geochemistry, and hydrothermal systems in a non-volcanic region.

ev.notes: Analyzed based on the JGR Solid Earth abstract and crossref metadata as no PDF was available.

sum: Full-waveform inversion (FWI) suffers from cycle-skipping, local minima, and high computational costs. While unsupervised physics-informed generative adversarial networks (FWIGAN) mitigate these issues using Wasserstein GANs with gradient penalty (WGAN-GP), evaluating gradient penalties at dynamically changing interpolation points introduces extra computational overhead and hyperparameter tuning. This paper proposes SN-FWIGAN, which integrates spectral normalization directly into the convolutional layers of the critic alongside a 2-D acoustic wave-equation forward generator. By constraining layer-wise spectral norms to unity via power iteration, SN-FWIGAN enforces the 1-Lipschitz condition directly on network weights without sample-dependent gradient penalties. Tested on synthetic Marmousi and Sigsbee 2A models under noise-free, 10 dB noisy, missing low-frequency (<3 Hz), and 1-D linear initial model conditions, SN-FWIGAN consistently achieves higher SNR, higher SSIM, and lower MAE than L2-FWI, W1-FWI, and FWIGAN, while reducing network parameters and stabilizing late-stage convergence.
针对全波形反演（FWI）易陷入局部极小值及FWIGAN中梯度惩罚计算和调参开销大的问题，本文提出了一种基于谱归一化对抗学习的无监督物理约束速度反演方法（SN-FWIGAN）。该方法将二维声波方程正演算子作为物理生成器，并在判别器卷积层中直接引入谱归一化以约束权重矩阵的最大奇异值，从而无需计算插值样本……

t: SN-FWIGAN couples a 2-D acoustic wave-equation forward modelling generator with a 6-layer CNN critic regularized by spectral normalization, updating velocity parameters via automatic differentiation to minimize an adversarial Wasserstein surrogate loss.
将二维声波正演物理生成器与含谱归一化的6层CNN判别器结合，利用自动微分交替更新速度模型与判别器参数。

Synthetic 2-D acoustic datasets on Marmousi (100x310) and Sigsbee 2A (120x320) models with 30 surface sources, 5 Hz Ricker wavelet, tested with 10 dB Gaussian noise, missing frequencies below 3 Hz, and 1-D initial models.
采用Marmousi和Sigsbee 2A合成模型，测试无噪、10 dB高斯噪声、缺失3 Hz以下低频及1D初始模型。

SN-FWIGAN outperforms L2-FWI, W1-FWI, and FWIGAN across all tests, achieving SNR of 18.28 dB (SSIM 0.74, MAE 183.82) on noise-free Marmousi and SNR of 20.70 dB (SSIM 0.48, MAE 121.96) on noise-free Sigsbee.
SN-FWIGAN在所有实验中表现最优，无噪Marmousi和Sigsbee模型SNR分别达18.28 dB和20.70…

Tested only on 2-D acoustic synthetic data with additive Gaussian noise, omitting realistic coherent field noise and elastic multicomponent wave propagation, while requiring more GPU memory and time per iteration than conventional FWI.
仅验证了含高斯白噪声的二维声波合成数据，未考虑实际相干噪声及弹性波，且单步耗时高于传统FWI。

Replaces WGAN-GP's sample-dependent gradient penalty in FWIGAN with layer-wise spectral normalization, stabilizing non-stationary synthetic seismic data distributions without penalty hyperparameters or extra gradient calculations.
以层间谱归一化替代FWIGAN中的插值样本梯度惩罚，消除了惩罚超参数与额外梯度计算并提升了稳定性。

kc: Introduces spectral normalization into the unsupervised physics-informed FWIGAN critic to enforce Lipschitz continuity without gradient-penalty computation or hyperparameter tuning.

Demonstrates superior velocity reconstruction accuracy (SNR, SSIM, MAE) on Marmousi and Sigsbee models across noise-free, 10 dB Gaussian noise, missing low-frequency (<3 Hz), and 1-D initial model scenarios.
Provides singular-value, stable-rank, and effective-rank analyses of the critic layers, showing how layer-wise spectral control prevents weight drift and divergence during non-stationary FWI updates.
将谱归一化引入无监督物理约束FWIGAN判别器中，无需计算梯度惩罚或调参即可直接实现Lipschitz连续性约束。
在Marmousi和Sigsbee模型的无噪、10 dB噪声、缺失3 Hz以下低频及1D初始模型条件下，取得了优于传统FWI与FWIGAN的反演精度。
通过对判别器卷积层进行奇异值谱、稳定秩和有效秩分析，揭示了谱归一化抑制权重漂移并改善后期收敛的机理。
me: 2-D time-domain staggered-grid finite-difference acoustic wave modelling (2nd-order time, 8th-order space) with PML boundaries embedded as a differentiable physical generator in PyTorch (Deepwave).
6-layer CNN critic with 3x3 kernels, stride 2, LeakyReLU activations, and spectral normalization applied via power iteration to constrain layer-wise operator norms to 1.
Alternating minimax optimization using Adam (generator lr=10, critic lr=1e-4, 300 epochs, minibatch of 5 shot gathers) minimizing an adversarial Wasserstein surrogate loss.
采用二维时域交错网格有限差分声波正演（时间二阶、空间八阶精度，含PML边界）作为嵌入PyTorch（Deepwave）的可微物理生成器。
构建包含6个卷积层（3×3卷积核，步长为2，LeakyReLU激活）的CNN判别器，利用幂迭代法施加谱归一化使各层算子范数约束为1。
基于Adam优化器（生成器学习率10，判别器学习率1e-4，300轮，每批5炮集）交替求解极小极大博弈，最小化对抗Wasserstein代理损失。
de: Downsampled Marmousi model (100 x 310 grid, 30 m spacing, velocities 1.472-5.772 km/s) and Sigsbee 2A model (120 x 320 grid, 30 m spacing, velocities 1.50-4.50 km/s).
Synthetic active-source acquisition with 30 surface sources, uniform surface receivers, 5 Hz Ricker wavelet, 3 ms time step, and 4.8 s duration (1600 samples).

Comparative benchmarks against L2-FWI, trace-wise W1-FWI, and WGAN-GP FWIGAN under Gaussian-smoothed initial models, 10 dB white Gaussian noise, high-pass filtered data (>3 Hz), and 1-D linear initial models.
使用降采样Marmousi模型（100×310网格，间距30 m，速度1.472–5.772 km/s）和Sigsbee 2A模型（120×320网格，间距30 m，速度1.50–4.50 km/s）。
合成主动源采集系统包含30个地表均匀震源、地表全接收排列、5 Hz主频Ricker子波、3 ms采样间隔及4.8 s记录时长。
在高斯平滑初始模型、10 dB高斯白噪声、高通滤波（缺失3 Hz以下低频）及1D线性初始模型条件下，与L2-FWI、W1-FWI和FWIGAN进行对比实验。
li: Evaluated only on 2-D acoustic isotropic synthetic models; does not account for elastic multicomponent wavefields, P-S mode conversions, or shear velocity.
Noise robustness was only tested with additive white Gaussian noise rather than coherent, coloured, or systematic field noise.
Requires higher per-iteration computational time and GPU memory (~3.5-3.8 s/iter) than conventional L2 or W1 FWI (~0.10-0.13 s/iter) due to the multilayer CNN critic.
仅在二维声波各向同性合成模型上进行了验证，尚未扩展至包含多分量波场、P-S波转换及横波速度的弹性波反演。
抗噪实验仅采用了加性高斯白噪声，未考虑实际野外观测中常见的相干噪声、有色噪声或系统性噪声。
由于引入多层CNN判别器，单次迭代计算耗时（约3.5–3.8秒）和显存占用高于传统L2和W1全波形反演（约0.10–0.13秒）。

tm.why: The paper develops a physics-constrained full-waveform inversion (FWI) method for subsurface seismic velocity model reconstruction.
The proposed method uses an unsupervised generative adversarial network (GAN) with spectral normalization as the critic in the inversion loop.
The work formulates FWI as an adversarial optimization problem using a Wasserstein surrogate objective and analyzes critic singular value spectra.

ev.notes: Full 30-page GJI article PDF analysed, including mathematical formulations, network architectures, 33 figures, and 6 tables.

sum: The 2025 M 7.7 Mandalay earthquake on the Sagaing Fault ruptured a 510-km-long segment, propagating well beyond a known seismic gap. Using high-rate GNSS, seismological, remote sensing data, and unique video footage, the authors identify a supershear slip pulse that developed early. Interestingly, near-surface observations from video footage show subshear characteristics. To reconcile these differences, the authors propose a depth-dependent model where energetic supershear rupture is confined to the deeper locked seismogenic zone, while the shallow fault zone exhibits subshear slip. This study highlights that ruptures on straight faults can easily bypass seismic gaps, posing significant challenges for seismic hazard assessment.
2025年曼德勒M7.7级地震在实皆断裂上引发了长达510公里的超剪切破裂，远超地震空区范围。研究结合高频GNSS、地震学、遥感及视频数据，发现深部存在早期超剪切滑动脉冲，而地表视频呈次剪切特征。作者提出深度相关破裂模型解释该差异：深部锁结段发生超剪切破裂，浅部为次剪切。该研究表明直断层破裂可轻易越……

t: Joint analysis of high-rate GNSS, seismological, remote sensing, and fault rupture video footage to characterize the rupture velocity and slip pulse.
联合高频GNSS、地震学、遥感及断层破裂视频数据，分析破裂速度与滑动脉冲特征。
High-rate GNSS, seismological waveforms, remote sensing imagery, and exceptional video footage of the 2025 M 7.7 Mandalay earthquake rupture.
2025年M7.7曼德勒地震的高频GNSS、地震波形、遥感图像及现场断层破裂视频。
Identified an exceptionally long 510-km rupture with a deep supershear slip pulse, contrasting with subshear characteristics observed in shallow video footage.
发现长达510公里的超长破裂，深部呈超剪切滑动脉冲，而地表视频观测则表现为次剪切特征。
The conceptual model of depth-dependent weakening and stress heterogeneity requires further validation with high-resolution near-fault geophysical observations.
深度相关弱化和应力非均匀性的概念模型仍需更多高分辨率近断层地球物理观测来验证。
First observation of a supershear rupture propagating far beyond a seismic gap, reconciled with shallow subshear slip using a depth-dependent model.
首次观测到超剪切破裂远超地震空区传播，并利用深度相关模型调和了深部超剪切与浅部次剪切的矛盾。

kc: Documented an exceptionally long (510 km) rupture during the 2025 M 7.7 Mandalay earthquake.
Discovered a discrepancy between deep supershear propagation and shallow subshear slip.
Proposed a depth-dependent weakening and stress heterogeneity model to reconcile the observations.
记录了2025年M 7.7曼德勒地震中长达510公里的超长破裂。
发现了深部超剪切传播与浅部次剪切滑动之间的显著差异。
提出了深度相关弱化和应力非均匀性模型来解释这一观测现象。
me: High-rate GNSS data processing.
Seismological waveform analysis.
Remote sensing and pixel tracking.
Analysis of on-fault video footage.

地震学波形分析。
遥感与像素追踪技术。
断层现场视频资料分析。
de: High-rate GNSS observations of the Sagaing Fault area.
Teleseismic and regional seismic waveforms.
Satellite remote sensing data.
Exceptional close-up video footage of the surface rupture.
实皆断裂带区域的高频GNSS观测数据。
远震及区域地震波形数据。

li: Lack of direct high-resolution deep stress measurements to confirm the depth-dependent model.
Potential simplified assumptions in the conceptual dynamic triggering model.
缺乏直接的高分辨率深部应力测量以证实深度相关模型。
概念性动态触发模型中可能存在简化的假设。

tm.why: The paper analyzes the supershear rupture dynamics, slip pulse, and propagation velocity of the 2025 Mandalay earthquake.
It discusses depth-dependent weakening properties, stress heterogeneity, and seismic gaps along the Sagaing Fault.

ev.notes: Analysis is based on the published abstract of the Science Advances paper.

sum: Using ~37,000 P-to-S receiver functions from 322 broadband stations in northeastern China, this study images mantle transition zone (MTZ) discontinuities (d410, x520, and d660) via 3D common conversion point (CCP) stacking. The authors observe that in the south-central Japan-Kurile subduction segment (moderate slab dip of ~28°), both the x520 positive converter and d660 exhibit in-phase sinusoidal undulations: a 30–50 km depression where the slab impacts the MTZ base, followed by a 10–20 km uplift further west. In contrast, the northern segment (shallow dip of ~15°) shows a flat stagnant slab with a modest (<20 km) non-undulating depression. Because pure thermal or compositional anomalies would cause anti-correlated deflections of d520 and d660 due to opposite Clapeyron slopes, the authors interpret x520 and d660 as the top and bottom of a ~140 km thick stagnant slab undergoing mechanical buckling—providing the first direct seismic observation of numerically predicted slab buckling.
本研究利用中国东北322个宽频带台站的约37,000条P-to-S接收函数，通过三维共转换点（CCP）叠加技术对地幔转换带（MTZ）间断面（d410、x520和d660）进行了高分辨率成像。结果显示，在中南部中等倾角（~28°）俯冲段，x520与d660呈现出同相位的正弦状起伏（板片撞击处下凹30–……

t: P-to-S receiver functions are computed via time-domain iterative deconvolution and migrated to depth on a 3D grid using Common Conversion Point (CCP) stacking with the FWEA18 regional tomographic velocity model.
利用时间域迭代反褶积计算P-to-S接收函数，并基于区域层析成像模型FWEA18进行三维CCP叠加深度偏移成像。

Around 37,000 quality-controlled teleseismic P-to-S receiver functions (M > 5.5, epicentral distance 30°–90°) recorded by 322 temporary and permanent broadband seismic stations across northeastern China.
中国东北322个固定与流动宽频带台站记录的约37,000条高质量远震P-to-S接收函数（震级>5.5，震中距30°–9…
In the south-central segment (~28° slab dip), x520 and d660 deform in-phase (R² ~ 0.7), depressing by 30–50 km over a ~220 km corridor at slab impact and uplifting by 10–20 km further west.
中南部段（倾角~28°）x520与d660呈同相起伏（R²~0.7），撞击区下凹30–50 km，向西隆起10–20 k…

The x520 converter has a lower signal-to-noise ratio causing larger depth scatter, and the role of slab rheological strength and Clapeyron slopes cannot be directly tested from seismic observations alone.
x520信噪比较低导致深度离散度较大，且仅凭地震观测无法直接检验板片流变强度与克拉伯龙斜率的作用。

Provides the first observational seismic evidence of stagnant slab buckling inside the mantle transition zone, showing that mechanical slab impact rather than pure thermal anomaly drives large d660 depressions.
首次在地震学上观测到地幔转换带内滞留板片的屈曲变形，证明机械撞击而非纯热效应主导了d660巨幅下凹。

kc: First observational seismic evidence of stagnant slab buckling inside the mantle transition zone, previously only predicted by numerical geodynamic models.
Identification of in-phase sinusoidal undulations (R² ~ 0.7) between the x520 positive converter and the d660 discontinuity with a half-wavelength of ~420 km.
Demonstration that MTZ discontinuity topography is strongly controlled by the mechanical impact and incidence dip angle of the subducting slab rather than pure thermal or compositional effects.
首次提供了地幔转换带内滞留板片发生屈曲变形的地震学观测证据，验证了此前数值动力学模型的预测。
发现x520正转换界面与d660间断面之间存在半波长约420 km的同相位正弦状起伏变形（R² ~ 0.7）。
证明了地幔转换带间断面起伏受俯冲板片机械撞击和入射倾角的强烈控制，而非单纯由热或化学异常引起。
me: Time-domain iterative deconvolution (Gaussian parameter a = 0.5, corner frequency 0.25 Hz) to extract P-to-S receiver functions.
3D Common Conversion Point (CCP) stacking using the high-resolution regional tomographic model FWEA18 and standard model IASP91 for depth migration.
Bootstrap resampling (2500 iterations per bin) to estimate the 95% confidence intervals of the stacked RF traces.
采用时间域迭代反褶积方法（高斯系数a = 0.5，拐角频率0.25 Hz）提取P-to-S接收函数。
结合区域高精度层析成像模型FWEA18与标准模型IASP91进行三维射线追迹与共转换点（CCP）叠加偏移成像。
应用自助重采样法（每个网格2500次迭代）评估CCP叠加结果的噪声水平和95%置信区间。
de: Teleseismic waveforms from events with magnitudes > 5.5 and epicentral distances between 30° and 90°.
322 broadband seismic stations in NE China combining three temporary linear arrays (NCISP6, NCISP10, NCISP11), 65 permanent CEA stations, and 125 NECESSArray stations.
Approximately 37,000 visually quality-controlled radial receiver functions.
震级大于5.5级、震中距在30°至90°之间的远震波形数据。
中国东北地区322个宽频带地震台站数据（包含NCISP6/10/11三个流动线性台阵、65个固定台站及125个NECESSArray台站）。
经过严格视觉质量控制的约37,000条高质量P-to-S接收函数。
li: The x520 discontinuity exhibits larger depth scatter than d660 due to a smaller signal-to-noise ratio in the receiver function images.
PP and PcP phases briefly overlap in time with MTZ phases around 30° and 55–60° epicentral distances, potentially slightly distorting detailed waveforms.
The role of the Clapeyron slope and age-dependent slab rheology/strength on buckling cannot be directly tested or assessed from seismic observations alone.
由于x520转换信号的信噪比较低，其深度分布比d660表现出更大的离散性。
在震中距30°和55–60°附近，PP和PcP震相与转换带震相存在短暂时间重叠，可能轻微扭曲叠加波形细节。

tm.why: The study uses ~37,000 P-to-S receiver functions and CCP stacking to image the d410, x520, and d660 mantle transition zone discontinuities.
The paper investigates the geometry, buckling mechanics, and thermo-chemical vs. mechanical deformation of a stagnant Pacific slab inside the mantle transition zone.

ev.notes: Full 9-page PDF of Zhang et al. (2026, EPSL) was analyzed, including all sections, equations, figures (Figs. 1–5), and Table 1.

sum: This study addresses the challenge of forecasting volcanic eruption sizes when historical volume data deviates from a power-law distribution. The authors propose using an Exponentially Modified Gaussian (EMG) distribution to model the erupted volume, which combines an underlying power-law (exponential in log-space) with observational uncertainties (Gaussian noise). Applying this method to eruptive records from Campi Flegrei (Italy) and Taupo (New Zealand) calderas, they demonstrate that the EMG distribution provides an excellent statistical fit. This reconciles the apparent non-power-law behavior of observed data with the theoretical power-law assumption, validating its continued use in long- and short-term volcanic hazard forecasting.
本研究解决了历史喷发体积数据偏离幂律分布时预测火山喷发规模的难题。作者提出使用指数修饰高斯（EMG）分布来模拟喷发体积，该分布结合了潜在的幂律（对数空间中的指数分布）与观测不确定性（高斯噪声）。通过将该方法应用于意大利坎皮佛莱格瑞（Campi Flegrei）和新西兰陶波（Taupo）两个高风险破火……

t: Fitting an Exponentially Modified Gaussian (EMG) distribution to historical volcanic eruption volumes to represent a power-law convolved with Gaussian observational uncertainty.
将指数修饰高斯（EMG）分布拟合到历史火山喷发体积中，以表示与高斯观测不确定性卷积的幂律。
Erupted volume records from two high-risk calderas: Campi Flegrei (Italy) and Taupo (New Zealand).
来自两个高风险破火山口的历史喷发体积记录：意大利坎皮佛莱格瑞和新西兰陶波。
The EMG distribution provides a good statistical fit to the eruptive records of both volcanoes, supporting the underlying power-law assumption for future size forecasting.
EMG分布对两个火山的喷发记录均提供了良好的统计拟合，支持了未来规模预测中的潜在幂律假设。
Relies on the assumption that volume uncertainties are normally distributed in log-space and requires representative historical catalogs.
依赖于体积不确定性在对数空间中呈正态分布的假设，且需要具有代表性的历史编目。
Introducing the EMG distribution to reconcile the discrepancy between observed non-power-law eruption volume distributions and theoretical power-law models by explicitly accounting for uncertainty.
引入EMG分布，通过显式考虑不确定性，协调了观测到的非幂律喷发体积分布与理论幂律模型之间的差异。

kc: Proposed the Exponentially Modified Gaussian (EMG) distribution to model volcanic eruption volumes under uncertainty.
Reconciled the discrepancy between theoretical power-law behaviors and observed non-power-law eruption catalogs.
Successfully applied the EMG model to the eruptive histories of Campi Flegrei and Taupo calderas.
提出了指数修饰高斯（EMG）分布，用于在不确定性下模拟火山喷发体积。
协调了理论幂律行为与观测到的非幂律喷发目录之间的差异。
成功将EMG模型应用于坎皮佛莱格瑞和陶波破火山口的喷发历史。
me: Formulation of an Exponentially Modified Gaussian (EMG) distribution combining power-law behavior with Gaussian measurement errors.
Statistical fitting of the EMG distribution to historical eruption volume datasets.
构建结合了幂律行为与高斯测量误差的指数修饰高斯（EMG）分布。
将EMG分布统计拟合到历史喷发体积数据集中。

Eruption volume catalogs from Taupo caldera, New Zealand.
意大利坎皮佛莱格瑞破火山口的喷发体积目录。
新西兰陶波破火山口的喷发体积目录。
li: Assumes that the volume uncertainty can be adequately modeled as Gaussian noise in log-space.
Requires relatively complete historical eruptive records to achieve robust statistical fits.
假设体积不确定性可以在对数空间中被充分模拟为高斯噪声。
需要相对完整的历史喷发记录以获得稳健的统计拟合。

tm.why: The paper focuses on forecasting the size of future volcanic eruptions using statistical distributions applied to caldera systems.
It models how observational uncertainty on past eruption volumes affects the shape of the size distribution using an Exponentially Modified Gaussian.

ev.notes: The analysis is based on the provided abstract and public metadata for the preprint egusphere-2026-1415, as no PDF was available.

sum: Finite-fault slip models are non-unique and not guaranteed to be physically self-consistent. This study introduces a derivative-free optimization framework coupling Ensemble Kalman Inversion (EKI) with 3D dynamic rupture simulations (SeisSol) to test the dynamic viability of 32 published slip models for the 2011 Mw 9.0 Tohoku-Oki earthquake. Using dynamic relaxation to derive shear-stress heterogeneity from each slip model, EKI optimizes two scalar parameters (heterogeneity scaling and ambient prestress ratio) against onshore/offshore geodetic displacements and teleseismic moment-rate functions. Requiring only ~285 forward simulations, 26 models yield dynamically viable scenarios. Despite contrasting input slip patterns, the viable models converge into three dynamic rupture styles controlled by prestress heterogeneity: crack-like, single-reactivation, and multiple-reactivation ruptures. Multiple-reactivation models best match observed depth-dependent rupture and moment-rate complexity, while large near-trench slip (>25 m) and consistent strain-energy partitioning persist across all viable models.
有限断层滑动模型具有非唯一性且未必满足破裂物理规律。本研究开发了将集合卡尔曼反演（EKI）与三维动力学破裂模拟（SeisSol）相结合的无导数优化框架，结合陆地/海底大地测量位移及远震矩率函数，评估了2011年日本东北Mw 9.0地震32个有限断层模型的动力学可行性。仅需约285次正演模拟，即识别出……

t: For each finite-fault slip model, Ensemble Kalman Inversion iteratively updates a 3-member ensemble of two scalar parameters—stress heterogeneity scaling (alpha) and regional prestress ratio (R0)—using 3D SeisSol dynamic rupture simulations to maximize geodetic and moment-rate variance reductions.
结合EKI与SeisSol三维动力学破裂模拟，迭代优化应力非均匀性缩放因子与区域预应力比以匹配观测数据。

The framework evaluates 32 standardized 2011 Mw 9.0 Tohoku-Oki finite-fault slip models constrained against GEONET onshore GNSS, offshore pressure gauge and acoustic GNSS displacements, and SCARDEC teleseismic moment-rate functions.
采用2011年东北Mw 9.0地震的32个标准化有限断层模型，结合海陆大地测量位移与SCARDEC矩率函数。

Out of 32 slip models, EKI identifies 26 dynamically viable scenarios in <=3 iterations (~285 total simulations, ~450,000 CPU-hours) with high slip correlations (mean 0.93) that converge into three rupture families and consistently produce >25 m trench slip.
仅用285次模拟在32个模型中识别出26个可行方案（平均相关性0.93），收敛为三类破裂模式且均具大浅部滑动。

The setup only varies two initial stress parameters without frictional or geometric heterogeneity, and continuous-space EKI fails on six models exhibiting abrupt transitions between premature arrest and runaway rupture.
仅优化两个初始应力参数而忽略摩擦与几何变化，且连续空间EKI在6个存在突变跃迁的模型上失效。

First coupling of derivative-free Ensemble Kalman Inversion with 3D dynamic rupture simulations to systematically evaluate an ensemble of 32 finite-fault models and unify them into three physical rupture styles.
首次将无导数EKI与三维动力学破裂模拟耦合，系统评估32个有限断层模型并归纳为三类破裂机制。

kc: Developed a derivative-free EKI-DR framework coupling Ensemble Kalman Inversion with 3D ADER-DG dynamic rupture simulations in SeisSol.
Evaluated 32 published finite-fault slip models of the 2011 Tohoku-Oki earthquake, identifying 26 dynamically viable scenarios using only ~285 forward simulations.
Demonstrated that diverse slip models converge to three dominant rupture families (crack-like, single-reactivation, multiple-reactivation) governed primarily by prestress heterogeneity.
Showed that large tsunamigenic near-trench slip (~40 m median) and comparable seismic efficiency (~0.25-0.38) persist across viable models regardless of shallow prestress conditions.
开发了将集合卡尔曼反演与SeisSol三维ADER-DG动力学破裂模拟耦合的无导数优化框架（EKI-DR）。
仅用约285次正演模拟评估了2011年东北大地震的32个有限断层滑动模型，识别出26个动力学可行的破裂方案。
证明不同滑动模型收敛为主要由预应力非均匀性控制的三类破裂家族（裂纹型、单次再激活、多次再激活）。
揭示了无论浅部预应力条件如何，可行模型均存在近海沟大致海啸滑动（中位数约40米）及相近的地震效率。
me: Dynamic relaxation simulations in SeisSol to compute pseudo-static shear-traction change tensors from 32 projected finite-fault slip models.
Two-parameter initial shear stress parameterization combining scaled slip-derived stress heterogeneity (alpha) and regional ambient prestress ratio (R0).
3D dynamic rupture modeling with fast velocity-weakening rate-and-state friction, depth-dependent (a-b), Drucker-Prager off-fault plasticity, and 3D JIVSM velocity structure.
Iterative Ensemble Kalman Inversion (EKI) with ensemble size Ne=3 optimizing variance reductions of onshore GNSS, offshore seafloor geodesy, and SCARDEC moment-rate functions.
利用SeisSol动力学松弛模拟，从32个投影统一的有限断层滑动模型计算准静态剪应力变化张量。
采用双参数初始剪应力参数化，结合缩放的滑动导出应力非均匀性（alpha）与区域环境预应力比（R0）。
开展包含快速速度弱化速率-状态摩擦定律、深度依赖(a-b)、Drucker-Prager断层外塑性及三维JIVSM速度结构的3D动力学破裂模拟。
利用集合大小为3的迭代集合卡尔曼反演（EKI），优化陆地GNSS、海底大地测量和SCARDEC矩率函数的方差缩减率。
de: 32 standardized finite-fault slip models of the 2011 Mw 9.0 Tohoku-Oki earthquake projected onto the JIVSM megathrust geometry.
Onshore geodetic coseismic displacements from the GEONET GNSS network.
Offshore seafloor geodetic observations from ocean-bottom pressure gauges and GNSS-Acoustic surveys.
Teleseismic moment-rate functions from the SCARDEC database and high-frequency back-projection radiators from US and EU arrays.
3D Japan Integrated Velocity Structure Model (JIVSM) and 15 arc-second GEBCO topobathymetry.

来自GEONET GNSS台网的陆地同震大地测量位移数据。
来自海底压力计和GNSS-声学测量的海底大地测量观测数据。
来自SCARDEC数据库的远震矩率函数以及美国和欧洲台阵的高频反投影辐射源数据。

li: Focuses only on two scalar initial stress parameters without inverting for spatial variations in frictional properties, effective normal stress, or fault geometry.
EKI assumes continuous parameter spaces and fails on 6 models where sharp transitions occur between premature arrest and runaway megathrust rupture.
In the optimization formulation used here, EKI identifies data-consistent parameters but does not generate rigorous Bayesian posterior uncertainty distributions.
仅关注两个标量初始应力参数，未反演摩擦性质、有效正应力或断层几何的空间变化。
EKI假设参数空间连续，在过早止裂与失控破裂之间存在急剧跃迁的6个模型上未能收敛。
本研究使用的EKI优化形式仅用于寻找与数据一致的参数，无法生成严格的贝叶斯后验不确定性分布。

It develops a derivative-free optimization framework based on Ensemble Kalman Inversion (EKI) to invert for initial stress parameters.

sum: Bridging physical earthquake source parameters and empirical magnitudes across the microseismic gap is challenging due to attenuation and finite recording bandwidth. This study combines regional catalogs with near-source hydraulic-fracturing microearthquakes from the Tony Creek dual Microseismic Experiment (ToC2ME), dense nodal recordings from Ridgecrest, and regional broadband data from San Jacinto. After empirically calibrating borehole geophone gains using colocated broadband sensors, the authors apply Bayesian source-spectral inversion to P-wave displacement spectra to estimate scalar potency, corner frequency, and spectral falloff. Across nine local-magnitude units (-1.8 ≤ ML ≤ 7.5) and seven potency-magnitude units, the combined datasets follow a continuous quadratic scaling relation: MP = 0.040 ML^2 + 0.556 ML + 1.133. Synthetic modeling demonstrates that this nonlinearity can arise from the interaction of self-similar source scaling, path attenuation, and the finite Wood-Anderson filter passband, providing a unified empirical conversion from induced microearthquakes to large tectonic events.
受衰减和有限频带影响，将震源物理参数与经验震级扩展至微震区间极具挑战。本研究结合区域地震目录与ToC2ME水力压裂微震观测、Ridgecrest密集节点台阵及San Jacinto宽频带数据，通过共址宽频带地震仪经验标定井下检波器增益，并利用P波位移谱的贝叶斯震源谱反演估算标量地震势。在约9个地方震……

t: Multitaper P-wave displacement spectra are corrected for path and site effects, median stacked across stations, and inverted via Metropolis-Hastings Bayesian sampling of a generalized Brune model to estimate scalar potency, corner frequency, and high-frequency falloff.
对多窗谱P波位移谱进行路径校正和中位数叠加，采用广义Brune模型开展贝叶斯MCMC反演以估算地震势。

Three earthquake datasets (7,886 ToC2ME induced microearthquakes, 1,970 Ridgecrest nodal events, and 4,405 San Jacinto broadband events) are combined with the western US regional potency catalog of Trugman and Ben-Zion (2024).

Across -1.8 ≤ ML ≤ 7.5, filtered binned medians follow a continuous quadratic scaling relation MP = (0.040 ± 0.003)ML^2 + (0.556 ± 0.018)ML + (1.133 ± 0.027), departing by ~2.6 ML units from linear extrapolation at MP = 0.

Quality control preferentially excludes low-SNR microearthquakes near noise limits, and the empirical curve cannot uniquely separate finite-bandwidth/attenuation artifacts from non-self-similar rupture physics.
极小震级处低信噪比事件剔除存在选择偏差，且无法唯一区分传播滤波效应与破裂物理差异。

Bridges the microseismic observational gap down to ML ≈ -1.8 by integrating empirically calibrated borehole microseismic arrays with tectonic earthquake catalogs into a single nine-magnitude-unit potency scaling law.
结合经验标定的近源井下微震阵列与构造地震目录，将势震级标度关系跨越微震空白区扩展至ML≈-1.8。

kc: Extends the empirical potency-to-local magnitude scaling relation across the microseismic gap down to ML ≈ -1.8, covering approximately nine ML units.
Establishes a unified quadratic relation MP = (0.040 ± 0.003)ML^2 + (0.556 ± 0.018)ML + (1.133 ± 0.027) linking induced microearthquakes and tectonic events.
Empirically calibrates ToC2ME borehole geophone gain using colocated broadband waveforms, correcting a nearly five-order-of-magnitude discrepancy in nominal metadata sensitivity.
Demonstrates via synthetic waveform modeling that self-similar sources combined with attenuation and finite Wood-Anderson bandwidth can explain the observed scaling curvature.
将地震势震级与地方震级的经验标度关系跨越微震观测空白区扩展至ML ≈ -1.8，覆盖约9个地方震级单位。
利用共址宽频带波形对ToC2ME井下检波器增益进行了经验标定，修正了标称元数据灵敏度近五个数量级的偏差。
通过合成波形正演证明，自相似震源结合路径衰减与Wood-Anderson有限通带效应即可解释观测到的非线性曲率。
me: Empirical time-domain P-wave amplitude matching between colocated geophones and broadband sensors to calibrate effective instrumental gain.
Multitaper P-wave vector-summed displacement spectrum estimation corrected for regional geometrical spreading, frequency-dependent attenuation, and near-surface kappa.
Bayesian inversion in the logarithmic spectral domain using a Metropolis-Hastings algorithm to jointly estimate scalar potency, corner frequency, and high-frequency decay exponent.
Binned median filtering across 50 ML bins followed by quadratic least-squares regression and first-order perturbation uncertainty analysis.
Synthetic source time function forward modeling with self-similar scaling, anelastic attenuation, and Wood-Anderson filtering.

在对数谱域采用Metropolis-Hastings算法进行贝叶斯反演，联合估算标量地震势、拐角频率及高频衰减指数。
在50个ML分箱内进行中位数滤波与二次最小二乘回归，并结合一阶微扰理论开展模型不确定度分析。
开展包含自相似震源标度、非弹性衰减和Wood-Anderson滤波的合成震源时间函数正演模拟。

Ridgecrest dataset (California, USA): 1,970 candidate aftershocks (0 ≤ ML ≤ 1.5) recorded at 500 Hz by temporary 3J nodal stations, yielding 501 reliable potency estimates.
San Jacinto dataset (California, USA): 4,405 candidate earthquakes (0.5 ≤ ML ≤ 3.5) from the QTM catalog recorded at 100 Hz by regional broadband stations, yielding 2,337 reliable potency estimates.

Bayesian spectral inference with Metropolis-Hastings sampling and first-order error propagation are used to estimate source parameters and quantify data- and model-induced uncertainties.
A core part of the dataset comes from the Tony Creek dual Microseismic Experiment (ToC2ME) monitoring hydraulic-fracturing-induced microearthquakes down to ML ≈ -1.8.

sum: This study utilizes 2D and 3D thermo-mechanical modeling to investigate how lower-crustal rheology and obliquity control the geodynamic outcomes of oblique terrane entry into subduction zones. The models show that weak continental crust accretion and topographic loading abort secondary subduction, whereas stronger arc-type crust facilitates the formation of short-lived triangular oceanic microplates. Additionally, continued consumption causes slab folding at depth, offering a new mechanism to accommodate double-subduction space constraints. These findings are applied to explain the contrasting behaviors of the Taiwan–South China Sea and Molucca–Mindanao systems, providing mechanical criteria for reconstructing ancient oceanic domains.
本研究利用二维和三维热-力学数值模拟，探讨了下地壳流变学和斜向汇聚对地体进入俯冲带时动力学演化的控制作用。研究表明，弱大陆地壳的增生和地形载荷会抑制二次俯冲的发生；而较强的弧状地壳则有利于形成短寿命的三角形海洋微板块。此外，持续的板块消耗会导致深部板块折叠，为解决双俯冲空间问题提供了新机制。该模型成……

sum: Conventional deep-learning earthquake monitoring processes stations independently and chains tasks sequentially, losing network-wide wavefield coherence and accumulating errors. This paper introduces EQNet2, a geometry-aware multi-station Swin Transformer that performs event-centric earthquake monitoring in a single unified model. Taking multi-station waveforms and station coordinates as input, EQNet2 incorporates a learnable spatiotemporal relative position bias and jointly predicts P/S arrivals, first-motion polarities, source parameters (travel time, distance, backazimuth, depth, magnitude), and prompt-based phase associations. Trained on the California Earthquake Event Dataset (CEED) and tested on the 2023 NCEDC dataset, the 2019 Ridgecrest sequence, and the 2025 Berkeley earthquake, EQNet2 recovers significantly more low-SNR arrivals, suppresses isolated false picks, and retains a higher fraction of picks in located events (e.g., locating 29,058 Ridgecrest events with 89.3% SCSN recall). Its learned attention maps naturally track seismic moveout across stations.
传统深度学习地震监测独立处理单台数据并串联各子任务，忽略了台网相干性且易累积误差。本文提出几何感知多台站Swin Transformer模型EQNet2，以多台波形和台站坐标为输入，引入时空相对位置偏置，联合预测P/S震相到时、初动极性、震源参数及基于提示的震相关联。模型基于加州地震事件数据集（CE……

基于含时空相对位置偏置的Swin Transformer与FPN，从多台波形联合解码震相、序数极性、震源参数及提示关联掩…

训练依赖在震相、极性、震源和关联任务上具有完整且一致的事件级标注数据集。
不同任务的损失尺度和收敛速度存在差异，导致多任务优化具有挑战性。
应用于超大规模台网时需要更稀疏的台站选择或分层台站窗口以控制计算与显存开销。
部分学习到的相对位置偏置（RPB）头表现出尚无明确物理解释的时间不对称性。

tm.why: The paper presents an end-to-end model that jointly performs phase picking, polarity determination, phase association, and source parameter estimation to build complete earthquake catalogs.
The core contribution is EQNet2, a geometry-aware multi-station Swin Transformer architecture with prompt-based association and multi-task prediction heads.

ev.notes: Full 38-page PDF (including main text and supplementary information) was used for evaluation.

sum: This paper proposes a spatiotemporal Bayesian neural network (STBNN) to predict shear wave velocity (Vs) and quantify prediction uncertainties from logging data. By combining ensemble learning and Bayesian approximation (Monte Carlo dropout), the method estimates both epistemic and aleatoric uncertainties. Tested on a real oil reservoir logging dataset, the STBNN outperforms conventional spatiotemporal neural networks and empirical models. The study demonstrates that prediction uncertainty is dominated by epistemic uncertainty, which is higher in data-sparse regions and can be mitigated by increasing sample diversity. This approach enhances Vs prediction accuracy and provides robust uncertainty estimates for reservoir characterization.
本文提出一种时空贝叶斯神经网络（STBNN），用于预测剪切波速度（Vs）并量化不确定性。该方法结合集成学习与蒙特卡洛Dropout，可估算认知和偶然不确定性。在实际油气储层测井数据集上的应用表明，STBNN的预测精度优于传统时空神经网络和经验模型。研究表明预测不确定性主要源于认知不确定性，可通过增加……

t: A spatiotemporal Bayesian neural network (STBNN) combined with Monte Carlo dropout to predict shear wave velocity and quantify epistemic and aleatoric uncertainties from logging data.
结合蒙特卡洛Dropout的时空贝叶斯神经网络（STBNN），用于预测剪切波速度并量化测井数据中的认知和偶然不确定性。
A real-world logging dataset derived from actual oil reservoirs, including an application to an untrained exploration area to evaluate model generalizability.
源自实际油气储层的真实测井数据集，并应用于未训练的勘探区以评估模型的泛化能力。
STBNN achieves higher prediction accuracy than conventional spatiotemporal and empirical models, showing that uncertainty is mainly epistemic and can be reduced by increasing sample diversity.
STBNN比传统时空和经验模型具有更高的预测精度，表明不确定性主要为认知不确定性，可通过增加样本多样性来降低。
Prediction accuracy and uncertainty quantification remain dependent on the diversity and quality of the training logging dataset.
预测精度和不确定性量化仍依赖于训练测井数据集的多样性和质量。
Integration of spatiotemporal deep learning with Bayesian uncertainty quantification (Monte Carlo dropout) specifically for shear wave velocity prediction in reservoir characterization.
将时空深度学习与贝叶斯不确定性量化（蒙特卡洛Dropout）相结合，专门用于储层表征中的剪切波速度预测。

kc: Proposed a spatiotemporal Bayesian neural network (STBNN) for shear wave velocity prediction.
Integrated Monte Carlo dropout to quantify both epistemic and aleatoric uncertainties in logging-based predictions.
Demonstrated that epistemic uncertainty dominates prediction errors, especially in data-limited areas, and can be mitigated by increasing sample diversity.
提出了一种用于剪切波速度预测的时空贝叶斯神经网络（STBNN）。
集成了蒙特卡洛Dropout方法，以量化基于测井预测中的认知和偶然不确定性。
证明了认知不确定性在预测误差中占主导地位（尤其在数据有限区域），并可通过增加样本多样性来降低。
me: Spatiotemporal Bayesian neural network (STBNN) architecture.
Feature selection on logging data to identify sensitive input attributes.
Monte Carlo dropout for estimating epistemic and aleatoric uncertainties.
时空贝叶斯神经网络（STBNN）架构。
测井数据的特征选择，以识别敏感的输入属性。
用于估算认知和偶然不确定性的蒙特卡洛Dropout方法。

Applied to an untrained exploration area to test generalizability.
Analyzed the impact of sample size on network epistemic uncertainty.
使用来自实际油气储层的真实测井数据集进行评估。
应用于未参与训练的勘探区以测试泛化能力。
分析了样本量对网络认知不确定性的影响。

Computational cost may be higher due to Monte Carlo dropout sampling during inference.
