由于推理过程中的蒙特卡洛Dropout采样，计算成本可能较高。

tm.why: The paper proposes a spatiotemporal Bayesian neural network (STBNN) for predicting shear wave velocity.
The core focus is on quantifying epistemic and aleatoric uncertainties using Monte Carlo dropout within a Bayesian framework.

ev.notes: The analysis is based on the paper's abstract and metadata from Crossref, as the full PDF was not available.

sum: This study establishes an information-theoretic observability framework for earthquake source inference from InSAR, separating statistical detection, local source-parameter identifiability, and finite-fault slip recoverability. Detection is evaluated via a whitened known-template matched-filter statistic; local identifiability is quantified through the eigenspectrum of a prior-scaled Fisher information matrix (yielding effective identifiable dimension, information gain, and invariant weak-subspace diagnostics); and finite-fault recoverability is measured via a prior-conditioned slip-information operator. Controlled Okada elastic-dislocation benchmarks across varying magnitudes, depths, fault dips (30°, 55°, 85°), viewing geometries, noise covariances, and GNSS/azimuth additions reveal that detection systematically precedes substantial parameter identifiability by 0.436–0.600 magnitude units at 10 km depth. Furthermore, finite-fault experiments demonstrate strong saturation of recoverable slip dimensionality under mesh refinement (e.g., increasing patches from 12 to 160 at 10 km depth only raises effective dimension from 5.88 to 6.56), proving that numerical discretization does not equate to observational spatial resolution.
本研究建立了InSAR地震震源推断的信息论可观测性框架，将统计检测、局部震源参数可识别性与有限断层滑动可恢复性明确分离。利用白化匹配滤波统计量量化检测，通过先验缩放Fisher信息矩阵特征谱导出有效可识别维数与弱子空间诊断，并用先验条件算子评估有限断层恢复度。基于Okada弹性位错的受控基准实验表明……

t: Formulates InSAR source observability as a three-level hierarchy using a whitened template detection statistic, prior-scaled Fisher information eigenspectrum for local identifiability, and prior-preconditioned slip sensitivity operators for finite-fault recoverability.
利用白化模板检测统计量、先验缩放Fisher信息矩阵特征谱及先验预处理有限断层算子，建立InSAR震源可观测性三级框架。

Synthetic elastic-dislocation benchmarks using Okada (1985) solutions in a homogeneous half-space across Mw 5.2–7.3, depths 2–30 km, and fault dips of 30°, 55°, and 85° with spatially correlated InSAR noise.
基于均匀半空间Okada位错模型的合成基准测试，涵盖Mw 5.2–7.3、深度2–30 km及30°/55°/85°倾角…

At 10 km depth, statistical detection (P_det = 0.5) precedes substantial local identifiability (d_eff = 5) by 0.436–0.600 magnitude units; refining finite-fault meshes from 12 to 160 patches only increases recoverable dimension from 5.88 to 6.56.
10 km深度处检测比参数可识别性早0.436–0.600震级单位；子断层从12加密至160仅使可恢复维数从5.88增至…

The local Fisher information approximation only characterizes curvature around a reference source and cannot resolve global posterior multimodality, discrete fault-plane ambiguities, or forward-model misspecification.
局部Fisher近似仅描述参考源附近曲率，无法捕捉全局多峰性、共轭断层面模糊性或正演模型设定误差。

First unified information-theoretic formulation that explicitly separates and compares statistical signal detection, low-dimensional parameter identifiability, and finite-fault slip recoverability for InSAR earthquake inversions.
首次在统一信息论框架下将InSAR同震信号检测、低维参数可识别性与有限断层可恢复性显式分离并定量对比。

kc: Formulates a unified information-theoretic hierarchy separating coseismic signal detection, local source-parameter identifiability, and finite-fault slip recoverability in InSAR analysis.
Introduces rotationally invariant weak-subspace participation diagnostics and prior-scaled Fisher information metrics to identify poorly constrained parameter combinations.
Demonstrates through dip-controlled benchmarks that statistical detection precedes substantial source identifiability by 0.436 to 0.600 magnitude units at 10 km centroid depth.
Proves that finite-fault effective recoverable dimension rapidly saturates as numerical mesh discretization is refined, decoupling numerical model dimension from data-supported resolution.
建立了统一的InSAR信息论层级框架，将同震信号检测、局部震源参数可识别性与有限断层滑动可恢复性区分开来。
提出了旋转不变的弱子空间参与度诊断方法和先验缩放Fisher信息指标，以识别受约束较差的参数组合。
通过倾角受控基准实验证明，在10 km质心深度处，统计检测比实质性震源参数可识别性超前0.436至0.600个震级单位。
证明有限断层有效可恢复维数随数值网格加密迅速饱和，将数值模型维数与数据支持的实际空间分辨率解耦。
me: Whitened known-template matched-filter detection statistic incorporating nuisance parameter marginalization (offsets and planar orbital ramps) via a projected precision operator.
Prior-scaled local Fisher information matrix eigendecomposition yielding effective identifiable dimension (d_eff) and Gaussian expected Kullback-Leibler information gain.
Invariant weak-subspace projector diagnostics to evaluate parameter trade-offs under nearly degenerate small eigenvalues.
Prior-conditioned finite-fault slip information operator using a squared-exponential spatial covariance prior to quantify effective recoverable slip dimension (r_eff).
结合投影精度算子边缘化干扰参数（常数偏移与平面轨道斜坡）的白化已知模板匹配滤波检测统计方法。
先验缩放局部Fisher信息矩阵特征分解，用于计算有效可识别维数（d_eff）及高斯期望Kullback-Leibler信息增益。
旋转不变的弱子空间投影诊断方法，用于评估近似简并小特征值下的参数折衷关系。
采用平方指数空间协方差先验的先验条件化有限断层滑动信息算子，用于量化有效可恢复滑动维数（r_eff）。
de: Synthetic Okada rectangular shear dislocation benchmarks in a homogeneous isotropic elastic half-space (shear modulus 30 GPa, Poisson ratio 0.25) with Wells & Coppersmith (1994) scaling.
Dip-controlled magnitude-depth grids (5.2 <= Mw <= 7.3, 2 <= z_c <= 30 km) for dips of 30°, 55°, and 85° with fixed strike (330°) and rake (0°).
Multi-sensor and viewing geometry experiments comparing single ascending LOS, dual LOS, along-track azimuth displacements, and a 9-station 3-component GNSS network.

Data degradation experiments testing ramp marginalization, near-field spatial masking, increased spatially correlated noise, and uniform grid decimation, plus finite-fault mesh refinement (12 to 160 patches).
均匀各向同性弹性半空间（剪切模量30 GPa，泊松比0.25）中的Okada矩形剪切位错合成基准实验，采用Wells & Coppersmith (1994)破裂标度律。
多传感器与观测几何实验，对比单升轨LOS、升降双轨LOS、沿轨方位向位移以及9台站三分量GNSS台网。
测试轨道斜坡边缘化、近场空间掩膜、增强空间相关噪声与均匀网格降采样的数据退化实验，以及有限断层网格加密实验（12至160个子断层）。
li: Local Fisher information diagnostics rely on linear-Gaussian approximations around a reference source and cannot capture global posterior multimodality or conjugate fault-plane ambiguities.
Forward modeling assumes a simplified homogeneous isotropic elastic half-space, planar fault geometry, and deterministic rupture scaling without epistemic structural uncertainty.
The Gaussian squared-exponential slip perturbation prior does not enforce slip positivity or represent non-Gaussian/trans-dimensional rupture priors.
Spatial data loss masks are deterministic and source-independent, omitting realistic amplitude-dependent phase decorrelation and unwrapping errors near fault traces.
局部Fisher信息诊断依赖于参考震源附近的线性高斯近似，无法捕捉全局后验多峰性或共轭断层面模糊性。
正演模型假设简化的均匀各向同性弹性半空间、平面断层几何与确定性破裂标度律，未包含弹性结构等认知不确定性。
高斯平方指数滑动微扰先验未强制滑动非负约束，也未涵盖非高斯或跨维破裂先验。
空间数据缺失掩膜是确定性且独立于震源的，未考虑断层迹线附近与形变梯度相关的真实相干性丧失和相位解缠错误。

tm.why: The paper develops an information-theoretic observability framework using Fisher information matrices, eigenspectra, and prior-preconditioned operators to quantify parameter identifiability and finite-fault recoverability.
The framework is specifically formulated and benchmarked for coseismic earthquake source parameter estimation and finite-fault slip inversion from surface deformation.
It derives Gaussian expected information gain, posterior covariance contraction, and prior-conditioned effective dimensions to evaluate source parameter uncertainty and experimental design.

ev.notes: Full 58-page manuscript PDF (including all mathematical derivations, benchmark specifications, and Figures 1–8) was analyzed.

sum: The 2025 M7.8 Mandalay earthquake ruptured ~480 km of the Sagaing Fault in Myanmar. Combining Sentinel-1, ALOS-2 SAR, and Sentinel-2 optical imagery with numerical modeling, this study shows that subsurface fault geometry and slip distribution could be anticipated from pre-event observations. Asymmetric coseismic and interseismic deformation reveal a helix-shaped fault geometry dipping east in the north and west in the south. Comparing coseismic slip to interseismic slip deficit supports a 'minimally slip-predictable' model where slip equals or exceeds accumulated deficit. Constrained by the static slip model, the authors generate 3D dynamic rupture ensembles using SeisSol and validate them against teleseismic back-projection, near-fault strong-motion (NPW), and CCTV video records. The preferred model features low fracture energy (0.83 MJ/m²) and depth-dependent rupture speeds: deep unilateral southward supershear propagation alongside shallow subshear slip, reconciling conflicting near-field and far-field speed estimates.
2025年缅甸曼德勒M7.8地震破裂了实皆断层约480公里。本研究结合SAR与光学卫星大地测量、远震反投影、近场强震及CCTV视频，开展了静态滑移反演与180组SeisSol三维动力学破裂系综模拟。研究发现断层呈北段东倾、南段西倾的螺旋状三维几何结构；同震滑移量等于或超过震间滑移亏损，符合“最小滑移……

t: Geodetic displacements are inverted on a 3D triangular mesh for static slip, which initializes an ensemble of 180 3D spontaneous dynamic rupture simulations in SeisSol by scaling prestress heterogeneity, critical slip-weakening distance, and relative prestress ratio.
在三维三角网格上反演大地测量静态滑移，并以此约束预应力等3个全局缩放参数，构建180组SeisSol三维自发动力学破裂模…

Surface deformation is measured along the ~480 km rupture using Sentinel-1A and ALOS-2 SAR images plus Sentinel-2 optical imagery, complemented by teleseismic arrays (AK, AU, EU), near-fault strong-motion station NPW, and CCTV video records.
整合覆盖480公里破裂带的Sentinel-1A、ALOS-2 SAR和Sentinel-2光学影像，以及区域远震台阵、…

The static slip model (Mw 7.81, 96% variance reduction, 5.5 m peak slip) reveals a helix-shaped fault and minimal slip-predictability; the preferred dynamic model (GOF 0.72, fracture energy 0.83 MJ/m²) reconciles observations via deep supershear and shallow subshear rupture.
静态模型（Mw 7.81，峰值滑移5.5米）揭示螺旋断层与最小滑移可预测性；优选动力学模型（断裂能0.83 MJ/m²）…

Dynamic rupture parameters exhibit strong non-unique trade-offs, and sparse near-fault observations prevent constraining fine-scale spatial parameter variations or applying full Bayesian dynamic inversions.
动力学摩擦与初始应力参数存在强烈非唯一性折衷，且近场观测稀疏限制了精细空间约束与贝叶斯反演。

Demonstrates that subsurface helix fault geometry, minimal slip-predictability, and depth-dependent supershear-to-subshear rupture dynamics of a ~480 km strike-slip earthquake can be anticipated and reconciled through static-informed dynamic ensembles.
证实超长走滑地震的螺旋几何与滑移可由震前数据预期，并通过深部超剪切、浅部亚剪切模型调和了近远场速度矛盾。

kc: Reconstructed the 3D surface displacement field and a ~480 km static slip model (Mw 7.81, peak slip ~5.5 m, negligible shallow slip deficit) from SAR and optical satellite imagery.
Identified a helix-shaped subsurface geometry of the Sagaing Fault (dipping 70–80°E in the north and ~80°W in the south) that explains cross-fault deformation asymmetry.
Demonstrated 'minimal slip-predictability' where fault segments with large interseismic deficits matched expected slip while recently ruptured segments (1946, 1956) experienced slip overshoot.

Generated ensembles of 3D dynamic rupture simulations (180 reference and 180 bimaterial models) constrained by static slip, identifying a low-fracture-energy (0.83 MJ/m²) scenario with deep supershear and shallow subshear rupture that reconciles CCTV, strong-motion, and back-projection data.
利用SAR和光学卫星影像重建了三维地表位移场及约480公里长的静态滑移模型（Mw 7.81，峰值滑移约5.5米，无明显浅部滑移亏损）。
揭示了实皆断层北段东倾（70–80°）、南段西倾（约80°）的螺旋状地下三维几何形态，解释了跨断层形变的不对称性。
验证了“最小滑移可预测性”：高震间亏损段同震滑移与亏损一致，而近期破裂段（1946、1956年）发生滑移超调。
基于静态滑移构建了三维动力学破裂模拟系综（180个参考模型与180个双材料模型），确定了深部超剪切、浅部亚剪切的低断裂能（0.83 MJ/m²）优选方案，调和了CCTV视频、近场强震与远震反投影观测。
me: Space-geodetic data processing (Sentinel-1A azimuth pixel offsets, ALOS-2 ScanSAR interferograms, Sentinel-2 COSI-Corr optical cross-correlation) and least-squares retrieval of 3D orthogonal surface displacements.
Subsurface dip grid-search and linear static slip inversion using piece-wise linear triangular dislocation elements in a 1D layered elastic half-space (SlipSolve) with discrete Laplacian smoothing.

High-performance 3D spontaneous dynamic rupture ensemble modeling using ADER-DG software SeisSol with linear slip-weakening friction and initial stresses derived via dynamic relaxation of the geodetic slip model.
Time-domain, phase-weighted relative teleseismic P-wave back-projection using regional arrays in Alaska, Australia, and Europe (0.4–2 Hz).
空间大地测量数据处理（Sentinel-1A方位向像素偏移、ALOS-2 ScanSAR干涉测量、Sentinel-2光学影像COSI-Corr互相关）及三维正交地表位移场的最小二乘反演。
基于一维分层弹性半空间（SlipSolve）的分段倾角网格搜索，以及采用分片线性三角形位错元和离散拉普拉斯平滑的静态滑移反演。
利用ADER-DG开源软件SeisSol开展三维自发动力学破裂系综模拟，采用线性滑移弱化摩擦准则，并通过大地测量滑移模型的动力学松弛计算初始应力场。
利用阿拉斯加、澳大利亚和欧洲三个区域台阵（0.4–2 Hz）开展时域相位加权相对远震P波反投影分析。
de: Sentinel-1A TOPS SAR images (4 tracks), ALOS-2 ScanSAR images (3 tracks), and 7 pairs of pre-/post-event Sentinel-2 optical images.
Teleseismic P-wave recordings (0.4–2 Hz) from 81 stations in Alaska, 62 in Australia, and 31 in Europe from the NSF SAGE archive.
Near-fault strong-motion waveform at station NPW (2.6 km from fault trace) and published slip-rate/trajectory histories derived from a near-fault CCTV video recording.

360 3D dynamic rupture simulations in SeisSol (180 reference ensemble varying prestress scale B, slip-weakening scale C, and prestress ratio Ru; 180 bimaterial ensemble with ±10% velocity contrast; plus localized deep barrier test models).
Sentinel-1A TOPS SAR影像（4个轨道）、ALOS-2 ScanSAR影像（3个轨道）以及7对震前/震后Sentinel-2光学卫星影像。
来自NSF SAGE数据中心的远震P波记录（0.4–2 Hz），包含阿拉斯加81个台站、澳大利亚62个台站和欧洲31个台站。
距离断层迹线2.6公里的NPW强震台近场波形，以及前人基于近断层CCTV监控视频提取的滑移率与弯曲滑移轨迹数据。
360组SeisSol三维动力学破裂数值实验（180组改变预应力缩放因子B、滑移弱化距离因子C及预应力比Ru的参考系综；180组具有±10%波速对比的双材料系综；以及局部深部障碍体测试模型）。
li: Frictional parameterization and initial stress conditions are non-unique, with strong trade-offs between effective normal stress, frictional strength drop, and critical slip-weakening distance.
Sparse near-fault instrumentation (only one near-fault strong-motion station NPW and one CCTV site) limits fine-scale spatial constraints and practical applicability of full Bayesian inversions.
The extent of historical penultimate ruptures (e.g., 1946 and 1956 earthquakes) is poorly constrained, introducing up to 50 km along-strike uncertainty in segment-wise slip deficit comparisons.
Simulations rely on a 1D layered velocity structure and linear slip-weakening friction rather than 3D heterogeneous velocity structure or enhanced thermal/fluid dynamic weakening laws.
摩擦参数化与初始应力条件具有非唯一性，有效正应力、摩擦强度降与临界滑移弱化距离之间存在显著折衷。
近断层观测极其稀疏（仅有一个NPW强震台和一处CCTV视频点），限制了对小尺度空间变化的约束及全贝叶斯反演的实际应用。
历史倒数第二次破裂（如1946年和1956年地震）的空间范围约束较差，沿走向存在高达50公里的不确定性。
模拟采用了简化的一维分层速度结构和线性滑移弱化摩擦律，未纳入三维非均匀速度结构或更复杂的增强动态弱化机制。

tm.why: The paper investigates the coseismic slip, 3D fault geometry, and supershear rupture dynamics of the 2025 M7.8 Mandalay earthquake using geodetic inversion, back-projection, and 3D dynamic rupture simulations.
The study analyzes interseismic slip deficits, minimal slip-predictability across fault segments, fracture energy, and frictional properties of the mature Sagaing Fault.
Using high-performance computing and the ADER-DG code SeisSol, the authors generate ensembles of 360 3D spontaneous dynamic rupture simulations.

ev.notes: Full 18-page PDF article from Nature Communications (2026) was provided and used for all text, method, figure, and anchor extractions.

sum: This study investigates how fracture network permeability controls fluid migration and induced microseismicity at The Geysers geothermal field, California, from 2015 to 2024. Using continuous waveforms from the local BG network, the authors apply a machine-learning-based workflow (PhaseNet, REAL, Velest, hypoDD) to construct a catalog of 434,160 events—threefold larger than regional catalogs. Markov clustering groups 88.2% of events into 153 spatial clusters tightly linked to injection wells. Source mechanism inversions (RPNet, SKHASH, NaNDC) and stress inversions on representative clusters reveal distinct local stress regimes, non-double-couple components indicating fracture opening/closure, and abundant steeply dipping fractures. Coupled 3D thermo-hydro-mechanical (THM) modeling demonstrates that orthotropic permeability (with vertical permeability two orders of magnitude higher than horizontal near wellbores) drives rapid downward pore pressure diffusion. Rather than simple isotropic regional diffusion, multiscale permeability heterogeneity and anisotropy govern localized fluid pathways and microseismic responses.

sum: This Zenodo repository contains the SeisSol parameter files for the study of the 2026 Mw 7.6 Venezuela earthquake. The study investigates the multi-stage rupture process of this earthquake, which was delayed but not arrested, using advanced 3D dynamic rupture modeling. SeisSol, an open-source software package based on the Arbitrary high-order accurate DERivative Discontinuous Galerkin (ADER-DG) method, is utilized to simulate the complex fault geometry and wave propagation. The parameters enable reproducible high-performance computing simulations of the earthquake's rupture dynamics.

sum: This study addresses the ill-conditioned inverse problem of recovering Greenland Ice Sheet mass change from sea surface height (SSH) fingerprints. The authors develop a physics-informed neural operator constrained by a neural-operator emulator of the forward sea level equation. Testing on synthetic ice change ensembles reveals that while broad ice loss patterns are recoverable, fine-scale structures are highly dependent on prior assumptions due to non-uniqueness. The study establishes an empirical error law defining a scale-dependent accuracy ceiling (R² ~ 0.79 under current SSH observation geometry). Applying this to 1993–2019 SSH rate observations successfully recovers large-scale Greenland fingerprints, while residuals correlate with bathymetry, indicating unresolved sterodynamic variability. This work provides a quantitative bound on fingerprint-only ice-loss resolving power.
本研究开发了受前向海平面方程约束的物理信息神经算子，用于定量评估从海表面高度指纹反演格陵兰冰盖质量变化的分辨极限。结果表明，大尺度冰流失可有效恢复，但细微结构高度依赖先验。研究建立了经验误差定律，确定当前观测下精度上限R²~0.79。实际应用成功恢复了大尺度指纹，残差揭示了未解决的动力位变率。该工作……

t: A physics-informed neural operator constrained by a neural-operator emulator of the forward sea level equation is developed to solve the ill-conditioned inverse problem.
开发了受前向海平面方程神经算子模拟器约束的物理信息神经算子来求解病态反演。
Synthetic ice change ensembles with varying geometries, a satellite-altimetry-derived reference field, and observed 1993–2019 sea surface height rate data are utilized.

The leading three principal components explain 99.76% of fingerprint variance, and an empirical error law defines a scale-dependent accuracy ceiling of R² ~ 0.79 under current geometry.

Fine-scale ice loss recovery remains highly non-unique and dependent on prior assumptions, and observations are limited by sterodynamic sea level noise.

This is the first systematic, scale-resolved quantification of Greenland Ice Sheet mass change structure recoverable from its sea level fingerprint using neural operators.

sum: This paper introduces Stein Mixture Variational Inference (SMVI) for Bayesian geophysical inversion with complex, non-Gaussian, or multimodal posteriors. SMVI approximates the posterior distribution using an equally weighted mixture of transformed parametric Gaussian distributions (particles), whose hyperparameters are jointly optimized in a reproducing kernel Hilbert space using the Stein Variational Gradient Descent (SVGD) update rule and a physics-informed reparameterization gradient estimator. Because each particle represents a continuous local distribution rather than a point mass, SMVI mitigates SVGD's particle degeneracy and allows parallel updates unlike sequential Boosting Variational Inference (BVI). Tested on synthetic 1D surface-wave dispersion inversion, 2D acoustic full-waveform inversion (25,000 parameters), and ambient-noise Love wave tomography of the British Isles, SMVI accurately recovers multimodal posteriors—such as bimodal basin boundary uncertainties in the East Irish Sea—while requiring 3–5 times fewer simulations and only 14 hours wall-clock time compared to 68–260 hours for SVGD and BVI.
本文提出Stein混合变分推断（SMVI）用于求解具有多峰或复杂后验分布的贝叶斯地球物理反演。该方法利用等权重变换高斯混合分布逼近后验概率密度，结合重参数化技巧与物理梯度，在再生核希尔伯特空间中通过SVGD规则并行优化各分量超参数。在一维面波频散合成反演、二维Marmousi声波全波形反演（2.5万……

t: SMVI approximates the posterior distribution using an equally weighted mixture of transformed parametric Gaussian components, jointly optimizing their hyperparameters in a reproducing kernel Hilbert space via SVGD updates and a reparameterization-trick gradient estimator.

tm.why: The paper introduces Stein Mixture Variational Inference (SMVI) to estimate complex, non-Gaussian, and multimodal Bayesian posterior probability density functions and uncertainties in geophysical inverse problems.
SMVI is validated on a 25,000-dimensional 2D acoustic full-waveform inversion (FWI) benchmark using the Marmousi model and adjoint-state gradients.
The method is tested on synthetic 1D Rayleigh wave dispersion inversion and applied to real ambient-noise Love wave tomography of the British Isles.

sum: This study introduces a novel seismic phase pair, PKIKPPKIKP–PKiKPPKiKP, observed at epicentral distances near 90° from deep earthquakes, to map the Earth's inner core (IC) boundary region. By utilizing multiply reflected core phases, this method minimizes mantle heterogeneity effects due to highly similar ray paths. Differential arrival times are measured using waveform cross-correlation in the 0.7–2 Hz band and compared with synthetic seismograms. Statistical evaluation using AIC and BIC supports a simple isotropic model over anisotropic alternatives for the sampled region. Additionally, PKIKPPKIKP and PKPbcPKPbc phases near 60° are identified, expanding the toolkit for deep Earth imaging.
本文提出了一种新型地震震相对 PKIKPPKIKP–PKiKPPKiKP（震中距约90°），用于探测地球内核（IC）边界结构。该方法利用多次反射核震相极度相似的路径，最大程度地消除了地幔非均匀性的干扰。研究通过波形互相关方法（0.7–2 Hz）测量差分走时，并与合成地震图进行对比。AIC和BIC统计……

t: Waveform cross-correlation of PKIKPPKIKP and PKiKPPKiKP phases in the 0.7–2 Hz band to measure differential travel times and compute residuals against synthetic seismograms.
在0.7-2 Hz频段对PKIKPPKIKP和PKiKPPKiKP震相进行波形互相关，测量差分走时并计算相对于合成地震图…
Seismic waveforms from deep earthquakes recorded at epicentral distances near 90° and 60°, along with synthetic seismograms.
在震中距约90°和60°处记录的深源地震波形数据以及相应的合成地震图。
Measured differential travel-time residuals favor a single-parameter isotropic model over anisotropic models based on AIC and BIC statistical criteria.
基于AIC和BIC统计准则，测得的差分走时残差更支持单参数各向同性模型，而非各向异性模型。
The analyzed multiply reflected core phases are rare and exhibit low signal-to-noise ratios, limiting their widespread detection.
所分析的多次反射核震相非常罕见且信噪比低，限制了其广泛检测。
Introduction of the PKIKPPKIKP–PKiKPPKiKP phase pair near 90° to minimize mantle path effects and probe the inner core.
首次引入90°附近的PKIKPPKIKP–PKiKPPKiKP震相对，以最大程度减少地幔路径影响并探测内核。

kc: Introduced the PKIKPPKIKP–PKiKPPKiKP differential travel-time pair near 90° epicentral distance for inner core mapping.
Demonstrated that multiply reflected core phases can effectively isolate inner core structure by canceling out mantle path anomalies.
Identified a new set of PKIKPPKIKP and PKPbcPKPbc arrivals near 60° epicentral distance.
Showed through statistical criteria (AIC/BIC) that the observed residuals are well-explained by an isotropic model without requiring anisotropy.
引入了震中距90°附近的PKIKPPKIKP–PKiKPPKiKP差分走时对，用于内核成像。
证明了多次反射核震相可以通过消除地幔路径异常来有效隔离内核结构。
在震中距60°附近识别出一组新的PKIKPPKIKP和PKPbcPKPbc震相。
通过统计准则（AIC/BIC）表明，观测残差可以通过各向同性模型得到很好解释，无需引入各向异性。
me: Waveform cross-correlation in the 0.7–2 Hz frequency band to measure differential arrival times.
Synthetic seismogram modeling incorporating earthquake source mechanisms to compute travel-time residuals.
Statistical model selection using Akaike Information Criterion (AIC) and Bayesian Information Criterion (BIC).
在0.7–2 Hz频段内进行波形互相关以测量差分到达时间。
结合地震震源机制进行合成地震图模拟，以计算走时残差。
使用赤池信息准则（AIC）和贝叶斯信息准则（BIC）进行统计模型选择。

Synthetic seismograms generated to match the observed earthquake source mechanisms.
在震中距约90°和60°处记录的深源地震波形数据。
针对观测到的地震震源机制生成的合成地震图。

The study is limited to specific epicentral distance ranges (near 90° and 60°).

研究局限于特定的震中距范围（约90°和60°）。

tm.why: The paper utilizes differential travel times of core-reflected body waves to map velocity anomalies in the Earth's inner core.
The study performs statistical analysis to test whether the observed travel-time residuals require an anisotropic model or can be explained by an isotropic one.

sum: Long-range infrasound propagation in Earth's atmosphere is sensitive to upper-atmospheric winds and temperature, offering strong potential for numerical weather prediction via data assimilation. However, because acoustic waves travel slowly relative to atmospheric dynamics, stationary medium assumptions fail. This paper introduces 4D (space and time) sensitivity kernels computed naturally via the adjoint-state method without summing over time. The authors show that sequential Kalman filters and 3D-Var cannot assimilate such nonlocal-in-time observations; instead, 4D-Var or ensemble smoothers with assimilation windows exceeding propagation duration are required. Using twin experiments in a 40-variable Lorenz'96 model mimicking Hunga-Tonga Lamb wave travel times, they apply a localized iterative ensemble Kalman smoother (LIEnKS). Results demonstrate that assimilating infrasound travel times significantly reduces wind prediction errors over sparsely observed oceans, whereas neglecting atmospheric time variability degrades assimilation performance even more than linearizing the observation operator.
远程大气次声波传播对高层大气风场和温度敏感，可用于数值天气预报的数据同化。但声波传播较慢，传统静态大气假设不再适用。本文提出利用伴随状态法直接计算不随时间累加的4D（时空）次声灵敏度核（即时变观测算子）。研究表明，只有同化窗口大于声波传播时间的4D-Var或集合平滑器（如局部迭代集合卡尔曼平滑器LI……

t: Computes 4D space-time infrasound sensitivity kernels via the adjoint-state method by integrating the correlation of forward and adjoint wavefields over discrete model time steps, then assimilates them using a Localized Iterative Ensemble Kalman Smoother (LIEnKS).
利用伴随状态法在离散时间步积分正伴随波场互相关以计算4D灵敏度核，并用LIEnKS进行同化。

Twin experiments on a 40-variable Lorenz'96 zonal wind model (18 noisy ocean cells, 22 land cells) assimilating synthetic relative travel times of eastward and westward circumnavigating Lamb waves spanning 2 to 3 time steps.
基于40变量Lorenz'96风场模型（18海洋、22陆地格点），同化跨越2-3个时间步的合成Lamb波走时。

Assimilating infrasound with time-variable operators reduces RMSE over the ocean from ~0.7 to ~0.45, whereas time-constant operators fail to improve or even degrade predictions due to large modeling errors.
时变算子将海洋区RMSE从~0.7降至~0.45，而静态算子因模型误差大导致同化结果退化。
The assimilation test uses an idealized 1D Lorenz'96 toy model assuming infinitely propagating Lamb waves available at every time step rather than realistic 3D atmospheric dynamics.
仅使用一维Lorenz'96理想模型，且假设Lamb波无限传播并在每个时间步均可观测。

Introduces 4D space-time adjoint sensitivity kernels for atmospheric infrasound and proves that neglecting medium time-variability during wave propagation degrades data assimilation much more than linearizing the operator.
首次提出次声波4D时空伴随灵敏度核，证实忽略大气时变性比算子线性化对同化的危害更大。

kc: Formulated 4D space-time sensitivity kernels for atmospheric infrasound propagation using the non-self-adjoint acoustic wave equations.
Demonstrated that only 4D-Var and ensemble smoothers (like IEnKS/LIEnKS) with windows spanning the full wave propagation can assimilate time-dependent wave operators.
Quantified the impact of stationary vs. time-varying and linear vs. nonlinear observation operators in a Lorenz'96 twin experiment mimicking Hunga-Tonga Lamb waves.
利用非自伴随声波方程，提出了大气次声传播的4D时空灵敏度核计算方法。
证明了只有同化时间窗覆盖整个波传播过程的4D-Var和集合平滑器（如LIEnKS）才能同化时变波场算子。
在模拟汤加火山Lamb波的Lorenz'96双生实验中，量化了静态与时变、线性与非线性观测算子对同化精度的影响。
me: Adjoint-state method for computing 4D space-time acoustic sensitivity kernels by correlating forward and adjoint wavefields over discrete time intervals.
Localized Iterative Ensemble Kalman Smoother (LIEnKS) with covariance localization and multiplicative inflation.
Twin data assimilation experiments comparing Nonlinear Time-Variable (NL-TV), Linear Time-Variable (L-TV), Nonlinear Time-Constant (NL-TC), and Linear Time-Constant (L-TC) operators.
伴随状态法：通过在离散时间步内互相关正演和伴随波场来计算4D时空声学灵敏度核。
结合协方差局地化和乘性膨胀的局部迭代集合卡尔曼平滑器（LIEnKS）。
双生数据同化实验：对比非线性时变（NL-TV）、线性时变（L-TV）、非线性时不变（NL-TC）和线性时不变（L-TC）算子。
de: 2D synthetic infrasound waveform sensitivity examples to horizontal winds from Gerier et al. (2026) with 5-minute time resolution.
1D 40-cell Lorenz'96 toy model partitioned into noisy 'sea' cells (1-18, error=5 m/s) and accurate 'land' cells (19-40, error=1 m/s).
Synthetic relative travel time residuals of eastward and westward circumnavigating Lamb waves (c0 = 310 m/s) spanning 2 to 3 model time steps (12 to 18 hours).
引自Gerier et al. (2026)的5分钟时间分辨率2D合成次声波形对水平风场的灵敏度核算例。
包含40个格点的1D Lorenz'96玩具模型，划分为高噪声“海洋”区（1-18格点，误差5 m/s）和低噪声“陆地”区（19-40格点，误差1 m/s）。
模拟向东和向西环绕地球传播的Lamb波（波速310 m/s）跨越2至3个模型时间步（12至18小时）的相对走时残差。
li: Demonstrated on an idealized 1D Lorenz'96 toy model rather than a full 3D numerical weather prediction model.
Assumed Lamb waves propagate infinitely and are observed at every time step to increase data weight and simplify software implementation.
Simplified propagation geometry where waves cross exactly 6 grid cells per model time step.
仅在理想化的1D Lorenz'96玩具模型上进行了验证，尚未应用于完整的3D数值天气预报模型。
为简化实现并增加数据权重，假设Lamb波无限传播且在每个时间步均可观测。
简化了波传播几何，假设声波在每个模型时间步长内恰好穿过6个网格单元。

tm.why: The paper formulates 4D space-time sensitivity kernels for acoustic wave propagation using the adjoint-state method by cross-correlating forward and adjoint wavefields.
The study investigates nonlinear and linear time-dependent observation operators in 4D variational and ensemble smoother data assimilation frameworks.
It models atmospheric infrasound and circumnavigating Lamb waves excited by volcanic eruptions (like Hunga-Tonga) to constrain upper-atmospheric winds.

ev.notes: Full 16-page PDF analyzed, including equations, tables, and figures.

sum: This study investigates the interseismic deformation and seismic potential of the buried Northern Apennines External Front (NAEF) beneath the Po Plain in Emilia-Romagna, Italy. Integrating continuous GNSS velocities (2001–2021) with newly reoccupied IGM95 campaign GNSS stations (1994–2023, corrected for the 2012 Emilia seismic sequence), the authors apply a kinematic block modeling approach and discretize the fault plane with a 3D Triangular Dislocation Elements (TDE) mesh. The optimal four-block model reproduces the observed shortening gradient with long-term dip-slip rates up to ~1.0 mm/yr and strike-slip rates up to ~0.8 mm/yr along the NAEF, and 1.0–1.5 mm/yr dip-slip along the Pedeapenninic Thrust Front. Inversion for slip-deficit rate and interseismic coupling identifies three well-resolved locked asperities near Finale Emilia, Ferrara, and Ravenna, yielding end-member rupture scenarios of Mw ~6.0–6.5 with 500–800 year recurrence intervals and quantifying the regional seismic moment budget.
本研究探讨了意大利波河平原下伏北亚平宁外缘断层带（NAEF）的震间变形与地震潜力。结合连续GNSS速度场与新复测的12个IGM95流动GNSS站点数据（已扣除2012年艾米利亚地震序列影响），采用运动学块体建模与三维三角形位错元（TDE）网格反演了断层长期滑动速率与滑动亏损率分布。结果表明，NAEF……

t: Kinematic block modeling combined with constrained linear inversion for slip-deficit rates on a 3D Triangular Dislocation Elements (TDE) mesh regularized via a Laplacian operator and trade-off curve.
结合运动学块体建模与三维三角形位错元（TDE）网格线性约束反演，通过拉普拉斯算子与折衷曲线估算滑动亏损率与耦合度。
Continuous GNSS velocities (2001–2021) from 270 stations combined with 12 IGM95 campaign GNSS stations (1994–2023) corrected for the 2012 Emilia earthquake sequence displacements.
整合270个测站的连续GNSS速度场（2001-2021）与扣除2012年地震变形后的12个IGM95流动GNSS站数据…
Long-term reverse slip-rates reach ~1.0 mm/yr on the NAEF and 1.0–1.5 mm/yr on the PTF; three high-coupling patches (IC ≥ 0.5) yield Mw 6.06–6.54 scenarios with 516–809 year recurrence intervals.
NAEF倾滑速率达~1.0 mm/yr，识别出3个高耦合凹凸体（IC≥0.5），对应Mw 6.06-6.54地震情景及5…
Low GNSS station density in the western mesh sector degrades resolution (~15–20 km), and simplified fault geometry omits complex fault splays and local fluid-extraction deformation.
西段GNSS站点稀疏导致空间分辨率低（15-20 km），且简化断层几何未包含次级分支断层及局部流体开采形变。
First 3D interseismic coupling, resolution length, and seismic moment budget model of the buried Northern Apennines front integrating newly reoccupied IGM95 campaign GNSS stations.
首次融合新复测IGM95流动GNSS数据，建立了北亚平宁隐伏前缘的三维震间耦合、分辨率及地震矩预算模型。

kc: Integrated continuous GNSS velocities with 12 newly reoccupied IGM95 campaign GNSS sites (spanning 1994–2023) corrected for 2012 coseismic and postseismic offsets.
Determined statistically optimal four-block kinematic configuration yielding ~1.0 mm/yr dip-slip and ~0.8 mm/yr strike-slip along the Northern Apennines External Front.

Mapped 3D interseismic coupling and resolution length using a Triangular Dislocation Elements mesh, identifying three main locked asperities (Finale Emilia, Ferrara, Ravenna) and evaluating Mw 6.0–6.5 rupture scenarios.
整合了连续GNSS速度场与12个新复测的IGM95流动GNSS站点数据（1994-2023年），并扣除了2012年地震序列的同震与震后形变影响。
通过统计F检验确定了最优的四块体运动学模型，获得北亚平宁外缘逆冲带约1.0 mm/yr的倾滑速率和约0.8 mm/yr的走滑速率。
利用三维三角形位错元网格反演了震间耦合度与分辨率长度，识别出Finale Emilia、Ferrara和Ravenna三个主要闭锁凹凸体，并评估了Mw 6.0-6.5破裂情景与地震矩预算。
me: Kinematic block modeling using Okada rectangular dislocations and F-test statistical model selection (Stein & Gordon, 1984).
Forward modeling of 2012 coseismic, postseismic, and aseismic slip-pulse displacements using GAME (Okada patch sources) to isolate interseismic GNSS velocities.
Slip-deficit rate and interseismic coupling inversion on a 3D Triangular Dislocation Elements (TDE) mesh using BLOCKS with linear inequality constraints and Laplacian smoothing.
Spatial resolution length analysis, checkerboard tests, and empirical rupture scenario estimation (Wells & Coppersmith, 1994; Aki, 1972).
基于Okada矩形位错理论的运动学块体建模及基于F检验（Stein & Gordon, 1984）的统计模型优选。
利用GAME工具正演模拟2012年地震序列的同震、震后及无震滑动脉冲位移，从GNSS时间序列中分离纯震间运动。
在三维三角形位错元（TDE）网格上利用带线性不等式约束和拉普拉斯平滑的BLOCKS代码反演滑动亏损率与震间耦合系数。
开展空间分辨率长度分析与检测板测试，并基于Wells & Coppersmith (1994)经验关系和Aki (1972)公式构建地震破裂情景。
de: Continuous GNSS horizontal velocity field from Serpelloni et al. (2022) covering 2001–2021 (270 total stations used in block inversion).
Campaign GNSS observations from 12 IGM95 benchmarks first surveyed in 1994 and reoccupied in March 2023 with dual-frequency receivers.
Seismogenic fault geometry constraints from the DISS v3.3.1 database and seismicity catalogs (HORUS 1960–2025, CPTI15, CLASS).
来自Serpelloni等（2022）涵盖2001-2021年的连续GNSS水平速度场数据（共270个测站用于块体反演）。
12个IGM95流动GNSS测站数据（最早始于1994年，于2023年3月使用双频接收机重新观测）。
来自DISS v3.3.1数据库的发震构造几何约束以及意大利地震目录（HORUS 1960-2025、CPTI15、CLASS）。
li: Sparse GNSS station coverage on the western sector (between Mirandola and Reggio Emilia) results in poor spatial resolution (~15–20 km) and inability to resolve the May 29, 2012 rupture asperity.
The simplified single-mesh fault geometry does not explicitly capture complex secondary splays, multi-segment partitioning, or potential local horizontal deformation from fluid extraction.
研究区西段（Mirandola与Reggio Emilia之间）GNSS测站稀疏，导致空间分辨率较低（约15-20 km），无法清晰分辨2012年5月29日震源区的耦合特征。
简化的单一断层网格几何模型未能显式刻画复杂的次级分支断层、多断层段滑动分配以及流体开采可能引起的局部非构造水平形变。

tm.why: The paper estimates spatial distributions of interseismic coupling, slip-deficit rates, locked asperities, and aseismic creep along buried thrust faults using geodetic block modeling.
The authors evaluate seismic moment accumulation rates and construct end-member earthquake rupture scenarios (Mw and recurrence intervals) to inform seismic hazard in the Po Plain.
The study constrains active crustal shortening and long-term kinematic slip rates across tectonic blocks of the Northern Apennines fold-and-thrust belt.

ev.notes: Full 44-page manuscript PDF (GJI advance article) including all sections, equations, Table 1, and Figures 1–7 was read and analyzed.

sum: This study combines seismic depth imaging, P-wave velocities, sediment physical properties, and age constraints to characterize horizontal shortening in the southern Hikurangi trench, New Zealand. The authors identify a distinct change in the lateral seismic velocity gradient of trench sediments ~20 km seaward of the main frontal thrust, marking the onset of lateral compaction and tectonically driven stratigraphic thickening. They find that compaction of the trench wedge has accommodated ~3 km of shortening, which represents over 20% of the long-term convergent strain rate. This significant compaction-driven strain accommodation reduces the amount of strain that would otherwise be accommodated by slip on the shallow megathrust and overlying upper plate faults, with critical implications for understanding shallow megathrust slip behavior and tsunamigenic potential.
本研究结合地震深度成像、P波速度、沉积物物理性质和年龄约束，表征了新西兰南希库朗伊海沟的水平缩短特征。研究发现，在主前缘断裂向海约20公里处，海沟沉积物的侧向地震速度梯度发生明显变化，标志着侧向压实和构造驱动地层增厚的开始。海沟楔的压实适应了约3公里的缩短，超过长期平均收敛应变率的20%。这种显著的……

t: Seismic depth imaging and P-wave velocity analysis combined with sediment physical properties and age constraints.
结合沉积物物理性质和年龄约束的地震深度成像与P波速度分析。
Active-source seismic reflection profiles and velocity data from the southern Hikurangi trench, New Zealand.
新西兰南希库朗伊海沟的活动源地震反射剖面和速度数据。
Sediment compaction accommodates ~3 km of shortening, exceeding 20% of the long-term convergent strain rate.
沉积物压实适应了约3公里的缩短，超过长期收敛应变率的20%。
Regional focus on Hikurangi margin and potential uncertainties in velocity-to-compaction scaling.
区域局限于希库朗伊边缘，且速度-压实换算存在潜在不确定性。
Quantifying the significant contribution of trench sediment compaction to the overall subduction strain budget.
定量化海沟沉积物压实对整个俯冲带应变收支的显著贡献。

kc: Quantified that sediment compaction in the southern Hikurangi trench accommodates ~3 km of horizontal shortening.
Demonstrated that compaction accommodates over 20% of the long-term convergent strain rate, reducing shallow megathrust strain.
Identified the onset of lateral compaction and stratigraphic thickening ~20 km seaward of the main frontal thrust.
定量化了南希库朗伊海沟沉积物压实所适应的约3公里水平缩短量。
证明了压实作用适应了超过20%的长期收敛应变率，从而减少了浅部超冲断层的应变。
确定了在主前缘断裂向海约20公里处侧向压实和地层增厚的开始位置。
me: Seismic depth imaging and P-wave velocity analysis.
Integration of sediment physical properties and stratigraphic age constraints.
地震深度成像与P波速度分析。
结合沉积物物理性质和地层年龄约束。
de: Active-source seismic reflection profiles and velocity data from the southern Hikurangi trench, New Zealand.
来自新西兰南希库朗伊海沟的活动源地震反射剖面和速度数据。
li: The study is regionally focused on the southern Hikurangi margin; results may vary in other subduction zones with different sediment inputs.
Resolution of seismic velocity models and physical property assumptions may introduce uncertainties in compaction estimates.
研究区域局限于南希库朗伊边缘；在其他具有不同沉积物输入的俯冲带中，结果可能会有所不同。
地震速度模型的解析度和物理性质假设可能会给压实估算带来不确定性。

tm.why: The paper investigates tectonic shortening, sediment compaction, and strain partitioning in the Hikurangi subduction margin.
The study utilizes seismic depth imaging and P-wave velocity gradients to characterize sediment compaction.

sum: This study reformulates a coda-based seismic localization approach using seismic quanta scattering theory to locate lunar meteoroid impacts. By combining four distance proxies—peak amplitude, rise time, differential arrival time, and overall coda shape—the method overcomes the challenges of intense scattering in the highly fractured lunar crust. Applied to forty-nine high-amplitude local impact events from the Apollo seismic network, the joint inversion yields locations consistent with travel-time solutions, while also estimating localization uncertainties and impact momenta. This demonstrates that coda envelopes contain robust distance information, providing a reliable tool for planetary impact localization and source property estimation.
本研究基于地震量子散射理论重构了尾波定位方法。联合峰值振幅、上升时间、差分到时和尾波形状四个距离代理，克服了破碎月壳强散射对直达波定位的干扰。该方法成功定位了阿波罗台网记录的49个高振幅局部撞击事件，并估算了其不确定性与撞击动量。结果表明尾波包络含有鲁棒的距离信息，为行星撞击定位提供了新工具。

t: A coda-based localization approach reformulated under seismic quanta scattering theory, combining peak amplitude, rise time, differential arrival time, and coda shape.
基于地震量子散射理论重构的尾波定位方法，联合了四种距离代理。
Seismic waveforms of forty-nine high-amplitude local impact events recorded by the Apollo seismic network.
阿波罗地震台网记录的49个高振幅局部月球撞击事件的地震波形数据。
Successful localization of 49 lunar impacts with estimated uncertainties and momenta, showing good agreement with independent travel-time-based solutions.
成功定位49个撞击事件并估算其动量，结果与独立走时定位解高度一致。

sum: This study investigates the stress state and shear strength across the deep subduction megathrust (~60 km depth) offshore Miyagi, northeastern Japan. By applying high-frequency (2–5 Hz) P-wave moment tensor inversion to ~2,000 M 2–3.5 earthquakes and integrating existing catalogs, the authors expand the focal-mechanism dataset by over sixfold (to 2,244 events). Stress tensor inversions reveal an abrupt, kilometer-scale ~90° rotation of maximum compression across the plate boundary: downdip compression in the upper slab persists to within ~2 km of the interface, whereas the overlying plate experiences strike-parallel compression. Because principal stress axes align nearly parallel or normal to the megathrust, the resolved shear traction on the boundary is only ~11% of the slab's maximum shear stress (~108 MPa for hydrostatic pore pressure, μ' = 0.07; ~11 MPa for a weaker overpressured slab, μ' = 0.006). This demonstrates that the deep megathrust mechanically decouples the slab and overriding plate.

sum: This study presents a statistical-physics-based analysis of 392 stratovolcanoes across seven volcanic zones to investigate their morphometric evolution. By analyzing frequency-size distributions of height, volume, slope, and ellipticity, the authors identify dual scaling relationships rather than single power laws. Log-log plots reveal two distinct sub-populations: abundant, morphologically variable small-to-intermediate volcanoes (high-entropy regime) and rarer, more uniform large volcanoes (low-entropy regime). Using thermodynamic and Shannon entropy, the study quantifies this morphometric dispersion, revealing a systematic transition between these regimes. This transition suggests that stratovolcano growth is not uniform across scales but evolves from highly variable, unconstrained growth to mechanically and morphometrically constrained systems. The findings provide a new comparative framework for quantifying volcanic zone variability and understanding scale-dependent volcanic growth.

sum: This paper investigates the physical controls governing the shape and asymmetry of earthquake source time functions (STFs). By analyzing STFs from dynamic rupture simulations or observational catalogs, the authors evaluate how factors like rupture velocity, nucleation location, stress drop, and fault geometry influence STF characteristics. The work provides theoretical insights into distinguishing symmetric versus asymmetric rupture propagation and improves our understanding of earthquake source physics and rupture complexity.

sum: This study performs large-scale 3D finite-difference ground-motion simulations for a potential M 8 Ryukyu subduction zone earthquake offshore eastern Taiwan. By simulating 192 source-velocity-model combinations and varying the Gaussian source time function duration, the authors generate over 8.5 million synthetic records across 4,950 virtual stations. The analysis shows that rupture directivity and velocity dominate long-period ground-motion spatial variability. Comparing synthetics with the empirical CH20 ground-motion model helps calibrate the source time functions. The derived nonergodic path terms reveal consistent 3D path effects, including amplification in the Longitudinal Valley and Ilan Plain, and deamplification along the Coastal and Central Ranges. This provides a framework for nonergodic seismic hazard assessment in data-sparse regions.

sum: Forecasting rockfalls typically relies on surface deformation monitoring, which can miss internal damage processes. This study presents over 10 years of passive seismic and geodetic monitoring of the ~14,000 m³ La Praz unstable rock slope in the French Alps until its collapse in August 2023. By tracking the fundamental resonance frequency (f₀) from ambient vibrations and correcting for reversible thermoelastic variations, the authors detected an irreversible 24% decrease in f₀ during the final six months before failure, reflecting bulk stiffness reduction. Comparing f₀ variations with surface displacement rates from extensometers and total stations revealed alternating damage regimes: rapid f₀ drops with minimal displacement indicating brittle rock-bridge failure, and gradual f₀ decreases with accelerating displacement indicating ductile sliding. The authors propose a novel metric multiplying daily f₀ variation by deformation velocity, which rises by four orders of magnitude before collapse, offering improved early warning for unstable slopes.

Over 10 years of passive seismic recordings (Lennartz/Kinemetrics and Raspberry-Shake), rear-crack extensometer measurements (2006–2023), 3D automatic total station displacements (2018–2023), and meteorological data at the ~14,000 m³ La Praz rock slope.

After remaining within ±3% of baseline for over a decade, temperature-corrected f₀ dropped by 24% (-1.6 Hz) during the 6 months before collapse, with daily variations reaching -0.75%/day.

The combined Δf₀ × V metric is less sensitive to brittle damage phases with low deformation rates, and linear thermal correction may struggle at sites with complex environmental forcing.

Demonstrates passive seismic damage tracking until collapse on a complex, heavily fractured slope (rather than a simple rock column) and introduces the combined Δf₀ × V hazard metric.
首次在复杂碎裂岩质边坡上实现直至崩塌的被动地震损伤追踪，并提出Δf₀×V联合预警新指标。

Proposed a combined monitoring metric (daily Δf₀ × deformation velocity V) that increases by four orders of magnitude during the pre-collapse year compared to baseline.

Linear regression between air temperature and f₀ during a 2011–2013 baseline period to remove reversible thermoelastic fluctuations and isolate damage-related Δf₀.

Surface deformation monitoring via invar wire extensometers across the main rear crack (2006–2023) and 3D cliff motion tracking with an automatic total station (2018–2023).
On-site air temperature measurements (PT100 probe) and precipitation time-series assembled from four nearby weather stations.
La Praz岩质边坡逾10年（2011–2023年）的被动地震数据，早期采用Lennartz/Kinemetrics连续记录，2023年采用低成本Raspberry-Shake触发记录（每天2×20分钟）。

现场气温测量（PT100探头）以及由附近四个气象站合成的降雨时间序列。

sum: This paper presents a deep learning-based method to suppress interference signals in surface-wave data acquired using Tunnel Boring Machine (TBM) drilling noise. TBM drilling noise serves as a real-time, non-invasive seismic source, but strong body-wave and inter-trace interference hinders accurate dispersion curve extraction. To address this, the authors construct a synthetic dataset mimicking realistic field interference and design a specialized convolutional autoencoder focused on signal morphological features. They also introduce a transfer learning strategy to mitigate inter-trace interference caused by irregular acquisition geometries. Both synthetic and field data tests demonstrate that the method effectively suppresses noise, leading to highly accurate dispersion-curve extraction for shallow subsurface characterization.
本文提出基于深度学习的TBM钻掘噪声面波干扰抑制方法。针对强体波和道间干扰影响频散提取的问题，构建了具实际干扰特征的合成数据集，并设计了关注信号形态特征的卷积自编码器。引入迁移学习抑制不规则采集导致的道间干扰。合成与实际数据测试表明，该方法去噪能力强，显著提升了频散曲线提取精度。

设计了关注信号形态特征的卷积自编码器，并结合迁移学习抑制体波与道间干扰。
A synthetic dataset incorporating realistic field interference characteristics and real field TBM drilling noise data.
包含实际野外干扰特征的合成数据集，以及实际TBM隧道钻掘噪声地震数据。
Successful suppression of three main interference types in TBM noise, enabling highly accurate extraction of surface-wave dispersion curves.
成功抑制了TBM噪声中的三类主要干扰，显著提高了面波频散曲线的提取精度。
Generalization depends on synthetic training data quality and may require site-specific transfer learning adaptation.

sum: This paper presents Seis-DAT, a dual-attention transformer designed for seismic resolution enhancement (super-resolution). Traditional CNN-based methods suffer from limited receptive fields, leading to oversmoothed results or artifacts. Seis-DAT addresses this by integrating window-based self-attention for local textures and channel attention for global geological trends. To train the model, the authors construct a large-scale synthetic dataset with complex faults and folds, and use a composite loss function combining L1 loss and multiscale structural similarity loss with a linear weight scheduling strategy. Synthetic and real-world applications demonstrate that Seis-DAT outperforms conventional methods, achieving higher PSNR and SSIM, and producing clearer seismic events with superior lateral continuity.

sum: The crustal nature of the Laxmi Basin (LB) in the northern Arabian Sea has long been debated among stretched continental crust, subduction forearc, and oceanic spreading models. This study presents new whole-rock major/trace element and acid-leached Sr–Nd–Pb isotopic data from 14 basaltic basement samples recovered at IODP Expedition 355 Site U1457. The lavas exhibit N-MORB-like trace element profiles, high Mg# (64%–71%), and initial εNd (+5.7 to +6.2). Isotopic mixing and MELTS thermodynamic phase-equilibrium modeling indicate the basalts formed by high-degree (10%–30%) melting of a hybrid mantle source comprising depleted MORB mantle (DMM) and minor (<25%) depleted subcontinental lithospheric mantle (SCLM). By rigorously removing seawater alteration effects that misled earlier subduction interpretations, the authors demonstrate that the LB records a short-lived (~68–63 Ma) aborted rift-to-ridge transition prior to spreading migration to the Carlsberg Ridge.

t: Geochemical (XRF, Q-ICP-MS) and acid-leached Sr-Nd-Pb isotopic (TIMS) analyses of basalt cores, combined with binary isotope mixing, PRIMELT3 temperature estimation, and MELTS/pMELTS thermodynamic phase equilibrium modeling.
对玄武岩芯进行XRF、ICP-MS和酸淋滤TIMS同位素分析，结合二元混合与MELTS相平衡模拟。
Fourteen visibly unaltered basaltic basement samples recovered from three cores (96, 97, 98) below ~1 km of sediment at IODP Expedition 355 Site U1457 in the Laxmi Basin.
IODP 355航次U1457站位约1千米沉积物之下回收的14个未蚀变玄武岩基底样品。
Basalts show N-MORB-like REE patterns, high Mg# (64%–71%), and initial εNd (+5.7 to +6.2), explained by 10%–30% melting of a hybrid mantle source with 80%–95% DMM and 5%–25% depleted SCLM.
玄武岩呈N-MORB特征（εNd为+5.7至+6.2），源于含5%–25%亏损SCLM的混合地幔10%–30%熔融。
The timing of rifting and oceanic spreading in the Laxmi Basin remains poorly constrained, relying on regional magnetic anomalies and overlying sediment biostratigraphy.
拉克希米盆地裂解和海底扩张的精确时间约束仍然较差。

Strict acid-leaching eliminates seawater alteration artifacts, refuting subduction and continental-rift models and proving the Laxmi Basin is an aborted Late Cretaceous rift-to-ridge spreading center.
严格酸淋滤消除海水蚀变假象，否定俯冲与陆裂模型，证实其为夭折扩张中心。

kc: Provides acid-leached Sr-Nd-Pb isotopic and trace element data for 14 basaltic basement samples from IODP Site U1457 in the Laxmi Basin.
Demonstrates that previously proposed subduction signatures (elevated LILE, 87Sr/86Sr) were artifacts of seawater alteration and secondary vein contamination.
Establishes through isotopic mixing and MELTS thermodynamic modeling that the basalts formed from 10%–30% melting of DMM mixed with 5%–25% depleted SCLM.
Proposes a tectonic model of an aborted Late Cretaceous (~68–63 Ma) rift-to-ridge seafloor spreading center prior to ridge jump to the Carlsberg Ridge.
提供了拉克希米盆地IODP U1457站位14个玄武岩基底样品的酸淋滤Sr-Nd-Pb同位素和微量元素数据。
证实前人提出的俯冲地球化学特征（高大离子亲石元素、高锶同位素比值）实为海水蚀变和次生脉体污染所致。
通过同位素混合和MELTS热力学模拟，确定玄武岩由亏损洋中脊地幔混入5%–25%亏损次大陆岩石圈地幔经10%–30%熔融形成。
提出了晚白垩世（约68–63 Ma）短暂陆裂-洋脊转换扩张中心在跃迁至卡尔斯伯格洋脊前夭折的构造演化模型。
me: Whole-rock major element analysis via X-ray fluorescence (XRF) and trace element analysis via quadrupole ICP-MS.
Acid-leached whole-rock radiogenic Sr–Nd–Pb isotope ratio measurements using Thermal Ionization Mass Spectrometry (TIMS).
Three-stage Pb isotopic evolution and binary Sr–Nd–Pb isotopic source mixing models.
Thermodynamic phase equilibrium and crystallization modeling using MELTS/pMELTS and mantle potential temperature estimation via PRIMELT3.
利用X射线荧光光谱仪（XRF）进行全岩主量元素分析，利用四极杆电感耦合等离子体质谱仪（Q-ICP-MS）进行微量元素分析。

Regional magnetic anomaly compilations, seismic reflection profile interpretations, and reference databases (PetDB, GEOROC) for Indian Ocean MORB, Deccan Traps, and hotspot lavas.

区域磁异常汇编、地震反射剖面解释，以及来自PetDB和GEOROC数据库的印度洋MORB、德干暗色岩和热点熔岩对比数据。

sum: This study introduces a novel, data-driven framework combining spectral clustering and kernel logistic regression to analyze seismic receiver function (RF) variability without requiring detailed velocity modeling. Applied to 16 volcanoes along the Alaska-Aleutian volcanic arc, the method successfully maps spatial RF patterns. The results show that volcanoes with spatially coherent RF patterns correspond to simpler magma storage systems, whereas those with disorganized patterns indicate complex, multi-layered storage. This variability correlates with edifice morphology rather than subduction parameters, providing a systematic tool for volcanic structure comparison.
本研究提出结合谱聚类和核逻辑回归的数据驱动框架，用于在无需速度建模的情况下分析接收函数（RF）变化。应用于阿留申弧16座火山，成功绘制了空间RF特征。结果表明，空间相干的RF模式对应较简单的岩浆储存系统，而无序模式对应复杂的多层储存。该变化与火山形态相关，为火山结构对比提供了系统性工具。

t: A data-driven framework combining spectral clustering and kernel logistic regression to identify and map seismic receiver function variability without detailed velocity modeling.
结合谱聚类和核逻辑回归的数据驱动框架，无需速度建模即可识别和映射接收函数变化。
Seismic receiver functions computed from earthquake waveforms recorded at 16 volcanoes along the Alaska-Aleutian volcanic arc.
利用阿拉斯加-阿留申火山弧16座火山处记录的地震波形计算出的接收函数数据。
Spatially coherent receiver function patterns correlate with simple magma storage systems and edifice morphology, while disorganized patterns indicate complex, multi-layer storage.
空间相干的接收函数模式与简单的岩浆储存和火山形态相关，而无序模式对应复杂的多层储存。
The method maps structural variability and patterns but does not directly invert for absolute seismic velocity models.
该方法仅映射结构变化和模式，无法直接反演获得绝对地震波速度模型。
First application of spectral clustering and kernel logistic regression to systematically compare receiver function patterns across multiple arc volcanoes.
首次应用谱聚类和核逻辑回归系统性对比多个弧火山的接收函数特征。

kc: Introduced a novel data-driven method using spectral clustering and kernel logistic regression to analyze receiver function variability.
Mapped crustal magmatic architecture across 16 volcanoes in the Aleutian arc without requiring detailed velocity modeling.

sum: This Zenodo repository contains the comprehensive data products, model files, and code inputs for analyzing periodic slow slip events (SSEs) on the Hayward Fault from 2016 to 2026. The dataset features rebased OPERA DISP-S1 Sentinel-1 displacement stacks (tracks 35 and 42), GNSS velocity mosaics, USGS creepmeter and alignment-array records, and precipitation data. Additionally, it includes 3D finite-element meshes and slip-model outputs generated using PyLith and the CSI framework. This open-science release enables full reproducibility of the spatial-temporal slip history and sensitivity analyses of the Hayward Fault's transient deformation, providing a valuable benchmark for fault mechanics and geodetic inversion studies.

sum: Calibrating physics-based earthquake-cycle models for hazard assessment is challenging due to chaotic nonlinear dynamics, unknown initial conditions, and sparse, noisy paleoseismic records. This study introduces a Bayesian inverse framework that bypasses initial-state estimation by exploiting ergodicity, inverting instead for stationary summary statistics of large earthquakes (mean interevent time, coefficient of variation, burstiness, and mean coseismic slip). Using synthetic data from a 1D rate-and-state fault with five heterogeneous segments, observational dating noise, slip noise, and detection thresholds are explicitly modeled. The inverse problem is solved via a three-stage Calibrate-Emulate-Sample strategy: derivative-free Ensemble Kalman Inversion (EKI) locates high-probability parameter regions, a PCA-reduced Gaussian Process (GP) surrogate emulates the parameter-to-statistics map, and preconditioned Crank-Nicolson MCMC performs rapid uncertainty quantification. Results show that velocity-weakening and central velocity-strengthening fault properties and segment lengths are tightly constrained with only ~2,500 forward simulations, laying a rigorous foundation for physics-based earthquake forecasting.
标定基于物理的地震周期模型面临混沌动力学、未知初始条件及古地震记录稀疏含噪等挑战。本研究提出一种贝叶斯反演框架，利用遍历性假设避开初始状态估计，直接反演大地震的平稳统计量（平均复发间隔、变异系数、爆发性及平均同震滑动）。基于含5个异质分段的一维速率-状态摩擦断层合成数据，显式建模了测年误差、滑动噪声……

t: A three-stage Calibrate-Emulate-Sample framework combines derivative-free Ensemble Kalman Inversion, a PCA-reduced Gaussian Process surrogate of the parameter-to-statistics map, and preconditioned Crank-Nicolson MCMC to infer 17 fault parameters without estimating initial conditions.
采用“标定-代理-采样”三步框架，结合无导数EKI、PCA降维高斯过程代理与pCN-MCMC反演17个断层参数。

Synthetic 5,000-year paleoseismic catalog from a 240-km rate-and-state fault across 20 trench sites, recording 80 summary statistics with 10-year dating noise, 0.4-m slip noise, and a 0.8-m detection threshold.
240公里断层上20个探槽点的5000年合成古地震目录，含测年误差10年、滑动误差0.4米及0.8米检测阈值。

EKI converges in ~2,500 forward simulations; 200,000 MCMC steps accurately recover segment lengths and frictional parameters (especially a/b and (a-b)sigma) in VW and central VS segments, though outer VS segments remain biased.
约2500次正演实现EKI收敛，准确恢复速度弱化段和中央强化段的长度及摩擦参数，外侧强化段存在偏差。
Assumes unproven ergodicity over finite Holocene windows, known 5-segment geometry, a perfect quasi-dynamic model, and an observational covariance matrix computed from the true parameters.
依赖未证实的遍历性假设、已知的分段几何、完美准动态模型假设以及由真实模型计算的噪声协方差。
Replaces unstable trajectory-matching and initial-state estimation in chaotic earthquake models with Bayesian inversion of stationary paleoseismic summary statistics accelerated by GP emulation.
以古地震平稳统计量的贝叶斯反演替代混沌地震模型中不稳定的轨迹匹配与初始状态估计。

kc: Formulated a Bayesian inverse framework to calibrate heterogeneous earthquake-cycle parameters using stationary paleoseismic summary statistics.
Exploited ergodicity of dissipative fault dynamics to eliminate the ill-posed problem of inferring unknown initial conditions in chaotic sequences.
Implemented a Calibrate-Emulate-Sample workflow combining Ensemble Kalman Inversion, PCA-reduced Gaussian processes, and MCMC using only O(10^3) forward runs.
建立了利用古地震平稳统计量标定非均匀地震周期模型参数的贝叶斯反演框架。
利用耗散断层动力学的遍历性，消除了在混沌序列中反演未知初始条件的病态问题。
实现了结合系综卡尔曼反演、PCA降维高斯过程和MCMC的“标定-代理-采样”流程，仅需千次量级正演。
me: Quasi-dynamic 1D rate-and-state friction earthquake simulator with aging law and static elastic stress transfer.
Stationary summary statistics observation operator incorporating dating noise, slip measurement noise, and slip detection thresholds.
Continuous-time derivative-free Ensemble Kalman Inversion (EKI) for parameter calibration.
Principal Component Analysis (PCA) dimensionality reduction coupled with Gaussian Process (GP) regression for surrogate modeling.
Preconditioned Crank-Nicolson (pCN) Markov Chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) sampling for posterior uncertainty quantification.
结合老化律与静态弹性应力传递的一维准动态速率-状态摩擦地震模拟器。
包含测年噪声、滑动测量噪声和检测阈值的平稳统计量观测算子。

Realistic noise injection: 10-year dating standard deviation, 0.4-m slip noise standard deviation, and 0.8-m coseismic slip detection threshold.

sum: This study investigates the decadal post-unrest subsidence at Changbaishan volcano (2002–2005) using 3D thermo-mechanical modeling integrated with InSAR observations, gravity, seismic, and magnetotelluric data. The authors propose a novel gravity-driven mechanism where a dense, mafic melt core settles within a shallow, lower-density felsic mush reservoir. This negative buoyancy model successfully reproduces the observed deformation magnitude and aligns with local gravity and high-conductivity anomalies. While alternative mechanisms cannot be completely ruled out, this gravity-driven settling provides a plausible explanation for non-eruptive volcanic subsidence, with potential analogs at Askja and Aluto volcanoes.
本研究针对长白山火山活跃期后的十年尺度地表沉降，结合InSAR观测与受重力、地震和电磁约束的三维热-机械模拟。结果表明，沉降可由浅部低密度长英质岩浆房中高密度基性熔体核的重力下沉解释。该模型成功重建了形变幅度，且与高重力和高导异常空间吻合。这一负浮力机制为无喷发火山沉降提供了新视角。

Proposes a novel gravity-driven negative buoyancy mechanism (settling of a dense melt core) to explain post-unrest volcanic subsidence without eruption.

sum: The paper introduces Sub-Ice, a semi-automated tool designed to map basal channels on ice shelves using surface digital elevation models (DEMs). Basal channels, which influence ice shelf stability and basal melting, are traditionally mapped manually. Sub-Ice automates this by tracing channel centerlines from user-defined endpoints, extracting cross-sectional profiles, and delineating channel edges using three distinct methods (slope threshold, profile knee point, or peak prominence). Tested on 34 channels of the Roi Baudouin Ice Shelf in East Antarctica, Sub-Ice centerlines closely match manual tracings (median difference of 132 m) while offering superior consistency and reproducibility. This tool enables standardized, large-scale comparisons of channel geometry across different ice shelves and time periods.
本文介绍了Sub-Ice，这是一款利用表面数字高程模型（DEM）半自动绘制冰架底部通道的工具。底部通道传统上依靠人工绘制，效率低且缺乏一致性。Sub-Ice通过用户定义的起点和终点自动追踪通道中心线，提取横截面剖面，并利用坡度阈值、剖面拐点或峰值显著性三种方法划定通道边缘。在南极东部Roi Baud……

基于表面DEM，结合迭代高程极小值中心线追踪与三种边缘划定方法（坡度阈值、拐点或峰值显著性）。
Surface digital elevation models (DEMs) covering 34 basal channels on the Roi Baudouin Ice Shelf, East Antarctica.

Sub-Ice centerlines differed from manual tracings by a median of 132 m, which is comparable to the year-to-year manual mapping variability (74-132 m).

The tool is semi-automated, requiring manual input for channel start and end points, and width estimates depend on user-calibrated parameters.

Provides the first semi-automated, reproducible framework for mapping ice shelf basal channels, replacing subjective manual digitization with explicit geometric criteria.

sum: This paper presents a refined, NaN-aware nested bilateral filtering method designed to filter gridded InSAR velocity fields prior to strain-rate estimation. By weighting pixels based on both spatial distance and velocity differences relative to a robust local reference velocity, the method effectively handles data gaps (NaNs), white noise, and spatially correlated noise. Synthetic tests using a screw dislocation model with shallow creep demonstrate its superiority over conventional Gaussian and median filters. The method is successfully applied to map strain rates (maximum shear, dilatation, and vorticity) across the Alpine-Himalayan Belt using real InSAR velocity fields, providing a robust tool for crustal deformation analysis.
本文提出支持NaN的嵌套双边滤波方法，用于对网格化InSAR速度场滤波以估计应变率。该方法结合空间距离和速度差加权，有效处理数据缺失与噪声。合成测试表明其在保留浅部蠕变等陡峭梯度上优于传统滤波器。应用于阿尔卑斯-喜马拉雅带实际数据，成功重建了多种应变率，为地壳形变分析提供了鲁棒工具。

t: A NaN-aware nested bilateral filter that weights pixels by spatial distance and velocity difference from a robust local reference velocity.
支持NaN的嵌套双边滤波器，结合空间距离和速度差进行局部加权滤波。
Synthetic screw dislocation models with shallow creep and noise, and real InSAR velocity fields across the Alpine-Himalayan Belt.
包含浅部蠕变和噪声的合成螺旋位错模型，以及阿尔卑斯-喜马拉雅带InSAR速度场。
The refined bilateral filter successfully maps maximum shear, dilatation, and vorticity strain rates while preserving sharp gradients and handling data gaps.

sum: This paper proposes a non-contact dual-laser Doppler vibrometry (LDV) synchronous sensing scheme to monitor the vibration response and predict the collapse of unstable rock masses under repeated aftershocks. Using a cement-block model with an ice-bonded interface subjected to repeated steel-ball impacts, the authors extract time-domain, frequency-domain, and cross-channel coupling indicators. The results demonstrate that while single indicators like dominant frequency are insensitive to damage, the zero-lag correlation deficit and normalized RMS show clear precursory changes. A multi-indicator fusion framework is developed to suppress false and missed alarms, providing a robust experimental and analytical basis for landslide and rockfall early warning.
本文提出了一种非接触式双激光多普勒测振（LDV）同步传感方案，用于监测反复余震作用下危岩体的振动响应并预测其崩塌。通过对冰胶结界面的水泥块模型进行重复落球冲击模拟余震，提取了时域、频域和跨通道耦合指标。结果表明，虽然主频等单一指标对损伤不敏感，但零滞后相关性赤字和归一化RMS在崩塌前表现出明显的先兆……

sum: Deep-learning-based seismic impedance inversion typically requires target-survey retraining, which overfits when well control is extremely sparse. This paper proposes a transferable 3D inversion framework separating offline training from target deployment. In Stage I, a 3D masked autoencoder learns structural representations from 244 unlabeled seismic volumes across 31 global surveys. In Stage II, the frozen encoder is integrated into an inversion network trained on 200 synthetic geological models using inverse-distance-weighted sparse-well low-frequency priors, dynamic gated feature fusion, and Ricker dominant-frequency convolutional consistency. During deployment, the network remains frozen; a single conditioning well constructs the low-frequency prior and determines global affine normalization parameters. Tested on five single-well configurations of the Overthrust model and a 3D field survey, the frozen model reduces Overthrust P95 trace-wise NRMSE from 0.1310 to 0.1074 and lowers field blind-well mean NRMSE by 20.95% compared to a target-trained U-Net.

sum: Empirical Green's functions (EGFs) extracted from ambient noise are essential for seismic tomography, yet sparse station coverage limits imaging resolution. Conventional interpolation methods struggle with the irregular, five-dimensional, and dispersive nature of surface-wave EGFs. This study introduces DIER (diffusion-assisted implicit EGF representation), a self-supervised deep learning framework combining implicit neural representation (INR) with denoising diffusion probabilistic models (DDPMs). Conditioned on station pair coordinates via classifier-free guidance, a 1D U-Net progressively denoises Gaussian noise into realistic EGF waveforms without requiring synthetic labels. Evaluated on continental U.S. ambient noise data (400 training and 60 test stations in the 20–50 s band), DIER substantially outperforms radial basis function (RBF) interpolation in phase alignment and dispersion accuracy, keeping phase-velocity errors within ±0.05 km/s. Furthermore, surface-wave tomography using DIER-interpolated EGFs across 1,046 virtual stations closely recovers structural anomalies seen in dense-array reference models.
从地震背景噪声中提取的经验格林函数（EGF）广泛用于地下结构成像，但稀疏台网限制了成像分辨率，且EGF固有的五维不规则采样和频散特性使传统插值方法难以奏效。本文提出了一种名为DIER的自监督深度学习框架，将隐式神经表征（INR）与去噪扩散概率模型（DDPM）相结合。该方法以台站对坐标作为条件引导1D……

t: DIER integrates Implicit Neural Representation with a 1D U-Net Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Model conditioned on station coordinates via classifier-free guidance to generate 5-D EGF waveforms from Gaussian noise.
结合隐式神经表征与1D U-Net去噪扩散概率模型，通过台站坐标条件引导自监督生成五维EGF波形。
Continental U.S. ambient noise EGFs (20–50 s period, 0.25 Hz, 2,000 s length) from 460 EarthScope stations, split into 35,867 training EGFs (400 stations) and 11,785 test EGFs (60 stations).
美国大陆460个台站20–50 s背景噪声EGF数据，含35,867条训练波形和11,785条测试波形。
DIER keeps phase-velocity perturbations mostly within ±0.05 km/s versus >±0.15 km/s for RBF, and improves 25-s and 40-s tomographic SSIM from 0.6485 and 0.6742 (sparse network) to 0.6851 and 0.7591.

Implicit Neural Representation (INR) formulated as conditional probabilistic modeling p_theta(G|C) using a 1D U-Net noise predictor with MLP coordinate and timestep embeddings.
Comparison of three coordinate embedding strategies: absolute position embedding, relative position embedding, and Fourier feature mapping.
Baseline comparison against Radial Basis Function (RBF) interpolation using second-order polyharmonic splines at each time sample.

将隐式神经表征（INR）重构为条件概率建模，利用带MLP坐标与时间步嵌入的1D U-Net预测噪声。

tm.why: The paper develops DIER, a self-supervised deep learning framework integrating denoising diffusion probabilistic models and implicit neural representation to interpolate seismic waveforms.
The framework specifically targets the interpolation of 5-D empirical Green's functions (EGFs) extracted from seismic ambient noise cross-correlations.
Interpolated EGFs are used to measure surface-wave phase velocity dispersion curves and construct enhanced continental-scale phase velocity tomography maps.

sum: This study quantitatively investigates the inverse correlation between the earthquake b-value and faulting instability (the alignment between background stress and faulting orientations). Using synthetic catalogs, the authors validate a maximum likelihood estimation (MLE) framework to recover friction coefficients and b-value parameters. Applying this method to two earthquake and stress catalogs in California, they confirm the universal inverse relationship between b-value and instability. The estimated regional friction coefficients are lower than laboratory values but consistent with field-scale estimates. This work introduces a novel approach to estimating regional friction coefficients and constraining the minimum earthquake size at which stochastic cascade-up growth begins, advancing our understanding of earthquake rupture mechanisms.

sum: This book chapter by Andreas Fichtner provides a rigorous introduction to Bayesian inference and Monte Carlo sampling techniques. It covers the formulation of inverse problems in a probabilistic framework, detailing how prior information and observational uncertainties are mapped into posterior probability densities. The chapter discusses various Monte Carlo sampling strategies, such as Markov Chain Monte Carlo (MCMC), which are essential for exploring high-dimensional parameter spaces in geophysics. It serves as a foundational theoretical guide for researchers and students working on uncertainty quantification in seismic tomography and other geophysical applications.

sum: This book chapter provides a comprehensive overview of optimization techniques for weakly non-linear inverse problems, which lie between linear approximations and full probabilistic sampling. It covers fundamental concepts of iterative optimization, including local minima, descent directions, and general descent methods. Building on these foundations, the chapter details advanced optimization algorithms crucial for geophysical applications, such as Newton-based methods (Gauss-Newton, Levenberg-Marquardt), conjugate-gradient variants, quasi-Newton methods (BFGS, L-BFGS), trust-region approaches, and stochastic gradient descent (ADAM). These methods are essential for efficiently solving moderately non-linear inverse problems, such as full-waveform inversion, by balancing computational cost with solution accuracy.

sum: This paper addresses the optimization of seismographic network strategies for earthquake surveillance. Since network deployment involves multiple conflicting criteria and high uncertainty, the authors introduce a multi-criteria decision-making (MCDM) framework based on linguistic Pythagorean fuzzy dynamic knowledge. This approach allows decision-makers to express qualitative preferences and handle dynamic, uncertain information effectively. The proposed method evaluates and ranks different network deployment alternatives, enhancing the reliability and responsiveness of earthquake monitoring systems.

sum: This study reports the discovery of a 3.95-Gyr-old trondhjemitic gneiss from the eastern Hebei province in the North China Craton. By analyzing primary magmatic zircons, the authors identified elevated δ18O and positive εHf(t) values, indicating a low-temperature altered basaltic source derived from a depleted Hadean mantle. Unlike the low-pressure origin of similar-aged rocks in Canada, geochemical signatures and thermodynamic modeling indicate a high-pressure origin (>1.6 GPa, 740–820 °C). This suggests that surface-altered oceanic crust was rapidly buried to mantle depths along a cool thermal gradient, providing strong evidence for transient subduction processes operating on Earth as early as 3.95 billion years ago.

sum: This study addresses the long-standing debate over the origin of the regional olivine-bearing unit in Nili Fossae, Mars. While previous hypotheses suggested pyroclastic or aeolian origins, recent in situ data from the Perseverance rover at Jezero crater indicated an igneous cumulate origin. Using orbital observations, the authors identify 'Large Linear Features' with triple junctions, raised ridges, and tapering geometries, interpreting them as feeder dikes aligned with Nili Fossae fractures. They propose that extensional fracturing of the Noachian crust, driven by Isidis basin loading, facilitated magma ascent. The unit's 'draping' morphology is reinterpreted as eroded saucer-shaped sills. This intrusive framework implies the olivine unit formed after Jezero crater and underwent significant subsequent erosion, fundamentally revising the geological timeline of the Perseverance landing site.

sum: This paper presents a physics-constrained neural network (PINN) emulator for time-discretised landslide runout modelling. To overcome the high computational cost of traditional physics-based simulations, the authors train the emulator on over 200,000 samples of landslide thicknesses and velocities on digital elevation models (DEMs). The model incorporates physics-based loss functions representing mass conservation and kinetic energy loss to ensure physical consistency. The emulator achieves high accuracy, with single-step root mean square errors of ~0.06 m for thickness and ~0.11 m/s for velocity. In autoregressive rollouts of 110 iterations, errors remain low (~0.21 m and ~0.09 m/s) while achieving a speedup of over 50 times compared to full physics-based models, making it highly suitable for large parameter sweeps and hazard forecasting.
本文提出了一种用于时间离散化滑坡运动模拟的物理约束神经网络（PINN）仿真器。为解决传统物理模型计算成本高的问题，该模型在超过20万个包含DEM上滑坡厚度和速度的数据样本上进行训练。通过引入基于质量守恒和动能损失的物理损失函数，确保了模拟的物理一致性。测试表明，单步预测中厚度和速度的均方根误差分别仅……

sum: This study investigates the active tectonics, structural geometry, and seismogenic potential of the Saline d'Arzew fault-related fold (SARF) in northwestern Algeria. By analyzing the fault-related folding, the authors assess its capacity to generate significant earthquakes and evaluate its potential role as the source of the devastating historical 1790 Oran earthquake and its associated tsunami. The research provides critical insights into the regional geodynamics of the Algerian margin, seismic hazard assessment, and tsunami risk mitigation in the western Mediterranean.

sum: This study applies the machine-learning-based LOC-FLOW workflow to continuous seismic data (2015–2019) from 191 stations in Northeast China to construct a high-precision earthquake catalog for the Wudalianchi volcanic field. The catalog contains 6,496 events, representing a tenfold increase in detections compared to the standard CENC catalog and lowering the magnitude of completeness to 1.15. The results delineate two newly identified NE-SW-trending seismic belts (Chaihe-Zhawenqihan and Bayan-Tangwang) and reveal a conical distribution of microearthquakes beneath the Wudalianchi volcano. These events are located above tomographically imaged low-velocity anomalies, suggesting that seismic activity is driven by magma or hydrothermal fluids originating from the big mantle wedge above the subducted Pacific slab.

sum: Simulating sequences of earthquakes and aseismic slip (SEAS) is computationally expensive because seismic ruptures require tiny time steps and tracking elastodynamic wave-mediated memory effects. This paper introduces a hybrid modeling framework that accelerates long-term SEAS simulations on 1D rate-and-state faults in 2D antiplane elasticity. A conventional quasi-dynamic (QD) solver handles slow interseismic periods where inertial effects are negligible, while a trained Fourier neural operator (FNO) acts as a Poincaré jump map that advances fault states directly from pre-rupture to post-rupture. Trained on 14,000 events generated efficiently via parallel short fully dynamic (FD) simulations, the FNO benefits significantly from incorporating redundant physical variables (shear stress and stress transfer functional) into its architecture and loss function. Tested on homogeneous and heterogeneous fault models, the hybrid simulator accurately reproduces long-term FD magnitude and recurrence-time distributions, outperforming standard QD approximations while achieving 7.6x to 12.2x speedups and eliminating history-storage memory.
地震与无震滑移序列（SEAS）全动态模拟因同震期需极小时间步长并追踪弹性动力波记忆效应而计算昂贵。本文提出一种混合建模框架：在惯性效应可忽略的震间慢速演化期采用传统准动态（QD）求解器；在同震期利用傅里叶神经算子（FNO）学习从震前到震后的状态跳跃映射。研究通过并行短时全动态模拟高效生成训练集，并在……

t: A hybrid simulator evolves slow interseismic periods using a conventional quasi-dynamic solver and replaces computationally intensive dynamic rupture phases with a 1D Fourier neural operator trained with redundant stress variables to map pre-event to post-event fault states.
混合模拟器在震间期采用准动态求解器，同震期用引入冗余应力变量训练的一维FNO直接映射震前至震后状态。

For both homogeneous and heterogeneous 1D antiplane rate-and-state fault models, 20,000 paired pre- and post-event states are generated from parallel short fully dynamic simulations (14,000 training, 2,000 validation, 4,000 testing).
通过并行短时全动态模拟，为均匀和非均匀一维反平面断层各生成2万对震前震后状态样本用于训练与测试。

The hybrid simulator achieves median relative L2 test errors below 0.01 for log slip rate and 0.02 for state, reproduces FD magnitude and recurrence distributions much better than QD, and speeds up 20,000–40,000-year simulations by 7.6x to 12.2x.
对数滑移率相对误差低于0.01，长期震级与复发统计显著优于准动态近似，计算速度提升7.6至12.2倍。

The current implementation is limited to 1D faults in 2D elastic solids with fixed rate-and-state friction and lacks 3D geometry, interseismic viscoplasticity, or enhanced coseismic thermal weakening.
目前仅限二维弹性介质中的一维固定摩擦参数断层，未包含三维几何、粘塑性或同震热弱化机制。

Unlike prior ML studies that emulate single dynamic ruptures, this work learns a Markovian Poincaré jump map across coseismic episodes to accelerate multi-cycle fully dynamic earthquake sequence simulations.
首次利用FNO学习跨越同震阶段的马尔可夫庞加莱跳跃映射，以加速多周期全动态地震序列模拟。

Established an efficient parallel data generation strategy using ensembles of short simulations with randomized initial conditions, proving statistical invariance with single long runs.

Redundant operator formulation mapping (ln V, Theta, tau) to changes (Delta ln V, Delta Theta, Delta phi) with physics-informed loss terms.

sum: This study investigates the Moho geometry beneath the Pumqu–Xianza Rift in southern Tibet to understand the mechanism of N–S trending rifts. Using Pn arrival times from a dense short-period seismic array and wavefield numerical simulations, the authors image detailed Moho morphology. They observe earlier Pn arrivals indicating significant Moho uplift beneath the rift. The center of this uplift shifts eastward away from the surface rift toward the north, implying weak coupling between the upper and lower crust. Furthermore, the uplift's height and width increase progressively northward, suggesting a north-to-south tearing of the Moho. This structural pattern suggests that rift formation is driven by eastward crustal extrusion in central Tibet or southward tearing of the subducted Indian slab.
本研究利用穿过朋曲-申扎裂谷的密集短周期地震台阵观测到的Pn波走时数据，结合波场数值模拟，精细刻画了藏南裂谷下方的Moho面形态。观测到的早期Pn到达表明裂谷下方存在显著的Moho面隆起。该隆起中心向北逐渐向东偏离地表裂谷，表明上、下地壳之间存在弱耦合。此外，隆起的高度和东西宽度向北逐渐增加，表明M……

Potential trade-offs between crustal velocity variations and Moho depth, and reliance on simplified geodynamic models.
地壳速度变化与Moho面深度之间可能存在折衷，且依赖于简化的动力学模型。
First detailed imaging of Moho morphology beneath the Pumqu-Xianza Rift showing systematic northward shift and expansion, suggesting southward Moho tearing.
首次精细成像朋曲-申扎裂谷下方Moho形态，揭示其系统性向北偏移与扩大，提出自北向南撕裂。

kc: Imaged detailed Moho morphology beneath the Pumqu-Xianza Rift using Pn arrival times.
Identified a significant Moho uplift beneath the rift that shifts eastward toward the north.
Proposed a north-to-south tearing model of the Moho based on the progressive northward increase in uplift height and width.
利用Pn波走时精细刻画了朋曲-申扎裂谷下方的Moho面形态。
发现了裂谷下方显著的Moho面隆起，且该隆起中心向北逐渐向东偏移。
根据隆起高度和宽度向北递增的特征，提出了Moho面自北向南撕裂的模型。
me: Pn arrival time analysis from a dense short-period seismic array.
Wavefield numerical simulations to constrain Moho morphology.
利用密集短周期地震台阵进行Pn波走时分析。
利用波场数值模拟约束Moho面形态。
de: Seismic data recorded by a dense short-period seismic array crossing the Pumqu-Xianza Rift in southern Tibet.
Synthetic wavefield simulations to model Pn travel times.
跨越藏南朋曲-申扎裂谷的密集短周期地震台阵记录的地震数据。
用于模拟Pn波走时的合成波场数值模拟。
li: Resolution may be limited by the spatial distribution of regional earthquakes and station density.
The geodynamic interpretation relies on simplified end-member models (extrusion vs. slab tearing).
分辨率可能受到区域地震空间分布和台站密度的限制。
地球动力学解释依赖于简化的端元模型（挤出或板块撕裂）。

tm.why: The study uses Pn arrival times to image Moho morphology beneath a rift zone.
The paper investigates Moho geometry and tearing beneath the Tibetan Plateau to understand rifting mechanisms.
